content.en:
Background: Margaret has a 3-year history of Alzheimer's dementia and is followed by a memory-care clinic. Medical history includes hypertension treated with amlodipine 5 mg daily and lisinopril 10 mg daily, osteoarthritis of both knees, and remote left hip fracture repair 5 years ago. She has not been seen by the memory-care clinic in 9 months because Diane could not get time off work.

Initial presentation at 10:00 AM Tuesday: Diane appears fatigued with dark circles, took a half-day off work, and must leave by noon. A neighbor will stay with Margaret from noon until Diane returns from work, but this is an informal favor. Diane reports Margaret was up 4 times last night and tried to go outside at 2 AM. Diane has been placing a chair against Margaret's bedroom door at night because she cannot stay awake. Diane has slept less than 4 consecutive hours for weeks, lost 12 lb in 2 months, called in sick to work 3 times last month, and says she promised her father she would never place Margaret in a home.

Margaret is seated in a recliner wearing a urine-stained housecoat with a faint urine odor. A half-eaten bowl of oatmeal is on the side table. Diane reports Margaret has refused more meals and lost about 8 lb over 3 months. Pill bottles are on the kitchen counter with tops off two bottles. A Wednesday-slot pill organizer is open, but today is Tuesday.
content.zh:
背景：Margaret 有3年阿尔茨海默病史，由记忆门诊随访。病史包括高血压（每日氨氯地平5 mg、赖诺普利10 mg）、双膝骨关节炎，以及5年前左髋骨折修复。因 Diane 无法请假，Margaret 已9个月未到记忆门诊复诊。

周二上午10:00初次表现：Diane 看起来疲惫、有黑眼圈，请了半天假，必须在中午前离开。中午后邻居会陪 Margaret 到 Diane 下班回来，但这只是非正式帮忙。Diane 报告 Margaret 昨晚醒来4次，凌晨2点试图外出。因为自己无法保持清醒，Diane 夜间把椅子抵在 Margaret 卧室门口。Diane 数周来连续睡眠不足4小时，2个月内减重12磅，上个月请病假3次，并说曾答应父亲绝不把 Margaret 送进机构。

Margaret 坐在躺椅上，穿着有尿渍且有淡淡尿味的家居服。边桌上有半碗燕麦。Diane 报告 Margaret 更常拒食，3个月内约减重8磅。厨房台面上有药瓶，其中两个瓶盖打开。星期三药格处于打开状态，但今天是星期二。

title.zh: 初次居家护理访视记录

content.en:
Margaret: T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C), HR 76 regular, BP 148/88, RR 16, SpO₂ 97% room air. Weight 58 kg; weight 9 months ago was 61.6 kg. Alert, oriented only to first name; does not know date, season, or address. Follows one-step commands but not two-step commands. Speech fluent with word-finding pauses and occasional confabulation. Calls the nurse by her late husband's name twice. Skin intact with no bruising, lacerations, or pressure areas. Bilateral knee crepitus with mild swelling. Gait slow and wide-based with a slight forward lean; ambulates short distances independently. Grip strength symmetric and adequate. Oral mucosa slightly dry. Abdomen soft and non-tender. Perineal skin intact but mildly erythematous from urine contact. Diane reports urinary incontinence 2-3 times daily, pull-up briefs during the day, and no fecal incontinence.

Diane: Hands tremble slightly when opening pill bottles. Reports headaches almost daily, difficulty concentrating at work, and feeling angry then guilty when Margaret repeats questions. Denies thoughts of harming herself or Margaret. Has not seen her own primary care provider in over a year. Has not attended a caregiver support group and does not know what respite care is.

Home: Single-story ranch. Bathroom grab bars and hallway night-lights are present. Front door has a standard deadbolt Margaret can unlock. Stove knobs are not covered or disabled. Throw rugs are in the kitchen and hallway. Cleaning supplies are unlocked under the kitchen sink. A wooden chair is propped under the bedroom doorknob.

Labs from primary care office 1 week ago: sodium 141 mEq/L, potassium 4.2 mEq/L, BUN 24 mg/dL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, fasting glucose 102 mg/dL, albumin 3.1 g/dL, prealbumin 14 mg/dL, TSH 2.8 mIU/L, hemoglobin 11.8 g/dL, hematocrit 35%, WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL, platelets 210 ×10³/µL. Urinalysis: trace leukocytes, no nitrites, specific gravity 1.028.
content.zh:
Margaret：T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，HR 76次/分且规则，BP 148/88，RR 16次/分，室内空气下SpO₂ 97%。体重58 kg；9个月前体重61.6 kg。清醒，仅能说出自己的名字；不知道日期、季节或地址。能执行一步指令，不能执行两步指令。言语流利但有找词困难和偶发虚构。两次把护士称为已故丈夫的名字。皮肤完整，无瘀斑、裂伤或压迫部位损伤。双膝骨擦感伴轻度肿胀。步态缓慢、基底较宽、轻度前倾；可在家中短距离独立行走。握力对称且足够。口腔黏膜轻度干燥。腹部柔软、无压痛。会阴皮肤完整但因尿液接触轻度发红。Diane 报告每天尿失禁2–3次，白天穿拉拉裤，无大便失禁。

Diane：打开药瓶时双手轻微颤抖。报告几乎每天头痛，工作时难以集中注意力，当 Margaret 重复提问时会先愤怒后内疚。否认有伤害自己或 Margaret 的想法。已超过1年未看自己的初级保健医生。未参加过照护者支持小组，也不知道喘息服务是什么。

家庭环境：单层牧场式住宅。浴室有扶手，走廊有夜灯。前门是普通插销锁，Margaret 能打开。炉灶旋钮未加盖也未停用。厨房和走廊有小地毯。清洁用品未上锁，放在厨房水槽下方。卧室门把手下抵着一把木椅。

1周前初级保健诊所化验：钠141 mEq/L，钾4.2 mEq/L，BUN 24 mg/dL，肌酐0.9 mg/dL，空腹血糖102 mg/dL，白蛋白3.1 g/dL，前白蛋白14 mg/dL，TSH 2.8 mIU/L，血红蛋白11.8 g/dL，红细胞压积35%，WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL，血小板210 ×10³/µL。尿检：白细胞微量，亚硝酸盐阴性，比重1.028。

title.zh: 评估发现和近期化验

glossary.defZh: 照护需求超过可用支持或能力时，照护者难以承担角色。
从受看护环境中不安全地离开或走失。
一组相互关联、共同指向优先问题的评估发现。

segments.en: Margaret is oriented only to her first name.
segments.zh: Margaret 仅能说出自己的名字，无法定向到日期、季节或地址。

segments.en: Her housecoat is urine-stained and has a faint urine odor.
segments.zh: 她的家居服有尿渍并有淡淡尿味。

segments.en: Perineal skin is mildly erythematous from urine contact.
segments.zh: 会阴皮肤因尿液接触轻度发红。

segments.en: Weight has decreased from 61.6 kg nine months ago to 58 kg today.
segments.zh: 体重从9个月前的61.6 kg下降到今天的58 kg。

segments.en: Albumin is 3.1 g/dL and prealbumin is 14 mg/dL.
segments.zh: 白蛋白为3.1 g/dL，前白蛋白为14 mg/dL。

segments.en: Oral mucosa is slightly dry.
segments.zh: 口腔黏膜轻度干燥。

segments.en: Blood pressure is 148/88 while medication administration is unreliable.
segments.zh: 在用药不可靠的情况下，BP为148/88。

segments.en: Gait is slow and wide-based with a slight forward lean.
segments.zh: 步态缓慢、基底较宽，并轻度前倾。

segments.en: Skin is intact with no bruising, lacerations, or pressure areas.
segments.zh: 皮肤完整，无瘀斑、裂伤或压迫部位损伤。

segments.en: Grip strength is symmetric and adequate.
segments.zh: 握力对称且足够。

segments.en: Temperature is 98.2 °F (36.8 °C) and SpO₂ is 97% on room air.
segments.zh: 体温98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，室内空气下SpO₂为97%。

segments.en: Diane reports sleeping less than four consecutive hours for weeks.
segments.zh: Diane 报告数周来连续睡眠不足4小时。

segments.en: Diane has lost twelve pounds in two months because she forgets to eat.
segments.zh: Diane 因忘记吃饭，两个月内减重12磅。

segments.en: Diane's hands tremble when she opens the pill bottles.
segments.zh: Diane 打开药瓶时双手轻微颤抖。

segments.en: Diane called in sick to work three times last month.
segments.zh: Diane 上个月请病假3次。

segments.en: Diane becomes tearful and says she promised not to place Margaret in a home.
segments.zh: Diane 哭泣，并说她承诺过不把 Margaret 送进机构。

segments.en: A chair is propped under the bedroom doorknob at night.
segments.zh: 夜间有一把椅子抵在卧室门把手下。

segments.en: Pill bottles are open and the wrong-day pill organizer is in use.
segments.zh: 药瓶敞开，且药盒日期使用混乱。

segments.en: The front door has a deadbolt Margaret can unlock.
segments.zh: 前门是 Margaret 能打开的普通插销锁。

segments.en: Stove knobs are uncovered and enabled.
segments.zh: 炉灶旋钮未加盖，也未停用。

segments.en: Throw rugs are present in the kitchen and hallway.
segments.zh: 厨房和走廊有小地毯。

segments.en: Cleaning supplies are unlocked under the kitchen sink.
segments.zh: 清洁用品未上锁，放在厨房水槽下方。

segments.en: Grab bars and night-lights are already present.
segments.zh: 浴室扶手和夜灯已经安装。

byChoice.en: Severe disorientation increases wandering, medication, and home-safety risk.
byChoice.zh: 严重定向障碍会增加走失、用药错误和居家安全风险。

byChoice.en: Urine-stained clothing suggests unmet toileting or hygiene needs and risk for skin breakdown.
byChoice.zh: 衣物有尿渍提示如厕或清洁需求未被充分满足，并有皮肤受损风险。

byChoice.en: Erythema from urine contact requires incontinence and skin-protection interventions.
byChoice.zh: 尿液接触导致的发红需要进行失禁管理和皮肤保护。

byChoice.en: A 3.6 kg loss in an older adult with dementia signals nutritional decline.
byChoice.zh: 老年痴呆患者体重下降3.6 kg提示营养状态下降。

byChoice.en: Low nutrition markers reinforce concern for inadequate intake and nutritional risk.
byChoice.zh: 营养相关指标偏低进一步支持摄入不足和营养风险。

byChoice.en: Dry mucosa and concentrated urine suggest possible inadequate fluid intake.
byChoice.zh: 口腔黏膜干燥和尿液浓缩提示可能液体摄入不足。

byChoice.en: Elevated BP matters because the antihypertensive routine is not reliable.
byChoice.zh: 血压升高需要关注，因为降压药给药流程并不可靠。

byChoice.en: This gait pattern, osteoarthritis, prior hip fracture, and home hazards increase fall risk.
byChoice.zh: 这种步态结合骨关节炎、既往髋部骨折和居家危险物会增加跌倒风险。

byChoice.en: This lowers concern for acute inflicted injury but does not make the home situation safe.
byChoice.zh: 这降低了急性人为外伤的担忧，但不能说明居家环境已经安全。

byChoice.en: Symmetric grip strength is not a priority cue in this caregiver-safety problem.
byChoice.zh: 握力对称不是本题照护者与居家安全问题中的优先线索。

byChoice.en: Normal temperature and oxygenation do not explain the caregiver strain or home hazards.
byChoice.zh: 体温和氧合正常不能解释照护者压力或居家危险。

byChoice.en: Sleep deprivation is a major caregiver role strain cue and threatens safe supervision.
byChoice.zh: 睡眠剥夺是照护者角色压力的重要线索，并威胁安全看护。

byChoice.en: Caregiver weight loss shows her own health is deteriorating.
byChoice.zh: 照护者体重下降说明她自身健康正在恶化。

byChoice.en: Trembling during medication tasks suggests overload and risk for administration errors.
byChoice.zh: 处理药物时手颤提示负荷过重，并增加给药错误风险。

byChoice.en: Work impairment is functional evidence that caregiving demands are overwhelming her.
byChoice.zh: 工作受影响是照护需求已使她不堪重负的功能性证据。

byChoice.en: Tearfulness and guilt reveal grief and caregiver role strain that must be addressed.
byChoice.zh: 哭泣和内疚反映悲伤和照护者角色压力，必须处理。

byChoice.en: The barricade is an unsafe restraint-like strategy used to manage wandering.
byChoice.zh: 用椅子挡门是为处理走失而采取的不安全、类似限制的做法。

byChoice.en: Medication disorganization is a direct safety cue.
byChoice.zh: 用药混乱是直接的安全线索。

byChoice.en: An exterior door the client can unlock creates elopement risk.
byChoice.zh: 患者能打开的外门会造成走失风险。

byChoice.en: Unsecured stove access is an immediate fire and burn hazard.
byChoice.zh: 炉灶未防护是即时火灾和烧伤风险。

byChoice.en: Throw rugs are modifiable trip hazards in a client with gait risk.
byChoice.zh: 小地毯是可改变的绊倒危险，尤其对有步态风险的患者。

byChoice.en: Unlocked chemicals are unsafe for a client with moderate dementia.
byChoice.zh: 对中度痴呆患者来说，未上锁化学清洁品不安全。

byChoice.en: These are protective features, not significant new safety cues requiring follow-up.
byChoice.zh: 这些是保护性设施，不是需要跟进的重要新危险线索。

correct.en: The significant cue cluster includes Margaret's cognitive impairment, nutritional decline, possible dehydration, incontinence-related skin risk, elevated BP with unreliable medication administration, gait/fall risk, and multiple environmental hazards. Diane's sleep deprivation, weight loss, tremor, missed work, guilt, unsafe door barricade, and medication disorganization show caregiver role strain that directly affects Margaret's safety. Normal temperature, oxygenation, symmetric grip, intact skin, grab bars, and night-lights do not remove the need for follow-up.
correct.zh: 重要线索包括 Margaret 的认知受损、营养下降、可能脱水、失禁相关皮肤风险、在用药不可靠情况下的血压升高、步态/跌倒风险以及多项环境危险。Diane 的睡眠剥夺、体重下降、手颤、误工、内疚、不安全挡门和药物混乱显示照护者角色压力，并直接影响 Margaret 的安全。体温、氧合、握力、皮肤完整、扶手和夜灯等正常或保护性发现不能消除跟进需要。

stem.en: Using the Stage 1 home-visit data, highlight the findings that are significant cues requiring nursing attention.
stem.zh: 根据第1阶段居家访视资料，标出需要护理关注的重要线索。

testTakingStrategy.en: In home-care dementia questions, assess two clients: the person with dementia and the caregiver. Normal physical findings can reduce concern for one problem but do not cancel environmental or caregiver-capacity risks.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 在痴呆居家护理题中，要同时评估两个人：痴呆患者和照护者。正常体征可能降低某一问题的担忧，但不能抵消环境风险或照护能力风险。

glossary.defZh: 根据当地法律和政策，调查并处理易受伤害成人疑似虐待、忽视或剥削的公共系统。
未能满足基本安全或照护需求，可为故意或非故意。
以信任为基础的护患关系，可支持评估、教育和行为改变。

options.en: The home situation is unsalvageable because Diane missed a clinic appointment, so the nurse should recommend immediate removal from the home as the first response.
options.zh: 由于 Diane 错过了门诊复诊，居家照护已无法挽回，因此护士的第一反应应是建议立即离家安置。

options.en: The problem is only medication nonadherence; the nurse should focus on the pill organizer and avoid discussing caregiver stress or home hazards.
options.zh: 问题只是服药不依从；护士应只关注药盒，避免讨论照护者压力或居家危险。

options.en: Because Margaret has no bruises or lacerations, the nurse should reassure Diane that no safety documentation or follow-up is needed.
options.zh: 因为 Margaret 没有瘀斑或裂伤，护士应安慰 Diane 不需要安全记录或跟进。

options.en: The chair barricade and raised voice prove intentional physical abuse, so the nurse should accuse Diane and demand immediate facility placement before completing the assessment.
options.zh: 椅子挡门和提高音量证明存在故意身体虐待，因此护士应指责 Diane，并在完成评估前要求立即机构安置。

options.en: The pattern best supports caregiver role strain with unsafe compensatory strategies; respond nonjudgmentally, correct immediate hazards, document, notify the provider/supervisor or social work, and follow agency/state APS policy if neglect is suspected or safety cannot be maintained.
options.zh: 该模式最支持照护者角色压力并伴有不安全的补偿性做法；应以非评判方式回应，纠正即时危险，记录，通知医师/主管或社工，并在怀疑忽视或无法维持安全时按机构/州政策联系成人保护服务。

byChoice.en: This response matches the total pattern and preserves the therapeutic relationship while still addressing safety and reporting obligations.
byChoice.zh: 该回应符合整体模式，在处理安全和报告责任的同时保持治疗性关系。

byChoice.en: Immediate removal is not the first response when Diane denies intent to harm, is receptive to help, and the hazards are modifiable with urgent support and monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 当 Diane 否认伤害意图、愿意接受帮助，且危险可通过紧急支持和监测来改善时，立即离家安置不是第一反应。

byChoice.en: Medication errors matter, but they are only one part of a larger pattern involving caregiver exhaustion, elopement, stove safety, nutrition, and incontinence.
byChoice.zh: 用药错误很重要，但只是更大问题的一部分，包括照护者疲惫、走失、炉灶安全、营养和失禁。

byChoice.en: Absence of bruising lowers concern for inflicted injury but does not make the home safe or remove documentation and follow-up duties.
byChoice.zh: 没有瘀斑可降低人为外伤的担忧，但不能说明居家环境安全，也不能免除记录和跟进责任。

byChoice.en: The barricade and raised voice are serious cues, but they do not by themselves prove intentional physical abuse; accusing Diane prematurely can damage trust and does not replace safety planning.
byChoice.zh: 挡门和提高音量是严重线索，但不能单独证明故意身体虐待；过早指责 Diane 会破坏信任，也不能替代安全计划。

correct.en: Diane's behavior is unsafe but the overall pattern is most consistent with caregiver role strain: she is exhausted, guilty, tearful, receptive to help, and voluntarily requested support. The nurse should not ignore the hazards or excuse unsafe care; the correct response is nonjudgmental support plus documentation, team notification, safety planning, and policy-guided APS reporting assessment if safety cannot be maintained or neglect is suspected.
correct.zh: Diane 的做法不安全，但整体模式最符合照护者角色压力：她疲惫、内疚、哭泣、愿意接受帮助，并主动请求支持。护士不能忽视危险或纵容不安全照护；正确回应是非评判支持，同时记录、通知团队、制定安全计划，并在无法维持安全或怀疑忽视时按政策评估是否需报告成人保护服务。

stem.en: At Stage 2, which interpretation of the findings and nursing response is most appropriate?
stem.zh: 在第2阶段，哪一种对评估发现的解释和护理回应最合适？

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not classify elder-safety cases from one cue alone. Compare intent, injury pattern, caregiver affect, willingness to accept help, and whether hazards can be modified.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要仅凭单一线索判断老年人安全问题。要比较意图、损伤模式、照护者情绪、接受帮助的意愿，以及危险是否可改变。

glossary.defZh: 如果现在不处理，最可能导致严重伤害的风险。
如门警报等安全设备，可提醒照护者而不限制患者行动。
具有抗胆碱作用的药物累积造成的认知和身体影响。

options.en: Defer environmental changes until the follow-up visit because Margaret is currently calm.
options.zh: 因为 Margaret 目前平静，所以将环境改变推迟到复诊时再处理。

options.en: Focus first on rechecking the blood pressure and teaching Diane to restart the Wednesday pill compartment tomorrow.
options.zh: 首先重新测量血压，并教 Diane 明天重新使用星期三药格。

options.en: Before Diane leaves today, ensure Margaret is not left in an unsafe environment: remove the bedroom-door barricade, use a nonrestrictive door-alert strategy, prevent unsupervised stove access, orient the neighbor to safety monitoring and emergency contacts, and notify the provider about diphenhydramine use.
options.zh: 在 Diane 今天离开前，确保 Margaret 不会被留在不安全环境中：移除卧室挡门，采用非限制性的门警报策略，防止无人看护时接触炉灶，向邻居说明安全看护和紧急联系方式，并通知医师有关苯海拉明使用情况。

options.en: Schedule a caregiver support group before addressing the stove, door, or neighbor supervision plan.
options.zh: 先安排照护者支持小组，再处理炉灶、门或邻居看护计划。

options.en: Prioritize a dietary consult and weekly weights because the albumin and prealbumin are low.
options.zh: 优先安排营养会诊和每周称重，因为白蛋白和前白蛋白偏低。

byChoice.en: Blood pressure and pill-organizer correction are important, but they do not control the immediate environmental threats.
byChoice.zh: 血压和药盒纠正很重要，但不能控制即时环境危险。

byChoice.en: Current calmness does not remove the risk; Margaret already turned on a burner and attempted nighttime elopement.
byChoice.zh: 目前平静并不消除风险；Margaret 已经打开过炉灶，也曾夜间试图离家。

byChoice.en: Support groups help sustainability but do not protect Margaret during today's period of supervision by the neighbor.
byChoice.zh: 支持小组有助于长期维持，但不能保护 Margaret 今天由邻居看护期间的安全。

byChoice.en: This option addresses the immediate elopement, fire/burn, temporary supervision, and medication-related confusion risks before Diane leaves.
byChoice.zh: 该选项在 Diane 离开前处理走失、火灾/烧伤、临时看护和药物相关混乱等即时风险。

byChoice.en: Nutritional decline needs follow-up, but it is less immediate than a client turning on burners or leaving the house unsafely.
byChoice.zh: 营养下降需要跟进，但不如患者打开炉灶或不安全离家那样紧迫。

correct.en: The immediate threat is that Margaret may be left with uncontrolled elopement and stove hazards while Diane returns to work. The nurse must replace the unsafe barricade with a nonrestrictive alert strategy, control stove access, orient the temporary caregiver, and contact the provider about diphenhydramine because it worsens confusion and compounds fall and wandering risk. Nutrition, BP, and caregiver support are important but not the most immediate life-safety threats before Diane leaves.
correct.zh: 即时威胁是 Diane 回去上班后，Margaret 可能面临未控制的走失和炉灶危险。护士必须用非限制性警报策略替代不安全挡门，控制炉灶接触，指导临时照护者，并就苯海拉明联系医师，因为它会加重意识混乱并增加跌倒和走失风险。营养、血压和照护者支持都重要，但不是 Diane 离开前最紧迫的生命安全威胁。

stem.en: After the Stage 2 disclosures, which priority should the nurse address before leaving the home today?
stem.zh: 在第2阶段补充信息后，护士今天离开该家庭前应优先处理什么？

testTakingStrategy.en: When several problems are real, choose the action that prevents the most immediate serious harm before the next handoff or period of reduced supervision.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当多个问题都真实存在时，选择能在下一次交接或看护减少前防止最即时严重伤害的行动。

glossary.defZh: 通过正式或非正式照护支持，为主要照护者提供暂时休息。
在失禁发生前按计划提醒并协助如厕。
在白天提供看护、活动和支持的社区项目。

options.en: Contact the provider and pharmacist about medication formulations and diphenhydramine use; set up alarms, a written schedule, and a clarified pill-organizer routine.
options.zh: 就药物剂型和苯海拉明使用联系医师及药师；设置提醒、书面时间表，并明确药盒流程。

options.en: Remove the bedroom-door barricade and use door alarms or contact sensors on exterior doors; consider medical identification and a local wandering-response program.
options.zh: 移除卧室挡门，在外门使用门警报或门磁感应器；考虑医疗识别饰品和当地走失应对项目。

options.en: Continue diphenhydramine at a lower dose and keep the chair barricade until Margaret stops wandering.
options.zh: 继续较低剂量苯海拉明，并保留椅子挡门，直到 Margaret 停止走失。

options.en: Remove throw rugs, lock cleaning supplies, maintain lighting, and coordinate physical therapy for gait and fall-risk assessment.
options.zh: 移除小地毯，锁好清洁用品，保持照明，并协调物理治疗评估步态和跌倒风险。

options.en: Prevent unsupervised stove use by using knob covers, removing knobs, or disconnecting the stove when not supervised.
options.zh: 通过旋钮保护盖、取下旋钮，或在无人看护时断开炉灶，防止无人看护使用炉灶。

options.en: Address nutrition, incontinence, and caregiver support with dietitian referral, preferred small frequent meals, prompted toileting, moisture barrier, social work, Area Agency on Aging, adult day program, caregiver support group, and Diane's own primary-care visit.
options.zh: 通过营养师转介、少量多餐且选择偏好食物、定时提醒如厕、皮肤屏障霜、社工、老龄事务机构、成人日间照护、照护者支持小组以及 Diane 自己的初级保健就诊，处理营养、失禁和照护者支持。

byChoice.en: Diphenhydramine can worsen confusion and falls in older adults with dementia, and a chair barricade is an unsafe restriction rather than a safe wandering strategy.
byChoice.zh: 苯海拉明可加重老年痴呆患者的混乱和跌倒风险，而椅子挡门是不安全限制，不是安全的走失管理策略。

byChoice.en: Medication errors and OTC diphenhydramine use require provider/pharmacist involvement and a simpler routine.
byChoice.zh: 用药错误和非处方苯海拉明使用需要医师/药师介入，并建立更简单的流程。

byChoice.en: Stove control is necessary because Margaret has already turned on a burner without safe supervision.
byChoice.zh: 必须控制炉灶，因为 Margaret 已经在缺乏安全看护时打开过炉灶。

byChoice.en: Door alarms reduce elopement risk without confining Margaret behind a barricade.
byChoice.zh: 门警报可降低走失风险，同时避免用挡门限制 Margaret。

byChoice.en: Nutrition, skin protection, incontinence management, respite, and caregiver health are all required for a sustainable home plan.
byChoice.zh: 营养、皮肤保护、失禁管理、喘息服务和照护者健康都是可持续居家计划所必需的。

byChoice.en: Fall and poisoning hazards are modifiable environmental risks in this home.
byChoice.zh: 跌倒和中毒危险是该家庭中可改变的环境风险。

correct.en: The plan must address both sides of the dyad: Margaret's safety risks and Diane's ability to continue caregiving. Appropriate interventions include nonrestrictive wandering alerts, stove control, fall and hazardous-material prevention, medication-formulation and reminder support, provider notification about diphenhydramine, nutrition and incontinence support, respite/adult day resources, social work, caregiver support, and Diane's own health care.
correct.zh: 计划必须同时处理照护关系中的两方面：Margaret 的安全风险和 Diane 持续照护的能力。合适干预包括非限制性走失警报、炉灶控制、跌倒和危险物预防、药物剂型与提醒支持、向医师报告苯海拉明、营养和失禁支持、喘息服务/成人日间照护资源、社工、照护者支持以及 Diane 自身就医。

stem.en: Which interventions should the nurse include in the Stage 2 home-safety and caregiver-support plan? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 护士应将哪些干预纳入第2阶段的居家安全和照护者支持计划？选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: For SATA care-plan items, select interventions that are specific, actionable, and tied to a cue. Avoid vague advice or actions that continue the unsafe workaround.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 在多选护理计划题中，选择具体、可执行且与线索相对应的干预。避免模糊建议或延续不安全权宜做法的行动。

glossary.defZh: 承认对方的感受真实且可以理解。
用不现实的安慰话语淡化对方担忧。
通过沟通和环境措施降低激动或冲突。

options.en: Immediately list every community resource and safety modification without first responding to Diane's statement that she is failing.
options.zh: 不先回应 Diane 说自己失败了，而是立即列出所有社区资源和安全改造。

options.en: After confirming Margaret is away from the stove, say: 'This is incredibly hard, and I can see how exhausted you are. Asking for help does not mean you are failing her. Let's take this one step at a time together.'
options.zh: 确认 Margaret 已远离炉灶后说：‘这真的非常不容易，我看得出你已经很疲惫。寻求帮助并不表示你辜负了她。我们一起一步一步来。’

options.en: Tell Diane to leave the room so the nurse can correct Margaret's behavior without family interference.
options.zh: 告诉 Diane 离开房间，让护士在没有家属干扰的情况下纠正 Margaret 的行为。

options.en: Say: 'You are doing a great job, and everything will get easier once she settles down.'
options.zh: 说：‘你做得很好，等她安定下来一切都会变容易。’

options.en: Say: 'You cannot raise your voice at a person with dementia; if you keep doing that, I will have to report you.'
options.zh: 说：‘你不能对痴呆患者提高音量；如果你继续这样，我就必须举报你。’

byChoice.en: Resources are needed later, but immediately listing them bypasses Diane's emotional statement.
byChoice.zh: 之后确实需要资源，但立即罗列资源会绕过 Diane 的情绪表达。

byChoice.en: Removing Diane from the interaction frames her as interference rather than a distressed caregiver who needs support and coaching.
byChoice.zh: 让 Diane 离开会把她视为干扰者，而不是需要支持和指导的痛苦照护者。

byChoice.en: This validates the caregiver's distress and reframes help-seeking as appropriate, not failure.
byChoice.zh: 该回应接纳照护者的痛苦，并将寻求帮助重新定义为合适行为，而不是失败。

byChoice.en: This is false reassurance because the situation is not safe or easy, and it dismisses Diane's real distress.
byChoice.zh: 这是虚假安慰，因为情况并不安全也不容易，并且忽视了 Diane 的真实痛苦。

byChoice.en: This is judgmental and threatening; it may shut down disclosure and does not first establish trust.
byChoice.zh: 这带有评判和威胁，可能使对方停止透露信息，也没有先建立信任。

correct.en: The nurse first ensures immediate safety, then validates Diane's exhaustion and guilt without judgment. This builds trust and opens the door to later education and safety planning. Lecturing, threatening, false reassurance, premature resource-listing, or excluding Diane bypasses the emotional cue and can reduce engagement.
correct.zh: 护士首先确保即时安全，然后以非评判方式接纳 Diane 的疲惫和内疚。这能建立信任，为之后教育和安全计划打基础。说教、威胁、虚假安慰、过早罗列资源或排除 Diane 都会绕过情绪线索，并可能降低参与度。

stem.en: During Stage 1, after Margaret is safely away from the stove and Diane says, 'I can't do this anymore. I'm failing her,' which nurse response is most therapeutic?
stem.zh: 第1阶段，当 Margaret 已安全远离炉灶，而 Diane 说‘我撑不下去了，我辜负了她’时，护士哪种回应最具治疗性？

testTakingStrategy.en: In therapeutic communication, answer the feeling before the fact list. Validate distress, avoid false reassurance, and preserve safety.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 治疗性沟通题中，先回应情绪，再处理事实清单。要接纳痛苦、避免虚假安慰，并维持安全。

glossary.defZh: 判断干预是否产生预期改变。
护理计划是否能在现实中长期维持。
用于判断是否需要升级处理的具体可测量改变。

columns.en: Monitor, but not decisive over this short interval
columns.zh: 需监测，但短期内不具决定性

rows.en: Diane removed the chair from the bedroom door and installed a front-door alarm.
rows.zh: Diane 移除了卧室门上的椅子，并安装了前门警报器。

rows.en: Margaret has received medications daily with a phone alarm, amlodipine liquid, and pharmacist-confirmed crushed lisinopril.
rows.zh: 通过手机提醒、氨氯地平液体剂型和药师确认可压碎的赖诺普利，Margaret 已每日服药。

rows.en: Diphenhydramine was stopped, and Diane reports less morning confusion on nights Margaret slept through.
rows.zh: 苯海拉明已停用；Diane 报告 Margaret 睡整夜后的早晨混乱减少。

rows.en: Diane contacted the Area Agency on Aging, attended an online caregiver support group, and made her own primary-care appointment.
rows.zh: Diane 联系了老龄事务机构，参加了一次线上照护者支持小组，并预约了自己的初级保健。

rows.en: The stove remains unsecured.
rows.zh: 炉灶仍未防护。

rows.en: Throw rugs remain in place and cleaning supplies are still unlocked.
rows.zh: 小地毯仍在原处，清洁用品仍未上锁。

rows.en: Margaret is not yet enrolled in the adult day program, and Diane remains the only reliable daily caregiver.
rows.zh: Margaret 尚未报名成人日间照护，Diane 仍是唯一可靠的日常照护者。

rows.en: Margaret's weight is 57.6 kg, down 0.4 kg from five days ago.
rows.zh: Margaret 体重57.6 kg，比5天前下降0.4 kg。

rows.en: SpO₂ is 98% on room air.
rows.zh: 室内空气下SpO₂为98%。

byChoice.en: This is a positive outcome because it replaces a restrictive unsafe workaround with a safer alert strategy.
byChoice.zh: 这是积极结果，因为它用更安全的警报策略替代了限制性的不安全权宜做法。

byChoice.en: A simpler medication system improves reliability compared with the wrong-day organizer pattern.
byChoice.zh: 与日期混乱的药盒相比，更简单的用药系统提高了可靠性。

byChoice.en: Stopping the anticholinergic medication is a positive safety step, with early symptom improvement reported.
byChoice.zh: 停用抗胆碱药物是积极的安全措施，并已有早期症状改善报告。

byChoice.en: These actions show engagement with support resources and attention to caregiver health.
byChoice.zh: 这些行动显示她开始参与支持资源，并关注照护者自身健康。

byChoice.en: Unsecured stove access is a remaining immediate safety hazard.
byChoice.zh: 炉灶未防护仍是即时安全危险。

byChoice.en: Fall and hazardous-material risks remain uncorrected.
byChoice.zh: 跌倒和危险物风险仍未纠正。

byChoice.en: Without respite or formal daytime support, caregiver sustainability remains fragile.
byChoice.zh: 没有喘息服务或正式日间支持，照护可持续性仍然脆弱。

byChoice.en: This is concerning in context but too short a trend to interpret definitively; nutrition and weight need continued monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 结合背景这令人担忧，但5天趋势太短，不能定论；仍需持续监测营养和体重。

byChoice.en: Normal oxygen saturation is not a meaningful short-interval outcome for this caregiver-safety plan.
byChoice.zh: 氧饱和度正常不是评估本照护者安全计划的有意义短期结局。

correct.en: The plan is improving but not adequate yet. Door alarm use, medication reliability, stopping diphenhydramine, and caregiver engagement are positive. The unsecured stove, throw rugs, unlocked cleaning supplies, absent adult-day enrollment, and continued reliance on Diane alone remain safety and sustainability gaps. A 0.4 kg five-day weight drop and normal oxygen saturation should be interpreted cautiously rather than used to declare the plan safe or unsafe by themselves.
correct.zh: 计划正在改善，但尚不足够。门警报、用药更可靠、停用苯海拉明和照护者参与资源是积极信号。炉灶未防护、小地毯、清洁用品未上锁、未报名成人日间照护以及仍主要依赖 Diane 一人，仍是安全和可持续性缺口。5天内体重下降0.4 kg和氧饱和度正常都应谨慎解释，不能单独用来判定计划安全或不安全。

stem.en: At the Stage 3 follow-up, classify each finding as evidence of improvement, a remaining gap requiring follow-up, or a finding that should be monitored but is not decisive over this short interval.
stem.zh: 在第3阶段复诊时，将每项发现分类为改善证据、仍需跟进的缺口，或需要监测但在短期内不能作为决定性依据的发现。

testTakingStrategy.en: Outcome evaluation often asks for trajectory, not perfection. Credit partial progress while still identifying uncorrected high-risk gaps.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 结局评价常考趋势，而不是完美达标。要承认部分进展，同时识别尚未纠正的高风险缺口。

content.en: While the nurse assesses the home, Margaret stands without warning, walks toward the kitchen, and turns on a stove burner. Diane rushes to turn it off and says Margaret thinks she is making coffee; last week Margaret left a burner on for 20 minutes before Diane noticed. Margaret becomes mildly agitated when redirected, pulls her arm from Diane's grasp, and says loudly, 'Don't touch me! I want my coffee!' Diane raises her voice: 'Mom, stop it! You can't use the stove!' Margaret paces, wrings her hands, and repeats, 'Where is Frank? I want Frank.' Diane sits at the kitchen table, puts her head in her hands, and says quietly, 'I can't do this anymore. I'm failing her.' Diane does not strike, shove, or physically restrain Margaret; her frustration is verbal and self-directed. Margaret's vital signs during agitation are HR 92, BP 156/94, RR 20. She calms after about 10 minutes when the nurse offers decaffeinated tea and speaks slowly and calmly. After calming: HR 78, BP 144/86, RR 16.
content.zh: 护士评估家庭环境时，Margaret 突然站起，走向厨房并打开炉灶。Diane 赶紧关掉炉灶，并说 Margaret 以为自己在煮咖啡；上周 Margaret 曾把炉灶开着20分钟，Diane 才发现。被转移注意时，Margaret 轻度激动，把手从 Diane 手中抽出，大声说：‘别碰我！我要咖啡！’Diane 提高音量：‘妈，停下！你不能用炉灶！’Margaret 来回踱步、绞手，并重复：‘Frank 在哪？我要 Frank。’Diane 坐在厨房桌旁，双手抱头，低声说：‘我撑不下去了。我辜负了她。’Diane 没有打、推或身体限制 Margaret；她的挫败表现为言语和自责。Margaret 激动时生命体征为HR 92、BP 156/94、RR 20。护士提供无咖啡因茶，并用缓慢平静语气陪伴后，约10分钟后 Margaret 平静。平静后：HR 78、BP 144/86、RR 16。

title.zh: 激动 episode 与照护者反应

content.en: With Margaret calm and seated, the nurse speaks privately with Diane. Diane reports crushing Margaret's amlodipine and lisinopril tablets into applesauce because Margaret spits out pills; Diane is unsure whether Margaret swallows all the applesauce. She estimates Margaret receives most medications most days but missed them entirely 2 days last week because Diane overslept. Margaret fell in the bathroom 3 days ago, with no visible injury; Diane helped her up but did not report the fall because she feared being judged. Diane's brother recently told her she 'just needs to try harder.' The nurse confirms today's Tuesday medication compartment is still full and Wednesday's compartment is empty. Diane says she must have mixed up the days and cannot keep track anymore. Diane has also been giving diphenhydramine 25 mg at bedtime for 3 weeks to help Margaret sleep; it worked at first but now Margaret seems more confused in the morning.
content.zh: Margaret 平静坐下后，护士与 Diane 私下交谈。Diane 报告因 Margaret 会吐出药片，她把 Margaret 的氨氯地平和赖诺普利压碎混入苹果泥；但她不确定 Margaret 是否吃完所有苹果泥。她估计 Margaret 大多数天能吃到大多数药，但上周有2天因为 Diane 睡过头而完全漏服。3天前 Margaret 在浴室跌倒，没有可见外伤；Diane 扶她起来但没有报告，因为害怕被评判。Diane 的哥哥最近说她‘只需要再努力一点’。护士确认今天星期二的药格仍满，星期三药格为空。Diane 说自己一定把日期弄混了，已经无法跟上。Diane 还连续3周在睡前给 Margaret 苯海拉明25 mg帮助睡眠；最初有效，但现在 Margaret 早晨似乎更混乱。

title.zh: 照护者私下补充信息

title.en: Stage 2 — Later the same visit, 11:30 AM-noon

content.en:
Since the first visit, the nurse coordinated a social-work referral, gave Diane Area Agency on Aging and caregiver support group contact information, and contacted the primary care provider about diphenhydramine use, the unreported fall, medication difficulties, weight loss, and BP readings. The provider discontinued diphenhydramine, ordered a pharmacy consultation for alternative formulations, referred Margaret to physical therapy for fall-risk assessment, and referred her to a dietitian.

Diane called the Area Agency on Aging and learned about an adult day program 3 miles away that operates Monday-Friday, 8 AM-4 PM. She is thinking about enrollment. She attended one online caregiver support group and felt less alone. She removed the chair from the bedroom door and installed a front-door alarm that chimes when the door opens. She has not addressed the stove, throw rugs, or unlocked cleaning supplies. Margaret's medications have been given daily with a phone alarm. The pharmacy delivered amlodipine oral liquid, which Margaret accepts in juice. Lisinopril is still crushed in applesauce after pharmacist confirmation that the tablet is crushable.

Margaret appears slightly more alert. Diane reports Margaret slept through the night twice in 5 days since diphenhydramine stopped, with less morning confusion on those days. Urinary incontinence continues 2-3 times daily. Meal intake over the past 2 days is about 50%, improved from the prior 25%-30% estimate. Weight is 57.6 kg, down 0.4 kg from 5 days ago; this trend is too short to interpret definitively. Vitals: T 98.4 °F (36.9 °C), HR 74, BP 138/82, RR 16, SpO₂ 98%. Perineal erythema is unchanged. No new falls. Margaret tried to open the front door once at night; the alarm woke Diane, who redirected her without incident. Diane reports some sleep improvement, fewer headaches, and a primary-care appointment next week, but still has no formal respite in place.
content.zh:
自第一次访视后，护士协调社工转介，提供老龄事务机构和照护者支持小组联系方式，并就苯海拉明使用、未报告跌倒、用药困难、体重下降和血压读数联系初级保健医生。医生停用了苯海拉明，开出药师会诊以寻找替代剂型，转介物理治疗评估跌倒风险，并转介营养师。

Diane 联系了老龄事务机构，得知距家3英里的成人日间照护项目，周一至周五8:00–16:00开放。她正在考虑报名。她参加了一次线上照护者支持小组，感觉不那么孤单。她移除了卧室门口的椅子，并安装了前门警报器，门打开时会响。她尚未处理炉灶、小地毯或未上锁清洁用品。Margaret 通过手机提醒已每日服药。药房送来了氨氯地平口服液，Margaret 可用果汁服用。经药师确认赖诺普利片可压碎后，仍压碎混入苹果泥。

Margaret 看起来稍微更清醒。Diane 报告自停用苯海拉明后的5天中，Margaret 有2晚睡整夜，且这些天早晨混乱减少。尿失禁仍每天2–3次。过去2天进食约50%，比之前估计的25%–30%有所改善。体重57.6 kg，比5天前下降0.4 kg；该趋势太短，不能定论。生命体征：T 98.4 °F (36.9 °C)，HR 74，BP 138/82，RR 16，SpO₂ 98%。会阴发红未变。无新跌倒。Margaret 夜间曾试图打开前门一次；警报叫醒 Diane，Diane 将她重新引导回床，无意外。Diane 报告睡眠有所改善、头痛减少，并已预约下周初级保健，但尚未落实正式喘息服务。

title.zh: 复诊结果

title.en: Stage 3 — Follow-up home visit, five days later
title.zh: 第3阶段——5天后居家复诊

summary.en: Margaret Tierney is a 78-year-old woman with moderate Alzheimer's dementia who lives with her daughter Diane, her sole caregiver. Diane requested home-health support after two months of worsening nighttime wandering and confusion, stating she cannot continue alone. The case unfolds across an initial home visit, later same-visit disclosures, and a five-day follow-up.
summary.zh: Margaret Tierney，78岁，中度阿尔茨海默病，与女儿 Diane 同住；Diane 是唯一照护者。因过去两个月夜间走失和意识混乱加重，Diane 请求居家护理支持，并表示自己无法再独自承担。病例按初次居家访视、同次访视后续透露信息和5天后复诊逐步展开。

title.en: Caregiver role strain in home management of moderate Alzheimer's dementia
title.zh: 中度阿尔茨海默病居家照护中的照护者角色压力

glossary.defZh: 一种进行性神经认知障碍，会损害记忆、判断、沟通和功能。
照护需求超过资源时导致的痛苦和功能受损。
痴呆患者无目的或不安全走动，可导致走失或受伤。
为照护者提供暂时休息，以帮助维持居家照护。

correct.en: This case centers on caregiver role strain affecting home safety for a client with moderate dementia. Margaret has cognitive impairment, wandering, unsafe stove use, nutrition and hydration concerns, incontinence-related skin risk, fall risk, and unreliable medication administration. Diane shows sleep deprivation, weight loss, work impairment, tremor, guilt, and unsafe coping strategies. The nurse's role is to preserve trust, mitigate immediate hazards, coordinate provider/pharmacy/social-work/community resources, avoid premature accusation of intentional abuse while still documenting and following reporting policy, and evaluate whether safety and caregiver capacity are improving over time.
correct.zh: 本病例核心是照护者角色压力影响中度痴呆患者的居家安全。Margaret 有认知受损、走失、炉灶不安全使用、营养和液体摄入担忧、失禁相关皮肤风险、跌倒风险和用药不可靠。Diane 表现出睡眠剥夺、体重下降、工作受影响、手颤、内疚和不安全应对策略。护士的作用是维护信任、减轻即时危险、协调医师/药师/社工/社区资源，避免过早指控故意虐待，同时仍需记录并按政策处理报告问题，并持续评价安全与照护者能力是否改善。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

testTakingStrategy.en: Track the unfolding data by stage. Early questions focus on cue recognition and therapeutic response; later questions add medication, fall, and safety disclosures; follow-up questions test whether partial improvement is enough.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 按阶段追踪逐步出现的信息。早期题关注线索识别和治疗性回应；后续题加入用药、跌倒和安全补充信息；复诊题考查部分改善是否足够。

content.en:
Standing rules at each doorway and reviewed at shift huddle:
1. Alcohol-based hand rub (ABHR) is the default hand-hygiene method except when hands are visibly soiled or the client has a known or suspected spore-forming organism; then soap and water is required.
2. Dedicated or single-use equipment is required for clients on contact precautions. If a device must be shared, clean visible soil, disinfect with an appropriate agent, and allow the manufacturer-specified wet-contact time before the device enters the next room.
3. PPE is donned outside the room and doffed inside the room, gloves first and then gown, before exiting; perform hand hygiene immediately after removal.
4. Visitors are offered a precautions orientation at the first visit of each shift, including hand hygiene and required PPE.
5. Soiled linen from any isolation room is placed in a water-soluble inner bag and then into a labeled outer bag at the point of use.
content.zh:
各病房门口张贴并在交班小会上复习的常规制度：
1. 酒精类手消毒剂（ABHR）为默认手卫生方式；但手部明显污染或患者有已知/疑似产孢子病原体时，必须使用肥皂和清水洗手。
2. 接触隔离患者需使用专用或一次性设备。如设备必须共用，应先清除可见污物，再用合适消毒剂消毒，并达到厂家规定的湿接触时间后，才能进入下一间病房。
3. PPE 在病房外穿戴；离开前在病房内脱除，先脱手套再脱隔离衣；脱除后立即进行手卫生。
4. 探视者在每个班次首次探视时接受隔离预防指导，包括手卫生和所需 PPE。
5. 任何隔离病房的污染布草应在使用地点先放入水溶性内袋，再放入有标识的外袋。

title.zh: 病区感染预防制度

content.en:
Client A, Room 12: 71-year-old post-op day 2 after right hemicolectomy. Six watery stools overnight; stool PCR positive for Clostridioides difficile at 0545. Contact precautions. Dedicated thermometer and blood-pressure cuff are in the room. Last void 7 hours ago; bladder scan ordered.
Client B, Room 14: 58-year-old with community-acquired pneumonia on standard precautions only. Oxygen by nasal cannula at 3 L/min; SpO2 93-94%. Suprapubic fullness; bladder scan ordered after Client A.
Client C, Room 16: 44-year-old with a large stage 3 sacral pressure injury, culture-positive for MRSA, open and draining through the dressing. Contact precautions. Dedicated stethoscope and blood-pressure cuff are in the room. Daughter has been helping reposition him.
Client D, Room 18: 29-year-old with confirmed pulmonary TB, sputum AFB smear positive, in a negative-pressure AIIR with green indicator light. Airborne plus standard precautions. Mother is at bedside.
content.zh:
A 患者，12房：71岁，右半结肠切除术后第2天。夜间水样便6次；0545 粪便 PCR 艰难梭菌阳性。执行接触隔离。房内有专用体温计和血压袖带。7小时未排尿，已医嘱膀胱扫描。
B 患者，14房：58岁，社区获得性肺炎，仅执行标准预防。鼻导管吸氧 3 L/min，SpO2 93–94%。诉耻骨上胀满；计划在 A 患者之后进行膀胱扫描。
C 患者，16房：44岁，骶尾部大型 3期压力性损伤，培养 MRSA 阳性，伤口开放且敷料有引流渗出。执行接触隔离。房内有专用听诊器和血压袖带。女儿一直协助翻身。
D 患者，18房：29岁，确诊肺结核，痰 AFB 涂片阳性，住在负压 AIIR，指示灯为绿色。执行空气传播隔离加标准预防。母亲在床旁。

title.zh: 0700 分配患者及初始概况

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 用于可通过直接或间接接触传播的病原体的隔离措施，通常包括隔离衣和手套。
只用于同一名患者或同一隔离房间的设备，不在患者之间交叉使用。
被病原体污染、可间接传播感染的物体表面。

rows.en: Entering the contact-precautions room wearing gloves but no gown
rows.zh: 进入接触隔离病房时只戴手套、未穿隔离衣

rows.en: Using the blood-pressure cuff dedicated to Room 12
rows.zh: 使用12房专用的血压袖带

rows.en: Removing gloves and failing to perform hand hygiene immediately afterward
rows.zh: 脱下手套后未立即进行手卫生

rows.en: Touching the door handle with bare, unwashed hands after client contact
rows.zh: 接触患者后用未清洁的裸手触碰门把手

byChoice.en: This is a breach because clothing can be contaminated during contact-precautions care; gloves alone are not enough.
byChoice.zh: 这是违规，因为接触隔离照护中衣物可能被污染；仅戴手套不够。

byChoice.en: This is not a breach because the cuff is dedicated to Client A's room and is not being moved to another client.
byChoice.zh: 这不是违规，因为该袖带专用于 A 患者房间，并未拿给其他患者使用。

byChoice.en: This is a breach because organisms can be transferred during glove removal; hand hygiene must immediately follow doffing.
byChoice.zh: 这是违规，因为脱手套时病原体可能转移到手上；脱除后必须立即手卫生。

byChoice.en: This is a breach because the door handle becomes a fomite that others may touch after care of a CDI client.
byChoice.zh: 这是违规，因为在照护 CDI 患者后，门把手会成为其他人可能接触的污染媒介。

correct.en: Contact precautions require gown and gloves before room entry. The dedicated cuff belongs in Room 12 and is appropriate to use. The major failures are missing the gown, missing immediate hand hygiene after glove removal, and touching a shared surface with contaminated bare hands; in a C. difficile room, the required hand-hygiene method is soap and water.
correct.zh: 接触隔离要求进入病房前穿隔离衣并戴手套。12房专用血压袖带可在该房内使用。主要问题是未穿隔离衣、脱手套后未立即手卫生，以及用污染的裸手触碰共用表面；在艰难梭菌病房，所需手卫生方式为肥皂和清水洗手。

stem.en: Stage 1: Classify each nursing-student behavior in Client A's Clostridioides difficile room.
stem.zh: 阶段1：请判断护生在 A 患者艰难梭菌病房中的每项行为。

testTakingStrategy.en: Separate true breaches from correct dedicated-equipment use. For contact precautions, ask: Was full PPE used, was hand hygiene done after doffing, and were shared surfaces protected?
testTakingStrategy.zh: 把真正的违规与正确使用专用设备区分开。遇到接触隔离题，追问：是否使用了完整 PPE、脱除后是否手卫生、是否保护了共用表面。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 消毒剂按标签要求保持表面湿润并持续接触的时间。
可灭活或杀灭细菌孢子的消毒产品。
以酒精为主要成分的免洗手卫生产品。

options.en: Perform hand hygiene with soap and water immediately after doffing.
options.zh: 脱除 PPE 后立即用肥皂和清水进行手卫生。

options.en: Doff gloves first and then gown inside Room 12 before exiting.
options.zh: 离开前在12房内先脱手套，再脱隔离衣。

options.en: Clean any visible soil from the scanner surfaces while still in Room 12 and wearing PPE.
options.zh: 仍在12房且穿戴 PPE 时，先清除扫描仪表面的可见污物。

options.en: Disinfect the probe, cord, screen or controls, handle, and touched surfaces with an EPA-registered sporicidal disinfectant effective against C. difficile, keeping surfaces wet for the label contact time.
options.zh: 使用对艰难梭菌有效的 EPA 注册杀孢子消毒剂，消毒探头、导线、屏幕或控制面板、把手及所有接触表面，并保持标签规定的湿接触时间。

options.en: Transport the disinfected scanner to Client B's room with clean hands.
options.zh: 用清洁的手将已消毒的扫描仪带到 B 患者房间。

byChoice.en: Soap and water are required after CDI care because the case policy treats spore-forming organisms differently from routine hand hygiene.
byChoice.zh: CDI 照护后必须用肥皂和清水洗手，因为本病例制度对产孢子病原体不同于常规手卫生。

byChoice.en: PPE is removed inside the room so contaminated gown and gloves are not carried into the hallway.
byChoice.zh: PPE 应在房内脱除，避免把污染的隔离衣和手套带到走廊。

byChoice.en: Only after cleaning, disinfection, doffing, and hand hygiene should the clean scanner enter Client B's room.
byChoice.zh: 只有完成清洁、消毒、脱除 PPE 和手卫生后，清洁的扫描仪才能进入 B 患者房间。

byChoice.en: Visible soil must be removed first; disinfectants may not work reliably on uncleaned organic material.
byChoice.zh: 必须先清除可见污物；消毒剂在未清洁的有机物表面可能无法可靠发挥作用。

byChoice.en: CDI requires a sporicidal disinfectant and full contact time; a quick alcohol wipe or ABHR is not sufficient for spores.
byChoice.zh: CDI 需要杀孢子消毒剂和完整接触时间；快速酒精擦拭或 ABHR 不能充分处理孢子。

correct.en: Because the scanner was used in a CDI contact-precautions room and must be shared with a standard-precautions client, it must be cleaned, disinfected with a sporicidal product, and allowed full wet-contact time before moving to the next room. Doffing and soap-and-water hand hygiene after the device is disinfected prevent the nurse from recontaminating it during transport.
correct.zh: 由于扫描仪先在 CDI 接触隔离病房使用，之后要给仅标准预防的患者使用，因此必须先清洁、使用杀孢子产品消毒，并达到完整湿接触时间后才能进入下一病房。设备消毒后再脱除 PPE，并用肥皂和清水洗手，可避免转运时再次污染设备。

stem.en: Stage 1: Put the steps in the correct order for handling the portable bladder scanner after use on Client A before taking it to Client B.
stem.zh: 阶段1：将为 A 患者使用便携式膀胱扫描仪后、带去 B 患者房间前的处理步骤按正确顺序排列。

testTakingStrategy.en: For shared equipment, think from dirty to clean: remove soil, disinfect with the organism-specific product and contact time, remove contaminated PPE, clean hands, then move the equipment.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 处理共用设备时按“由脏到净”思考：清除污物，使用针对病原体的消毒剂并达到接触时间，脱除污染 PPE，清洁双手，然后再移动设备。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 对甲氧西林等多种抗菌药物耐药的金黄色葡萄球菌。
glossary.termZh: 耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌

glossary.defZh: 由学习者实际演示所学技能，以确认理解和操作正确。
按安全顺序穿上和脱下 PPE 的过程。

options.en: Show her where PPE is located and ask for a return demonstration of donning, doffing, and hand hygiene.
options.zh: 告诉她 PPE 放置位置，并请她回示穿戴、脱除和手卫生。

options.en: Tell her not to touch or reposition her father until the wound has healed.
options.zh: 告诉她在伤口愈合前不要触碰或协助父亲翻身。

options.en: Explain that the draining MRSA wound can spread organisms by direct contact with hands, clothing, or linens.
options.zh: 解释有引流的 MRSA 伤口可通过手、衣物或床单等直接接触传播病原体。

options.en: Acknowledge that she was not previously oriented and thank her for helping with care.
options.zh: 承认她先前未被指导，并感谢她协助照护。

options.en: Give her a surgical mask as the main protection for MRSA contact precautions.
options.zh: 给她外科口罩作为 MRSA 接触隔离的主要防护。

options.en: Teach that gown and gloves are required for room entry and direct contact with the client or bed linens.
options.zh: 告知进入病房以及直接接触患者或床单时需要穿隔离衣并戴手套。

byChoice.en: This gives the reason for precautions and links the open draining wound to contact transmission.
byChoice.zh: 这说明采取隔离措施的原因，并将开放引流伤口与接触传播联系起来。

byChoice.en: This matches contact-precautions PPE for direct contact with the client and contaminated linens.
byChoice.zh: 这符合直接接触患者和污染床单时的接触隔离 PPE 要求。

byChoice.en: A surgical mask is not the main intervention for MRSA contact precautions; gown, gloves, and hand hygiene are.
byChoice.zh: 外科口罩不是 MRSA 接触隔离的主要措施；主要措施是隔离衣、手套和手卫生。

byChoice.en: This is unnecessarily restrictive; the safer plan is to teach her how to help while wearing PPE.
byChoice.zh: 这过度限制；更安全的做法是教她在穿戴 PPE 的情况下继续协助。

byChoice.en: Return demonstration verifies that teaching changed the visitor's behavior, not just her verbal understanding.
byChoice.zh: 回示可确认教学转化为行为改变，而不仅是口头理解。

byChoice.en: This supports adherence by correcting a system gap without blaming the visitor.
byChoice.zh: 这样可在不责备探视者的情况下纠正系统性遗漏，促进依从性。

correct.en: The daughter can remain involved in care, but she needs nonjudgmental teaching, clear explanation of contact spread, gown and glove use, and return demonstration. MRSA is spread mainly by contact in this scenario, so gown, gloves, and hand hygiene are the priority, not a surgical mask.
correct.zh: 女儿可以继续参与照护，但需要非评判式指导、清楚解释接触传播、使用隔离衣和手套，并进行回示。本情境中 MRSA 主要通过接触传播，因此重点是隔离衣、手套和手卫生，而不是外科口罩。

stem.en: Stage 1: Which nursing actions are appropriate when teaching Client C's daughter about MRSA contact precautions? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 阶段1：护士教育 C 患者女儿有关 MRSA 接触隔离时，哪些措施合适？选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a visitor makes an isolation error, choose teaching that preserves safe family involvement and verifies the behavior with return demonstration.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 探视者出现隔离错误时，选择既能保留安全家庭参与、又能通过回示确认行为的教学措施。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 存放或准备清洁医疗用品的区域，应避免被污染设备进入。
病原体从一个患者、物品或环境转移到另一个患者或区域。
病原体从来源到易感者的传播路线。

options.en: The nursing student's contaminated bare-hand contact with the Room 12 door handle
options.zh: 护生用污染裸手触碰12房门把手

options.en: The standard linen bag used for Client A's soiled linens
options.zh: A 患者污染布草被放入普通布草袋

options.en: Client B's wife stopping at the open doorway of Room 12 to ask a question
options.zh: B 患者妻子停在12房开着的门口询问问题

options.en: Client C's dedicated stethoscope placed on the clean-utility-room counter near the clean supply cart
options.zh: C 患者专用听诊器被放在清洁用物间柜台上，靠近清洁物品车

byChoice.en: The wife needs reassurance and hand-hygiene teaching, but merely stopping at the doorway is not the highest-risk breach described.
byChoice.zh: 妻子需要安抚和手卫生教育，但仅停在门口不是本题描述的最高风险漏洞。

byChoice.en: The contaminated door handle is serious but is one high-touch surface at one doorway and can be addressed with targeted disinfection.
byChoice.zh: 污染门把手很严重，但它是单一门口的一个高频接触表面，可通过定点消毒处理。

byChoice.en: The linen-bagging error matters, especially for CDI, but it primarily creates downstream laundry-handling risk rather than immediate lateral spread to multiple clients.
byChoice.zh: 布草装袋错误很重要，尤其涉及 CDI，但主要增加下游洗涤处理风险，而非立即向多名患者横向传播。

byChoice.en: This is the priority because a contaminated dedicated device entered a clean supply area, creating an expanding fomite pathway to many clients.
byChoice.zh: 这是优先事项，因为污染的专用设备进入清洁物品区域，形成可扩大的污染媒介路径，影响多名患者。

correct.en: The stethoscope breach has the widest and most direct cross-contamination pathway: a device from a draining MRSA contact-precautions room was placed in a clean supply area used for multiple clients. It could contaminate surfaces, supplies, and staff hands. The door handle and linen bagging errors are serious, but their exposure radius is more contained.
correct.zh: 听诊器漏洞具有最广且最直接的交叉污染路径：来自 MRSA 引流伤口接触隔离病房的设备被放到供多名患者使用的清洁物品区域，可能污染表面、物品和工作人员双手。门把手和布草装袋错误也严重，但暴露范围较有限。

stem.en: Stage 3: The charge nurse asks which identified breach posed the greatest cross-contamination risk to other clients on the unit. Which breach should the nurse identify as the priority?
stem.zh: 阶段3：责任护士询问已发现的哪个漏洞对病区其他患者造成最大的交叉污染风险。护士应优先指出哪一项？

testTakingStrategy.en: Prioritization in infection control is about scope and pathway: choose the breach that can spread organisms to the most clients through the most direct route.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 感染控制优先级要看范围和传播路径：选择能通过最直接路径把病原体传播给最多患者的漏洞。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 用于控制空气传播病原体的负压隔离房间。
glossary.termZh: 空气传播感染隔离病房

glossary.defZh: 检测痰液中抗酸杆菌的显微镜检查，常用于评估结核传染性。
按规定佩戴时可过滤空气中微粒的呼吸防护用品。

options.en: Tell the mother she does not need respiratory protection inside the AIIR because negative pressure protects everyone in the room.
options.zh: 告诉母亲在 AIIR 内不需要呼吸防护，因为负压会保护房内所有人。

options.en: Explain that a non-essential trip outside the AIIR is not permitted while AFB smears remain positive; offer in-room comfort alternatives and teach the mother to follow the facility airborne-precautions visitor policy, including instruction and offering of an N95 respirator.
options.zh: 解释 AFB 涂片仍阳性期间不得因非必要原因离开 AIIR；提供病房内舒适替代措施，并指导母亲遵循机构空气传播隔离探视政策，包括说明并提供 N95 呼吸防护口罩。

options.en: Delay answering until the provider makes rounds because nurses do not teach airborne-precautions restrictions.
options.zh: 等医务人员查房后再回答，因为护士不负责空气传播隔离限制的教育。

options.en: Allow a brief outdoor trip if the patient wears a surgical mask the entire time.
options.zh: 如果患者全程戴外科口罩，就允许短暂到室外。

options.en: Give the mother a surgical mask and explain that this reliably protects visitors from airborne TB while inside the room.
options.zh: 给母亲外科口罩，并解释这能在房内可靠保护探视者免受空气传播结核感染。

byChoice.en: A patient surgical mask is for medically necessary transport; it does not make a non-essential trip acceptable while the client remains smear-positive.
byChoice.zh: 患者外科口罩用于医学必要转运；涂片阳性期间不能因此允许非必要外出。

byChoice.en: Negative pressure helps keep room air from escaping to adjacent areas; it does not protect a visitor who is inside the room from inhaling droplet nuclei.
byChoice.zh: 负压有助于防止室内空气逸散到邻近区域；但不能保护房内探视者不吸入飞沫核。

byChoice.en: A surgical mask is not reliable respiratory protection for a visitor against airborne TB in the room; the case's visitor policy includes N95 instruction and offering.
byChoice.zh: 外科口罩不是探视者在房内防护空气传播结核的可靠呼吸防护；病例中的探视政策包括 N95 指导和提供。

byChoice.en: Nurses are responsible for reinforcing isolation precautions and visitor teaching; delaying leaves an active safety question unresolved.
byChoice.zh: 护士有责任强化隔离预防和探视者教育；拖延会让正在发生的安全问题得不到处理。

byChoice.en: This protects others from airborne TB, uses the case's current smear-positive status, and addresses the mother's concern without dismissing her.
byChoice.zh: 这能保护他人免受空气传播结核，依据病例中涂片阳性的当前状态，并在不忽视母亲担忧的情况下回应。

correct.en: The patient is still AFB smear-positive, and the case states the AIIR is functioning and precautions must continue. A non-essential outdoor trip would bypass the engineering control. A surgical mask on the patient is used only when medically necessary transport cannot be avoided; it is not a substitute for the AIIR. The nurse should respond compassionately, offer alternatives, and teach visitor respiratory-protection expectations under facility policy.
correct.zh: 患者 AFB 涂片仍阳性，且病例说明 AIIR 功能正常、隔离需继续。非必要外出会绕过负压工程控制。患者外科口罩仅用于不可避免的医学必要转运，不能替代 AIIR。护士应以同理方式回应，提供替代措施，并按机构政策教育探视者呼吸防护要求。

stem.en: Stage 2: Client D has smear-positive pulmonary TB in a functioning AIIR. Her mother asks to take her outside in a wheelchair for fresh air. Which response is best?
stem.zh: 阶段2：D 患者为痰涂片阳性肺结核，住在功能正常的 AIIR。母亲请求用轮椅带她到室外呼吸新鲜空气。哪项回应最合适？

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not let a compassionate request override the isolation category. For airborne TB, ask whether the trip is medically necessary and whether the AIIR can be replaced by a mask; here, it cannot.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要让合情合理的请求凌驾于隔离类别之上。遇到空气传播结核，先问外出是否医学必要，以及口罩能否替代 AIIR；本题不能。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 用于评价护理措施是否按预期执行的可观察行为或步骤。
持续收集和分析感染或风险数据以发现趋势。
学习者实际演示技能，以确认能正确执行。

options.en: Client C's daughter demonstrating correct gown and glove donning and doffing supports that visitor teaching changed behavior.
options.zh: C 患者女儿能正确回示隔离衣和手套的穿脱，支持探视者教学已改变行为。

options.en: The student's isolation-room errors require follow-up education and supervised return demonstration before independent isolation-room contact.
options.zh: 护生在隔离病房的错误需要后续教育，并在独立接触隔离患者前接受监督下回示。

options.en: Client D's continued AFB smear positivity means airborne precautions and AIIR confinement remain necessary; the outdoor trip remains inappropriate.
options.zh: D 患者 AFB 涂片仍阳性，表示仍需空气传播隔离和 AIIR，室外活动仍不合适。

options.en: Client A's potassium correction to 3.6 mEq/L means CDI contact precautions can be discontinued.
options.zh: A 患者血钾纠正到 3.6 mEq/L 表示可以停止 CDI 接触隔离。

options.en: Retrieving the stethoscope, disinfecting contacted clean-utility surfaces, handling nearby supplies per policy, and completing wet-contact disinfection before return supports containment of the environmental breach.
options.zh: 取回听诊器、消毒其接触过的清洁用物间表面、按制度处理附近物品，并完成湿接触消毒后再送回，支持环境污染漏洞已被控制。

options.en: Because no new infections were diagnosed by the end of the shift, all interventions can be declared fully effective.
options.zh: 因为班末没有诊断出新感染，所以可宣布所有干预完全有效。

byChoice.en: The student had multiple isolation-practice breaches, so supervised return demonstration is needed before independent care.
byChoice.zh: 护生出现多项隔离操作漏洞，因此独立照护前需要在监督下回示。

byChoice.en: New infections or colonization may not appear during one shift; this is premature outcome-based reassurance.
byChoice.zh: 新感染或定植可能不会在一个班次内显现；这是过早依赖结局指标的安心判断。

byChoice.en: Potassium correction treats a complication risk; it does not change the organism or transmission-based precautions for CDI.
byChoice.zh: 纠正血钾是处理并发症风险；并不改变 CDI 病原体或传播隔离要求。

byChoice.en: Observed correct performance is a meaningful process outcome after visitor teaching.
byChoice.zh: 教学后观察到正确操作，是有意义的过程性结果。

byChoice.en: This addresses the device, the surfaces, and supplies in the contamination radius before returning the device to the room.
byChoice.zh: 这在设备返回病房前处理了设备、表面以及污染范围内的物品。

byChoice.en: Ongoing smear positivity means the airborne transmission risk remains active in this case.
byChoice.zh: 涂片持续阳性表示本病例中空气传播风险仍存在。

correct.en: Effective infection-control evaluation during the same shift relies on process indicators: observed PPE compliance, return demonstration, correction of environmental contamination, and recognition of ongoing isolation needs. A same-day absence of new infections is not proof of effectiveness, and lab correction does not end CDI precautions.
correct.zh: 同一班次内评价感染控制效果主要依赖过程指标：观察到的 PPE 依从性、回示、环境污染纠正，以及识别仍需隔离的风险。当天没有新感染并不能证明完全有效，电解质纠正也不代表可停止 CDI 隔离。

stem.en: Stage 3: Which statements show an accurate evaluation of whether the infection-control interventions were effective? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 阶段3：哪些陈述能准确评价感染控制干预是否有效？选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluation questions often mix outcomes and process measures. In short time frames, prioritize observable compliance and corrected hazards over infection rates that require longer surveillance.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价类题常混合结局指标和过程指标。在短时间内，优先看可观察到的依从性和已纠正的危险，而不是需要更长监测期的感染率。

content.en: While the nurse is assessing Client A while wearing gown and gloves after soap-and-water hand hygiene, a nursing student steps into Room 12 wearing gloves but no gown. The student uses Client A's dedicated blood-pressure cuff, removes her gloves inside the room, and then touches the door handle with bare, unwashed hands. The nurse stops the student before she exits, directs soap-and-water hand hygiene, and arranges door-handle disinfection.
content.zh: 护士在完成肥皂和清水洗手并穿戴隔离衣和手套后，正在评估 A 患者。此时护生进入12房，只戴手套、未穿隔离衣。护生使用 A 患者的专用血压袖带，在房内脱下手套，然后用未清洁的裸手触碰门把手。护士在护生离开前立即制止，指导其用肥皂和清水洗手，并安排对门把手消毒。

content.en: At 0745, the nurse uses the portable bladder scanner on Client A; post-void residual is 410 mL, and the provider is notified. The scanner is also needed for Client B, who is on standard precautions. At 0800, Client C's daughter is in Room 16 in street clothes with no gown or gloves. She has been repositioning her father and says, "I've been coming every day — nobody told me I needed to put anything on." Client C's dressing is saturated and due for change.
content.zh: 0745，护士为 A 患者使用便携式膀胱扫描仪；残余尿量为 410 mL，已通知医务人员。该扫描仪随后还需用于仅执行标准预防的 B 患者。0800，C 患者女儿在16房，穿普通衣服，未穿隔离衣、未戴手套。她一直协助父亲翻身，并说：“我每天都来——没人告诉我需要穿戴什么。” C 患者敷料已被渗液浸透，需更换。

title.zh: 0745–0800 设备与探视者问题

title.en: Stage 1 — 0700 to 0900: shift organization and first rounds
title.zh: 阶段1 — 0700至0900：安排班次并首次查房

content.en:
0915: Client D's mother asks at the nurses' station whether she can take her daughter outside in a wheelchair for ten minutes of fresh air. The mother is not wearing a mask.
0945: During Client C's wound dressing change, the nurse notices Client C's dedicated stethoscope sitting on the clean-utility-room counter next to the clean supply cart. A housekeeper reports another staff member carried it out of Room 16 about 20 minutes earlier.
1030: Client A has another large watery stool. While the nurse is gowned and gloved in Room 12, soiled linens are bundled into a standard linen bag instead of a water-soluble inner bag and labeled outer bag. The student asks whether this matters.
1100: Client B's wife arrives, stops at Room 12's open doorway, sees the contact-precautions sign, and asks if she should worry because her husband is next door.
content.zh:
0915：D 患者母亲在护士站询问，能否用轮椅带女儿到室外呼吸10分钟新鲜空气。母亲未戴口罩。
0945：护士为 C 患者更换伤口敷料时，发现 C 患者的专用听诊器放在清洁用物间柜台上，靠近清洁物品车。保洁人员说约20分钟前有另一名工作人员把它从16房拿出并放在那里。
1030：A 患者再次大量水样便。护士在12房内穿戴隔离衣和手套协助清洁时，污染布草被装入普通布草袋，而不是先放入水溶性内袋再放入有标识外袋。护生询问这是否重要。
1100：B 患者妻子到达，停在12房开着的门口，看到接触隔离标识，询问丈夫就在隔壁是否需要担心。

title.zh: 0915–1100 请求与感染控制漏洞

content.en:
Client A: T 38.4 C, HR 110, BP 100/58; two additional large watery stools since 0900, intake 750 mL IV, output about 1,100 mL; potassium 3.1 mEq/L, creatinine 1.5 mg/dL.
Client B: stable; post-void residual 45 mL; preliminary sputum culture Streptococcus pneumoniae susceptible to ceftriaxone.
Client C: dressing changed; wound appearance unchanged; vancomycin monitoring managed by pharmacy.
Client D: remains in AIIR; morning sputum AFB smear still positive (2+); mother remains at bedside and the outdoor-trip request has not yet been addressed.
content.zh:
A 患者：T 101.1 °F (38.4 °C)，HR 110，BP 100/58；0900后又有2次大量水样便，IV 入量 750 mL，尿液和粪便总出量约 1,100 mL；血钾 3.1 mEq/L，肌酐 1.5 mg/dL。
B 患者：情况稳定；残余尿量 45 mL；痰培养初步为肺炎链球菌，对头孢曲松敏感。
C 患者：敷料已更换；伤口外观无变化；万古霉素监测由药房按制度管理。
D 患者：仍在 AIIR；晨痰 AFB 涂片仍阳性（2+）；母亲仍在床旁，外出请求尚未处理。

title.zh: 1130 复查情况
阶段2 — 0900至1200：复杂情况增加

content.en:
1215: The nurse debriefs the student about the Room 12 entry without a gown, missed hand hygiene after glove removal, door-handle contact, the linen-bagging error, and the stethoscope found in the clean utility room.
1230: The charge nurse asks which identified breach posed the greatest cross-contamination risk to other clients and why.
1300: Client D's repeat sputum AFB smear remains positive (2+); the provider confirms airborne precautions and AIIR must continue. The nurse teaches the patient and mother that non-essential trips outside the AIIR are not permitted while smear-positive; a surgical mask is used on the patient only for medically necessary transport, and visitors follow the facility airborne-precautions policy with instruction and offering of an N95 respirator.
End of shift: Client C's daughter correctly demonstrates gown and glove donning and doffing. The contaminated stethoscope is retrieved; clean-utility surfaces it may have touched are disinfected; potentially contaminated nearby supplies are removed or handled per policy; the stethoscope is disinfected with full wet-contact time and returned to Room 16. Client A's CDI diarrhea continues; contact precautions remain. Client D remains smear-positive in AIIR. The student requires follow-up education and supervised return demonstration.
content.zh:
1215：护士与护生重点复盘12房未穿隔离衣进入、脱手套后未手卫生、触碰门把手、布草装袋错误，以及在清洁用物间发现听诊器的问题。
1230：责任护士询问已发现的哪些漏洞对其他患者造成最大的交叉污染风险，以及原因。
1300：D 患者复查痰 AFB 涂片仍阳性（2+）；医务人员确认必须继续空气传播隔离和 AIIR。护士向患者和母亲解释：涂片阳性期间不得因非必要原因离开 AIIR；只有医学必要转运时才给患者戴外科口罩；探视者需遵循机构空气传播隔离探视政策，包括指导并提供 N95 呼吸防护口罩。
班末：C 患者女儿能正确回示隔离衣和手套的穿脱。污染听诊器已取回；其可能接触的清洁用物间表面已消毒；附近可能污染的物品已按制度移除或处理；听诊器完成全程湿接触时间消毒后送回16房。A 患者 CDI 腹泻仍持续，继续接触隔离。D 患者仍为涂片阳性并留在 AIIR。护生需要后续教育和受监督回示。

title.zh: 重点复盘与班末情况

title.en: Stage 3 — 1200 to 1500: resolution, teaching, and evaluation
title.zh: 阶段3 — 1200至1500：处理、教学与评价

summary.en: A day-shift nurse on a medical-surgical unit is caring for four adjacent clients: Client A with Clostridioides difficile infection on contact precautions, Client B with community-acquired pneumonia on standard precautions, Client C with a draining MRSA pressure injury on contact precautions, and Client D with smear-positive pulmonary TB in a functioning airborne infection isolation room. The nurse must model safe practice for a nursing student, teach visitors, and contain several infection-control breaches during the shift.
summary.zh: 一名日班护士在内外科病区照护四名相邻病房的患者：A 患者为艰难梭菌感染并执行接触隔离，B 患者为社区获得性肺炎并执行标准预防，C 患者有引流性 MRSA 3期压力性损伤并执行接触隔离，D 患者为痰涂片阳性肺结核并住在功能正常的空气传播感染隔离病房。护士需要为护生示范正确做法，教育探视者，并在班次中控制多项感染控制漏洞。

title.zh: 集中照护期间预防交叉污染

payload.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 在标准预防基础上，根据接触、飞沫或空气传播风险增加的隔离措施。
glossary.termZh: 基于传播途径的隔离预防

glossary.defZh: 用于可经直接或间接接触传播病原体的预防措施，常需隔离衣和手套。
用于可经空气中微粒传播的病原体，通常需要 AIIR 和呼吸防护。
消毒剂需在表面保持湿润并接触的规定时间。
可被病原体污染并间接传播感染的物体或表面。

correct.en: This case centers on preventing cross-contamination while moving between clients with different precautions. Key judgments include recognizing true PPE and hand-hygiene breaches in a CDI room, using organism-specific disinfection and wet-contact time for shared equipment, teaching MRSA contact precautions without blaming family, prioritizing the contaminated stethoscope in the clean utility room because it creates the broadest direct fomite pathway, maintaining AIIR restrictions for smear-positive TB, and evaluating effectiveness through observed behavior and corrected environmental hazards rather than same-shift infection rates.
correct.zh: 本病例核心是护士在不同隔离预防患者之间移动照护时预防交叉污染。关键判断包括识别 CDI 病房中的真实 PPE 和手卫生漏洞；对共用设备使用针对病原体的消毒和湿接触时间；在不责备家属的情况下教育 MRSA 接触隔离；因清洁用物间污染听诊器形成最广、最直接的污染媒介路径而将其列为优先；对涂片阳性肺结核继续维持 AIIR 限制；并通过可观察行为和已纠正的环境危险评价效果，而不是依赖同一班次内的感染发生率。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

testTakingStrategy.en: Track the organism, route of transmission, and radius of exposure. The safest answer usually interrupts the most direct route of spread while preserving appropriate family involvement and using the facility policy stated in the chart.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 追踪病原体、传播途径和暴露范围。最安全的答案通常是切断最直接的传播路径，同时保留适当的家庭参与，并使用病历中给出的机构制度。

content.en:
Reason for admission: symptomatic anemia with fatigue, exertional dyspnea, and pallor for 2 weeks.
Ordered therapy: two units packed red blood cells; initial transfusion rate 2 mL/min for the first 15 minutes per facility protocol.
Baseline vital signs: T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C), HR 92/min, BP 108/68 mmHg, RR 18/min, SpO2 96% on room air.
Assessment: alert and oriented, lungs clear, skin pale/warm/dry, abdomen soft and non-tender, no edema, IV site without redness/swelling/tenderness.
Urine output: about 40 mL/hr, straw-colored urine.
Admission labs: Hgb 6.4 g/dL, Hct 19.2%, WBC 7.8 ×10³/µL, platelets 218 ×10³/µL, BUN 32 mg/dL, creatinine 1.8 mg/dL, K 4.6 mEq/L, total bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL, LDH 190 U/L, INR 1.0, aPTT 28 sec, fibrinogen 310 mg/dL, haptoglobin 95 mg/dL. Urinalysis yellow/clear, no blood.
content.zh:
入院原因：症状性贫血，2 周来乏力、活动后气促、面色苍白。
医嘱治疗：输注 2 单位浓缩红细胞；按机构流程，前 15 分钟初始速率为 2 mL/min。
基线生命体征：T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，HR 92 次/分，BP 108/68 mmHg，RR 18 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 96%。
评估：清醒定向，双肺清，皮肤苍白但温暖干燥，腹部软且无压痛，无水肿，IV 部位无发红/肿胀/压痛。
尿量：约 40 mL/hr，尿液稻草色。
入院实验室：Hgb 6.4 g/dL，Hct 19.2%，WBC 7.8 ×10³/µL，血小板 218 ×10³/µL，BUN 32 mg/dL，肌酐 1.8 mg/dL，K 4.6 mEq/L，总胆红素 0.9 mg/dL，LDH 190 U/L，INR 1.0，aPTT 28 秒，纤维蛋白原 310 mg/dL，结合珠蛋白 95 mg/dL。尿检黄色清亮，无血。

title.zh: 输血前基线记录

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 强烈、不可控制的发抖，常提示急性发热或感染/输血反应。
游离血红蛋白经肾脏排出，使尿液呈红褐色。
患者突然强烈感觉将发生严重危险，可见于严重急性反应。

segments.en: Sudden deep bilateral flank and low back pain during the transfusion.
segments.zh: 输血过程中突然出现双侧腰背部深部疼痛。

segments.en: The client states, "something is wrong — I feel like something terrible is about to happen."
segments.zh: 患者说：“不对劲——我觉得要出大事了。”

segments.en: Visible rigors with temperature rising from 98.2 °F (36.8 °C) to 101.5 °F (38.6 °C).
Heart rate increases from 92/min to 118/min.
segments.zh: 心率从 92 次/分升至 118 次/分。

segments.en: Blood pressure decreases from 108/68 mmHg to 96/58 mmHg.
segments.zh: 血压从 108/68 mmHg 降至 96/58 mmHg。

segments.en: The most recent urine appears dark reddish-brown.
segments.zh: 最近一次尿液呈深红褐色。

segments.en: The peripheral IV site has no redness, swelling, or streaking.
segments.zh: 外周 IV 部位无发红、肿胀或条索状红线。

byChoice.en: Acute flank or low back pain during a transfusion is a high-risk cue for intravascular hemolysis and renal involvement.
byChoice.zh: 输血时急性腰部或下背痛是血管内溶血和肾脏受累的高危线索。

byChoice.en: A sudden sense of impending doom during a transfusion is a classic subjective warning sign of a severe acute reaction.
byChoice.zh: 输血过程中突然出现濒危感，是严重急性反应的典型主观警讯。

byChoice.en: A rapid temperature rise with rigors during blood administration indicates an acute transfusion reaction until proven otherwise.
byChoice.zh: 输血期间体温快速升高并伴寒战，应首先视为急性输血反应。

byChoice.en: The new tachycardia is part of the systemic reaction and may reflect early shock.
byChoice.zh: 新发心动过速属于全身反应的一部分，可能提示早期休克。

byChoice.en: A falling blood pressure during the reaction signals loss of perfusion and a potentially life-threatening trajectory.
byChoice.zh: 反应过程中血压下降提示灌注不足，病情可能危及生命。

byChoice.en: Dark reddish-brown urine suggests hemoglobinuria, which strongly supports intravascular hemolysis.
byChoice.zh: 深红褐色尿提示血红蛋白尿，强烈支持血管内溶血。

byChoice.en: A normal IV site does not explain the systemic symptoms; it is not a cue that requires emergency action by itself.
byChoice.zh: IV 部位正常不能解释全身症状；它本身不是需要紧急处理的线索。

correct.en: The cue cluster is abrupt flank/back pain, a sense of impending doom, fever with rigors, tachycardia, falling blood pressure, and dark reddish-brown urine within minutes of starting blood. This pattern requires the nurse to treat the event as an acute transfusion reaction and stop the transfusion immediately. The normal IV site is useful because it makes infiltration or phlebitis less likely, but it is not itself a danger cue.
correct.zh: 关键线索组合是在输血开始后数分钟内突然出现腰背痛、濒危感、发热寒战、心动过速、血压下降和深红褐色尿液。护士应按急性输血反应处理，立即停止输血。IV 部位正常有助于排除渗漏或静脉炎，但它本身不是危险线索。

stem.en: Using the Stage 1 update, highlight the findings that are significant cues requiring immediate nursing action.
stem.zh: 根据第1阶段更新，标出需要护士立即处理的重要线索。

testTakingStrategy.en: During a transfusion, sudden systemic changes are more important than a normal IV site. Link timing plus cue cluster before deciding the priority.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 输血过程中，突然出现的全身变化比 IV 部位正常更重要。先把发生时间和线索组合联系起来，再判断优先级。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 输注不相容血液后红细胞被迅速破坏的严重反应。
供受者 ABO 血型不匹配，可引起严重溶血。
肾区疼痛；在溶血时可与肾脏受累有关。

options.en: Febrile non-hemolytic transfusion reaction
options.zh: 非溶血性发热性输血反应

options.en: Mild allergic transfusion reaction
options.zh: 轻度过敏性输血反应

options.en: Delayed hemolytic transfusion reaction
options.zh: 迟发性溶血性输血反应

options.en: Transfusion-associated circulatory overload
options.zh: 输血相关循环超负荷

options.en: Acute hemolytic transfusion reaction
options.zh: 急性溶血性输血反应

byChoice.en: A febrile non-hemolytic reaction can cause fever and chills, but it does not explain hemoglobinuria, flank pain, or shock.
byChoice.zh: 非溶血性发热反应可有发热寒战，但不能解释血红蛋白尿、腰痛或休克。

byChoice.en: A delayed hemolytic reaction occurs days to weeks later, not within 12 minutes of beginning the transfusion.
byChoice.zh: 迟发性溶血反应发生在数天到数周后，而不是输血开始 12 分钟内。

byChoice.en: TACO is suggested by dyspnea, crackles, jugular venous distension, fluid overload, and often hypertension rather than hemoglobinuria and flank pain.
byChoice.zh: TACO 通常由呼吸困难、湿啰音、颈静脉怒张、容量超负荷及常见高血压提示，而不是血红蛋白尿和腰痛。

byChoice.en: A mild allergic reaction usually causes urticaria, itching, and flushing; it does not cause hemoglobinuria or bilateral flank pain.
byChoice.zh: 轻度过敏反应通常表现为荨麻疹、瘙痒和潮红；不会导致血红蛋白尿或双侧腰痛。

byChoice.en: This is correct because hemoglobinuria plus flank pain and hemodynamic instability during the first minutes of transfusion strongly indicates acute intravascular hemolysis.
byChoice.zh: 正确。输血最初数分钟内出现血红蛋白尿、腰痛和血流动力学不稳定，强烈提示急性血管内溶血。

correct.en: The most consistent diagnosis is an acute hemolytic transfusion reaction. The decisive features are very rapid onset during transfusion, flank/back pain, hypotension, hemoglobinuria, fever with rigors, and a sense of impending doom. These findings fit acute intravascular hemolysis from incompatible red cells.
correct.zh: 最符合的是急性溶血性输血反应。关键特征是输血过程中快速发作、腰背痛、低血压、血红蛋白尿、发热寒战和濒危感。这些符合不相容红细胞导致的急性血管内溶血。

stem.en: At Stage 1, which transfusion reaction is most consistent with fever and rigors, bilateral flank pain, hypotension, a sense of impending doom, and dark reddish-brown urine 12 minutes after the transfusion begins?
stem.zh: 第1阶段，输血开始 12 分钟后出现发热寒战、双侧腰痛、低血压、濒危感和深红褐色尿液，最符合哪一种输血反应？

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not stop at the word fever. Hemoglobinuria and flank pain shift the diagnosis from a simple febrile reaction to hemolysis.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要只看到“发热”。血红蛋白尿和腰痛会把判断从单纯发热反应转向溶血反应。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 循环系统不能维持足够组织灌注的危急状态。
血液向组织输送氧气和营养的过程。
组织灌注不足导致细胞缺氧和器官功能障碍的状态。

options.en: The dark reddish-brown urine
options.zh: 深红褐色尿液

options.en: The normal-appearing IV site
options.zh: IV 部位外观正常

options.en: The fever and rigors
options.zh: 发热和寒战

options.en: The client's nausea
options.zh: 患者恶心

options.en: The acute hypotension with tachycardia
options.zh: 急性低血压伴心动过速

byChoice.en: Nausea is uncomfortable but is not the immediate threat compared with shock and ongoing hemolysis.
byChoice.zh: 恶心会造成不适，但与休克和持续溶血相比，不是最直接威胁。

byChoice.en: Hemoglobinuria indicates hemolysis and renal risk, but circulation must be supported first so the kidneys can be perfused.
byChoice.zh: 血红蛋白尿提示溶血和肾损伤风险，但必须先维持循环灌注，肾脏才有灌注。

byChoice.en: The normal IV site rules against a local IV complication; it is not the life-threatening problem.
byChoice.zh: IV 部位正常有助于排除局部 IV 并发症；它不是危及生命的问题。

byChoice.en: This is correct because hypotension with tachycardia signals shock physiology and loss of adequate tissue perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 正确。低血压伴心动过速提示休克生理和组织灌注不足。

byChoice.en: Fever and rigors help identify the reaction, but temperature control is not the first survival priority.
byChoice.zh: 发热寒战有助于识别反应，但退热不是最优先生命支持问题。

correct.en: The immediate threat is cardiovascular collapse: the blood pressure is falling while the heart rate is rising. Fever and hemoglobinuria are important, but inadequate perfusion can become fatal within minutes and must drive the response to stop the antigen exposure and support circulation.
correct.zh: 最直接的威胁是循环崩溃：血压下降同时心率升高。发热和血红蛋白尿很重要，但灌注不足可在数分钟内危及生命，因此处理重点是停止继续接触抗原并支持循环。

stem.en: At Stage 1, which problem is the most immediately life-threatening and should drive the nurse's priority response?
stem.zh: 第1阶段，哪一个问题最直接危及生命，应该决定护士的优先处理？

testTakingStrategy.en: When several abnormal findings are present, ask which one can kill the client first. Shock physiology outranks fever control.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 多个异常同时存在时，先问哪一个会最快危及生命。休克生理优先于退热处理。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 常用于输血相关 IV 管路管理的等渗晶体液。
对血袋、管路、标签和患者样本进行核查，以确认反应原因。
用于输液、给药或输血的静脉管路。

options.en: Remove the peripheral IV catheter because the line has been exposed to incompatible blood.
options.zh: 因为该管路接触过不相容血液，所以拔除外周 IV 导管。

options.en: Disconnect the blood tubing and keep the IV open with 0.9% normal saline through new tubing per protocol.
options.zh: 断开输血管路，并按流程用新的管路接 0.9% 生理盐水维持 IV 通路。

options.en: Clamp the blood tubing and stop the transfusion.
options.zh: 夹闭输血管路并停止输血。

options.en: Save the blood unit with attached tubing and labels for the blood bank investigation.
options.zh: 保留血袋、连接管路和标签，供血库调查。

options.en: Flush the blood remaining in the original tubing before switching to saline.
options.zh: 在换接生理盐水前，先把原管路中剩余的血液冲入体内。

options.en: Stay with the client and have another staff member notify the provider and blood bank.
options.zh: 留在患者身边，并请另一名工作人员通知医护提供者和血库。

byChoice.en: Removing the IV loses needed venous access in a hypotensive client who may require fluids, medications, and blood components.
byChoice.zh: 拔除 IV 会失去必要静脉通路；低血压患者可能需要补液、用药和血液成分治疗。

byChoice.en: New tubing with 0.9% normal saline maintains access and avoids flushing residual blood from the transfusion tubing.
byChoice.zh: 使用新管路接 0.9% 生理盐水可维持通路，并避免冲入输血管路中的残余血液。

byChoice.en: The client is unstable; the nurse should remain with the client and delegate notification when possible.
byChoice.zh: 患者不稳定；护士应留在患者身边，并在可能时委派他人通知。

byChoice.en: The blood bank needs the unit, tubing, and labels intact to investigate the incompatibility and reaction.
byChoice.zh: 血库需要完整的血袋、管路和标签来调查不相容和输血反应。

byChoice.en: This is unsafe because any additional incompatible blood can worsen the hemolytic reaction.
byChoice.zh: 不安全。任何额外的不相容血液都可能加重溶血反应。

byChoice.en: Stopping the transfusion immediately stops additional incompatible red cells from entering the client.
byChoice.zh: 立即停止输血可阻止更多不相容红细胞进入患者体内。

correct.en: The nurse should stop the transfusion, maintain venous access with 0.9% normal saline using new tubing according to protocol, notify the provider and blood bank while staying with the client, and preserve the unit/tubing/labels. The nurse should not flush the original tubing because that would infuse more incompatible blood, and should not remove the IV because the client is hypotensive and needs access.
correct.zh: 护士应停止输血，按流程使用新管路和 0.9% 生理盐水维持静脉通路，留在患者身边并通知医护提供者和血库，同时保留血袋、管路和标签。不能冲洗原输血管路，因为会把更多不相容血液输入体内；也不应拔除 IV，因为患者低血压，需要静脉通路。

stem.en: At Stage 1, which actions should the nurse take immediately? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第1阶段，护士应立即采取哪些措施？请选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: For a suspected severe transfusion reaction, do four things together: stop blood, keep access safely, call for help, and preserve evidence.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 疑似严重输血反应时同时抓住四点：停血、以安全方式保留通路、呼叫支援、保留证据。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 凝血系统广泛激活导致血栓形成和凝血因子消耗，可出现出血。
尿量明显减少，成人常以每小时尿量过低作为警讯。
针对病情突然恶化患者启动的院内紧急评估和支援流程。

options.en: Hold further interventions until the blood bank confirms the exact incompatibility.
options.zh: 等待血库确认具体不相容类型后再进行进一步干预。

options.en: Escalate immediately for rapid response or ICU-level care while continuing perfusion support and strict output monitoring.
options.zh: 立即升级处理，启动快速反应或转入 ICU 级别护理，同时继续支持灌注并严格监测尿量。

options.en: Administer acetaminophen and reassess the temperature in 30 minutes.
options.zh: 给予对乙酰氨基酚，并在 30 分钟后复测体温。

options.en: Slow the saline infusion because chronic kidney disease makes fluid overload the main priority.
options.zh: 因患者有慢性肾病，应减慢生理盐水输注，因为容量超负荷是主要优先问题。

options.en: Complete the transfusion reaction documentation before further escalation.
options.zh: 先完成输血反应记录表，再进一步升级处理。

byChoice.en: This is correct because worsening hypotension, oliguria, and coagulopathy require higher-acuity monitoring and interventions.
byChoice.zh: 正确。低血压、少尿和凝血障碍恶化，需要更高级别监护和干预。

byChoice.en: The client has renal disease, but the immediate problem is poor perfusion and shock; fluids are guided by orders/protocol and ongoing assessment.
byChoice.zh: 患者有肾病，但当前直接问题是灌注不足和休克；补液应按医嘱/流程并结合持续评估。

byChoice.en: Treating fever alone misses the life-threatening shock, renal injury, and DIC.
byChoice.zh: 单纯退热会漏掉危及生命的休克、肾损伤和 DIC。

byChoice.en: The nurse should not wait for final confirmation when the client is actively deteriorating.
byChoice.zh: 患者正在恶化时，护士不应等待最终确认才处理。

byChoice.en: Documentation is required, but it must not delay escalation for an unstable client.
byChoice.zh: 记录是必要的，但不能延误对不稳定患者的升级处理。

correct.en: The client is deteriorating with shock, oliguric acute kidney injury, and DIC despite the initial correct response. The nurse should escalate immediately to rapid response or ICU-level care, continue ordered perfusion support, measure urine output closely, and ensure the blood bank workup and compatible components are moving. Documentation and antipyretics must not delay escalation.
correct.zh: 患者在初步正确处理后仍出现休克、少尿性急性肾损伤和 DIC，说明病情恶化。护士应立即启动快速反应或 ICU 级别护理，继续按医嘱支持灌注，严密测量尿量，并确保血库调查和相容血液成分准备正在进行。记录和退热不能延误升级处理。

stem.en: At Stage 2, the client remains hypotensive despite initial saline, has worsening oliguria with port-wine urine, oozing from puncture sites, petechiae, and labs consistent with hemolysis and evolving DIC. What is the nurse's priority action?
stem.zh: 第2阶段，患者经初始生理盐水处理后仍低血压，少尿加重且尿呈葡萄酒色，穿刺部位渗血、出现瘀点，实验室结果符合溶血和进展性 DIC。护士的优先措施是什么？

testTakingStrategy.en: When initial measures fail and multiple organ systems are worsening, choose escalation rather than task completion or symptom-only care.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 初步处理无效且多个器官系统恶化时，应选择升级处理，而不是先完成文书或只处理单一症状。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 凝血所需蛋白；DIC 中可被消耗而下降。
反映凝血途径功能的实验室指标，升高表示凝血时间延长。
用于收缩血管、提高血压和改善灌注的药物。

columns.zh: 单独看不足以判断稳定

rows.en: Urine output is 8 mL in the past hour with persistent hemoglobin-positive dark urine.
rows.zh: 过去 1 小时尿量 8 mL，尿液仍深色且血红蛋白阳性。

rows.en: Blood pressure is maintained while norepinephrine requirements are decreasing.
rows.zh: 血压可维持，同时去甲肾上腺素需求量正在下降。

rows.en: Fibrinogen is rising while INR and aPTT are falling toward baseline.
rows.zh: 纤维蛋白原上升，同时 INR 和 aPTT 正向基线下降。

rows.en: Potassium has increased to 5.9 mEq/L with worsening creatinine.
rows.zh: 钾升至 5.9 mEq/L，肌酐继续恶化。

rows.en: Temperature has decreased from 102.4 °F (39.1 °C) to 101.1 °F (38.4 °C).

byChoice.en: Persistent oliguria with hemoglobin-positive dark urine indicates ongoing renal hypoperfusion and hemoglobin-mediated injury.
byChoice.zh: 持续少尿且尿血红蛋白阳性，提示肾灌注不足和血红蛋白介导损伤仍在进行。

byChoice.en: Maintaining pressure with less vasopressor support would indicate improving cardiovascular stability.
byChoice.zh: 在升压药需求减少的情况下维持血压，提示循环稳定性改善。

byChoice.en: Rising fibrinogen with improving clotting times suggests the consumptive coagulopathy is stabilizing.
byChoice.zh: 纤维蛋白原上升且凝血时间改善，提示消耗性凝血障碍趋于稳定。

byChoice.en: Rising potassium with worsening creatinine indicates worsening renal failure and dyskalemia risk.
byChoice.zh: 钾升高并伴肌酐恶化，提示肾衰竭加重和电解质危险。

byChoice.en: A lower temperature may be reassuring, but by itself it does not outweigh worsening renal, coagulation, and perfusion data.
byChoice.zh: 体温下降可能令人稍安心，但单独看不能抵消肾脏、凝血和灌注数据恶化。

correct.en: Stabilization would be shown by improving perfusion with lower vasopressor needs, improving urine output, and improving coagulation and electrolyte trends. At Stage 3, persistent oliguria with hemoglobinuria, rising creatinine, rising potassium, and worsening coagulation show deterioration. A modest temperature decrease alone does not prove recovery.
correct.zh: 病情稳定应表现为灌注改善且升压药需求下降、尿量改善、凝血和电解质趋势改善。第3阶段持续少尿伴血红蛋白尿、肌酐升高、钾升高和凝血恶化提示继续恶化。体温略降本身不能证明恢复。

stem.en: At Stage 3, classify each finding as evidence of stabilization, evidence of continued deterioration, or insufficient by itself to show stabilization.
stem.zh: 第3阶段，请判断每项发现是提示病情稳定、继续恶化，还是单独看不足以说明病情稳定。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate outcomes by trends in threatened organ systems, not by one improving vital sign.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价结果时看受威胁器官系统的趋势，不要只看一个好转的生命体征。
