content.en: The client presses the call light and reports sudden deep low back pain across both flanks. She says, "something is wrong — I feel like something terrible is about to happen." She is visibly shivering and reports feeling cold despite warm blankets. Face and chest are flushed; early diaphoresis and mild nausea are present. Vital signs: T 101.5 °F (38.6 °C), HR 118/min, BP 96/58 mmHg, RR 24/min, SpO2 95% on room air. IV site remains unchanged with no redness, swelling, or streaking. About 25 mL of the unit has infused. The urine in the bedside commode from the most recent void is dark reddish-brown.
content.zh: 患者按铃，诉双侧腰部突然出现深部下背痛。她说：“不对劲——我觉得要出大事了。”患者明显发抖，即使盖着暖毯仍觉得冷。面部和胸部潮红，早期出汗，轻度恶心。生命体征：T 101.5 °F (38.6 °C)，HR 118 次/分，BP 96/58 mmHg，RR 24 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 95%。IV 部位无变化，无发红、肿胀或条索状红线。约 25 mL 血液已输入。床旁便盆中最近一次尿液呈深红褐色。

title.zh: 输血期间急性变化
第1阶段：输血开始后 12 分钟（1432）

content.en:
The provider is at the bedside. The client is increasingly restless, reports worsening flank pain and chest tightness, and speaks in fragmented phrases. Vital signs: T 102.4 °F (39.1 °C), HR 132/min, BP 82/50 mmHg, RR 28/min, SpO2 93% on 4 L nasal cannula. Extremities are mottled with cool fingers and toes despite truncal flushing. Foley catheter drainage: initial 20 mL dark port-wine urine, then only 10 mL over the next 30 minutes. New oozing is present from the peripheral IV insertion site and a venipuncture site; petechiae are appearing across the anterior chest.
Stat labs: Hgb 5.8 g/dL, platelets 104 ×10³/µL, K 5.4 mEq/L, creatinine 2.6 mg/dL, total bilirubin 4.2 mg/dL, LDH 1,840 U/L, INR 1.8, aPTT 52 sec, fibrinogen 140 mg/dL, haptoglobin <10 mg/dL, free plasma hemoglobin elevated. Blood bank requests the discontinued unit with attached tubing, a post-reaction blood sample from the opposite arm, and the original pretransfusion specimen.
content.zh:
医护提供者已在床旁。患者越来越烦躁，诉腰痛加重并有胸闷，说话断续。生命体征：T 102.4 °F (39.1 °C)，HR 132 次/分，BP 82/50 mmHg，RR 28 次/分，鼻导管 4 L/min 下 SpO2 93%。四肢呈花斑，手指和脚趾冰凉，但躯干仍潮红。Foley 导尿：初始引流 20 mL 深葡萄酒色尿，随后 30 分钟仅 10 mL。外周 IV 穿刺处和抽血穿刺处新出现渗血；前胸出现瘀点。
急查实验室：Hgb 5.8 g/dL，血小板 104 ×10³/µL，K 5.4 mEq/L，肌酐 2.6 mg/dL，总胆红素 4.2 mg/dL，LDH 1,840 U/L，INR 1.8，aPTT 52 秒，纤维蛋白原 140 mg/dL，结合珠蛋白 <10 mg/dL，游离血浆血红蛋白升高。血库要求送回已停止输注的血袋及连接管路、从对侧手臂采集输血反应后血样，以及原输血前标本。

title.en: Worsening shock, renal findings, and coagulopathy
title.zh: 休克、肾脏表现和凝血障碍恶化

title.en: Stage 2: 30 minutes after transfusion stopped and saline bolus started (about 1505)
title.zh: 第2阶段：停止输血并开始生理盐水快速输注后 30 分钟（约 1505）

content.en: The client has been transferred to the ICU after receiving 1,500 mL normal saline. A central venous catheter has been placed, and norepinephrine is infusing at 0.08 mcg/kg/min to maintain MAP above 65 mmHg per ICU protocol. The blood bank confirms the client is A-positive and the transfused unit was B-positive. Current vital signs: T 101.1 °F (38.4 °C), HR 120/min, BP 88/56 mmHg on norepinephrine, RR 24/min on 6 L nasal cannula, SpO2 94%. Urine output over the past hour is 8 mL, dark amber and hemoglobin-positive by dipstick. Repeat labs: Hgb 5.2 g/dL, platelets 78 ×10³/µL, K 5.9 mEq/L, creatinine 3.4 mg/dL, total bilirubin 6.1 mg/dL, LDH 2,600 U/L, INR 2.2, aPTT 68 sec, fibrinogen 88 mg/dL. The client is drowsy but arousable, oriented to person only. Peripheral pulses are thready; mottling extends to knees and elbows; oozing continues from catheter sites. ICU team is evaluating for emergent dialysis and blood component therapy.
content.zh: 患者已转入 ICU，已接受 1,500 mL 生理盐水。已置入中心静脉导管，并按 ICU 流程使用去甲肾上腺素 0.08 mcg/kg/min 以维持 MAP >65 mmHg。血库确认患者为 A 阳性，输注血袋为 B 阳性。当前生命体征：T 101.1 °F (38.4 °C)，HR 120 次/分，使用去甲肾上腺素时 BP 88/56 mmHg，鼻导管 6 L/min 下 RR 24 次/分、SpO2 94%。过去 1 小时尿量 8 mL，深琥珀色，尿试纸血红蛋白阳性。复查实验室：Hgb 5.2 g/dL，血小板 78 ×10³/µL，K 5.9 mEq/L，肌酐 3.4 mg/dL，总胆红素 6.1 mg/dL，LDH 2,600 U/L，INR 2.2，aPTT 68 秒，纤维蛋白原 88 mg/dL。患者嗜睡但可唤醒，仅能说出自己是谁。外周脉搏细弱；花斑延伸至膝部和肘部；导管部位仍渗血。ICU 团队正在评估是否需紧急透析和血液成分治疗。

title.en: ICU course and confirmed ABO incompatibility
title.zh: ICU 经过和 ABO 不相容确认
第3阶段：停止输血后 2 小时（约 1620）

summary.en: A 58-year-old woman with CKD stage 3b, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes is admitted for symptomatic anemia. Her true blood type is A-positive, but a mislabeled pretransfusion specimen leads to issue of an ABO-incompatible packed red blood cell unit. The transfusion begins at 1420 through a 20-gauge peripheral IV.
summary.zh: 一名 58 岁女性，有 3b 期慢性肾病、高血压和 2 型糖尿病，因症状性贫血入院。患者真实血型为 A 阳性，但输血前标本采集时贴错标签，导致发出 ABO 不相容的浓缩红细胞。输血于 1420 经 20G 外周 IV 开始。

title.en: Acute hemolytic transfusion reaction following ABO-incompatible red blood cell transfusion
title.zh: ABO 不相容红细胞输注后的急性溶血性输血反应

payload.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 输注不相容血液后红细胞迅速破坏，可能导致休克、肾损伤和 DIC。
游离血红蛋白进入尿液，常呈红褐色。
与游离血红蛋白结合的血浆蛋白；血管内溶血时常降低。
凝血系统广泛激活并消耗血小板和凝血因子，可同时血栓和出血。
形成纤维蛋白凝块所需蛋白；在 DIC 中下降提示消耗。

correct.en: This unfolding case teaches recognition and management of acute hemolytic transfusion reaction from ABO-incompatible red cells. The Stage 1 cue cluster—rapid fever/rigors, flank pain, hypotension, tachycardia, sense of impending doom, and hemoglobinuria—requires immediate transfusion cessation, safe maintenance of IV access with 0.9% normal saline through new tubing per protocol, notification of the provider and blood bank, and preservation of the unit/tubing/labels. Later stages show progression to shock, oliguric acute kidney injury, hyperkalemia, and DIC; outcomes must be evaluated by perfusion, urine output, potassium/creatinine, coagulation studies, and vasopressor needs rather than temperature alone.
correct.zh: 本病例训练识别和处理 ABO 不相容红细胞导致的急性溶血性输血反应。第1阶段的线索组合——快速发热寒战、腰痛、低血压、心动过速、濒危感和血红蛋白尿——要求立即停止输血，按流程用新管路和 0.9% 生理盐水安全维持 IV 通路，通知医护提供者和血库，并保留血袋/管路/标签。后续阶段进展为休克、少尿性急性肾损伤、高钾血症和 DIC；评价结果应看灌注、尿量、钾/肌酐、凝血指标和升压药需求，而不是单看体温。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

testTakingStrategy.en: In transfusion questions, connect timing, symptom cluster, and first nursing action. Severe systemic findings mean stop the transfusion and escalate; do not slow the rate or treat only fever.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 输血题要把发生时间、症状组合和首要护理措施联系起来。严重全身表现意味着停止输血并升级处理；不要只是减慢速率或只退热。

content.en:
Patient: Margaret Ellison, 82 years old.
Admitted from home with NYHA class IV heart-failure exacerbation, worsening dyspnea, edema, and poor oral intake for 5 days.
History: ischemic cardiomyopathy with EF 15%, CKD stage 4 with baseline creatinine 2.8 mg/dL, type 2 diabetes on basal insulin, progressive dysphagia followed by speech-language pathology for 6 months. Three hospitalizations in the past 4 months for fluid overload. Outpatient palliative-care referral was recently canceled by family.
Advance directive: son David is named durable power of attorney for health care, to be activated only if Mrs. Ellison loses decisional capacity.
Current orders: IV furosemide 40 mg every 12 hr, fluid restriction 1,200 mL/day, low-sodium cardiac diet with pureed foods and nectar-thick liquids per speech-language pathology, daily weights, telemetry.
Initial statement to admitting nurse: "I don't want any more tubes or machines. I've had a good life. I want to be comfortable."
Initial assessment: alert, conversational, oriented to person/place/time/situation. Mini-Cog 4/5. Mood calm and reflective; denies depression or hopelessness and states she feels "at peace." Vitals: T 36.8 C, HR 92 irregular, BP 104/62, RR 22, SpO2 93% on 2 L nasal cannula. Weight 68.4 kg; documented dry weight 64.2 kg. Bilateral lower-lung crackles, JVD at 45 degrees, 3+ bilateral pitting edema to mid-shin, temporal wasting. Oral mucosa moist. She can manage small sips of nectar-thick water but needs prolonged time to initiate swallowing.
Admission labs: BNP 2,840 pg/mL, Na 131 mEq/L, K 5.1 mEq/L, BUN 48 mg/dL, creatinine 3.2 mg/dL, eGFR 14 mL/min/1.73 m2, glucose 142 mg/dL, albumin 2.6 g/dL, Hgb 9.8 g/dL, WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL, platelets 188 ×10³/µL, INR 1.1, prealbumin 11 mg/dL.
content.zh:
患者：Margaret Ellison，82 岁。
因 NYHA IV 级心力衰竭加重从家中入院，过去 5 天出现气促加重、水肿和进食不足。
病史：缺血性心肌病，射血分数 15%；慢性肾病 4 期，基线肌酐 2.8 mg/dL；2 型糖尿病，使用基础胰岛素；进行性吞咽困难，过去 6 个月由言语语言病理科随访。过去 4 个月因液体负荷过多住院 3 次。近期曾转诊门诊姑息治疗，但被家属取消。
预立医疗指示：儿子 David 被指定为医疗保健持久授权代理人，但只有在 Ellison 太太丧失决策能力时才生效。
现有医嘱：呋塞米 40 mg IV 每 12 小时一次；限液 1,200 mL/日；低钠心脏饮食，按言语语言病理科建议给予糊状食物和花蜜稠液；每日体重；遥测监护。
入院时对护士的表述：“我不想再要任何管子或机器了。我这一生过得很好。我想舒服一点。”
初始评估：清醒、能交谈，人物、地点、时间和情境定向力均正常。Mini-Cog 4/5。情绪平静、能反思；否认抑郁或绝望，并表示自己“很平静”。生命体征：T 36.8 C，HR 92 次/分且不规则，BP 104/62，RR 22 次/分，SpO2 93%，经鼻导管吸氧 2 L/min。体重 68.4 kg；记录的干体重 64.2 kg。双下肺湿啰音，45 度可见颈静脉怒张，双下肢至小腿中段 3+ 凹陷性水肿，颞部消瘦。口腔黏膜湿润。可少量饮用花蜜稠水，但启动吞咽时间延长。
入院实验室：BNP 2,840 pg/mL，Na 131 mEq/L，K 5.1 mEq/L，BUN 48 mg/dL，肌酐 3.2 mg/dL，eGFR 14 mL/min/1.73 m2，血糖 142 mg/dL，白蛋白 2.6 g/dL，Hgb 9.8 g/dL，WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL，血小板 188 ×10³/µL，INR 1.1，前白蛋白 11 mg/dL。

title.zh: 入院记录

glossary.defZh: 针对某一项具体治疗决定评估患者是否能理解、权衡并表达选择。
患者无能力时由指定代理人代替作医疗决定的权力。
某项治疗在医学上可考虑或建议的理由。

segments.en: Chart review findings:
segments.zh: 病历审查发现：

segments.en: The physician documents that Mrs. Ellison understands the risks and benefits of PEG placement, including continued weight loss without it.
segments.zh: 医师记录 Ellison 太太理解 PEG 置管的风险与获益，包括不置管可能继续体重下降。

segments.en: She asks clarifying questions about whether the tube will cure her heart failure and whether she may still eat by mouth.
segments.zh: 她提出澄清性问题，询问管子是否能治愈心力衰竭，以及是否仍可经口进食。

segments.en: She states, "I understand what you're telling me. I don't want a feeding tube. I want to eat what I can and be comfortable."
segments.zh: 她说：“我理解你们说的内容。我不想要喂食管。我想吃多少算多少，并且舒服一点。”

segments.en: The advance directive states that the son's DPOAHC authority activates only if Mrs. Ellison loses decisional capacity.
segments.zh: 预立医疗指示说明，儿子的 DPOAHC 权限只有在 Ellison 太太丧失决策能力时才生效。

segments.en: Mini-Cog score is 4/5 with a normal clock draw.
segments.zh: Mini-Cog 得分为 4/5，画钟正常。

segments.en: David says he is the power of attorney and wants the tube placed.
segments.zh: David 说自己是授权代理人，并要求放置管子。

segments.en: Albumin is 2.6 g/dL and prealbumin is 11 mg/dL.
segments.zh: 白蛋白 2.6 g/dL，前白蛋白 11 mg/dL。

segments.en: Speech-language pathology has followed progressive dysphagia for 6 months.
segments.zh: 言语语言病理科已随访进行性吞咽困难 6 个月。

byChoice.en: This directly supports decision-specific capacity because it documents understanding of risks and benefits.
byChoice.zh: 这直接支持针对该决定的决策能力，因为记录了她理解风险与获益。

byChoice.en: Clarifying questions show that she is engaging with the information rather than passively refusing.
byChoice.zh: 提出澄清问题说明她在主动理解信息，而不是被动拒绝。

byChoice.en: This is the patient's own informed, values-based refusal, which governs while she has capacity.
byChoice.zh: 这是患者本人知情且基于价值观的拒绝；只要她有能力，该决定就应被遵循。

byChoice.en: The activation clause shows that the son does not currently have decision-making authority.
byChoice.zh: 生效条件说明儿子目前没有代替患者作决定的权力。

byChoice.en: A normal cognitive screen supports the absence of an obvious red flag, but it does not by itself establish legal decision-making authority for this PEG decision.
byChoice.zh: 认知筛查正常可提示没有明显认知警讯，但不能单独确立患者对 PEG 决定的法律决策能力。

byChoice.en: The son's claim is a cue to check the document, not proof that his authority has activated.
byChoice.zh: 儿子的说法提示护士应核对文件，但不能证明他的代理权已经生效。

byChoice.en: These nutritional labs support why PEG is being recommended; they do not determine who has consent authority.
byChoice.zh: 这些营养指标支持为什么会建议 PEG，但不能决定谁有同意或拒绝的权力。

byChoice.en: Dysphagia supports the clinical rationale for discussing PEG but does not override a capacitated refusal.
byChoice.zh: 吞咽困难支持讨论 PEG 的医学理由，但不能推翻有决策能力患者的拒绝。

correct.en: The governing cues are decision-specific capacity documentation, Mrs. Ellison's demonstrated understanding and clarifying questions, her clear values-based refusal, and the advance directive clause showing that the son's surrogate authority is dormant while she has capacity.
correct.zh: 关键线索是：针对 PEG 决定的能力评估记录、患者表现出理解并提出澄清问题、她清楚且基于价值观地拒绝，以及预立医疗指示说明只要她仍有能力，儿子的代理权就尚未生效。

stem.en: Stage 1: Highlight the findings that establish that Mrs. Ellison's refusal is the governing decision.
stem.zh: 阶段 1：请标出哪些发现能确立 Ellison 太太的拒绝是当前应遵循的决定。

testTakingStrategy.en: For capacity and consent questions, key the findings that show understanding, reasoning, voluntariness, and who legally holds authority now—not the findings that make the proposed treatment medically reasonable.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到决策能力和同意权题目时，优先寻找能证明理解、推理、自愿性以及当前谁有法律权力的线索，而不是只看治疗在医学上是否合理。

glossary.defZh: 患者根据自己的价值观作医疗决定的权利。
指定医疗代理人的文件，通常在患者无能力时才用于代理决策。
满足文件规定条件后，代理人才开始具有决策权限。

options.en: The decision should be delayed until Mrs. Ellison's daughter can be physically present.
options.zh: 应推迟决定，直到 Ellison 太太的女儿能亲自到场。

options.en: Mrs. Ellison's refusal governs because her decision-making capacity is intact and documented.
options.zh: 应遵循 Ellison 太太的拒绝，因为她的决策能力完整且已有记录。

options.en: David's decision governs because a DPOAHC always has priority over the patient's current choice.
options.zh: 应遵循 David 的决定，因为 DPOAHC 总是优先于患者当前选择。

options.en: The physician may proceed because PEG placement is medically recommended for poor intake and dysphagia.
options.zh: 医师可以继续安排，因为 PEG 对进食不足和吞咽困难有医学建议理由。

options.en: The children should decide together because both adult children agree with PEG placement.
options.zh: 应由两名成年子女共同决定，因为他们都同意 PEG 置管。

byChoice.en: A DPOAHC does not override the current decision of a capacitated patient.
byChoice.zh: DPOAHC 不能推翻有决策能力患者当前作出的决定。

byChoice.en: This correctly applies autonomy and the documented capacity assessment.
byChoice.zh: 这正确应用了自主原则和已记录的决策能力评估。

byChoice.en: Waiting for the daughter is unnecessary because the patient has already made an informed decision and can speak for herself.
byChoice.zh: 无需等待女儿到场，因为患者已作出知情决定，并能为自己表达意愿。

byChoice.en: Family agreement does not create authority over a capacitated adult's treatment refusal.
byChoice.zh: 家属意见一致并不会赋予他们推翻有能力成年患者拒绝治疗的权力。

byChoice.en: Medical recommendation is not a substitute for consent when the patient has capacity.
byChoice.zh: 当患者有决策能力时，医学建议不能替代患者同意。

correct.en: A capacitated adult holds the authority to accept or refuse treatment. The DPOAHC is meaningful but dormant because the activation condition—loss of decisional capacity—has not occurred.
correct.zh: 有决策能力的成年人有权接受或拒绝治疗。DPOAHC 文件本身有法律意义，但由于触发生效条件——丧失决策能力——尚未发生，因此目前尚未生效。

stem.en: Stage 1: David insists that his DPOAHC status allows him to override his mother's refusal and request PEG placement. Whose decision governs at this time?
stem.zh: 阶段 1：David 坚称自己的 DPOAHC 身份允许他推翻母亲的拒绝并要求放置 PEG。此时应遵循谁的决定？

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not let the phrase 'power of attorney' automatically shift authority away from a patient. Ask whether the patient currently lacks capacity and whether the document is activated.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要因为看到“授权代理人”就自动把决定权从患者身上转移。先判断患者当前是否无能力，以及文件是否已经生效。

glossary.defZh: 专业人员根据伦理原则必须承担的责任。
通过压力、威胁或操控影响患者决定。
医务人员在明确原则或计划上犹豫不定，可能影响患者权利保护。

options.en: Advocate for Mrs. Ellison's informed, voluntary refusal so it is not overridden by family pressure or provider ambivalence.
options.zh: 为 Ellison 太太知情、自愿的拒绝进行倡导，防止其意愿被家属压力或医师摇摆态度覆盖。

options.en: Prioritize correcting malnutrition because albumin and prealbumin are low.
options.zh: 优先纠正营养不良，因为白蛋白和前白蛋白偏低。

options.en: Schedule the consult because allowing GI to speak with her is a neutral way to keep the family calm.
options.zh: 安排会诊，因为让胃肠科与她谈谈是一种中立方式，也能让家属平静。

options.en: Tell the family the nurse cannot discuss the situation and avoid further contact with them.
options.zh: 告诉家属护士不能讨论此事，并避免继续接触他们。

options.en: Stay neutral and let the physician and family resolve the disagreement without nursing involvement.
options.zh: 保持中立，让医师和家属自行解决分歧，护士不介入。

byChoice.en: The family deserves compassionate communication and support; avoidance does not protect the patient or resolve the conflict.
byChoice.zh: 家属仍需要同理沟通和支持；回避既不能保护患者，也不能解决冲突。

byChoice.en: Nursing neutrality in the face of an autonomy threat becomes a failure to advocate.
byChoice.zh: 当患者自主权受到威胁时，护士所谓“中立”会变成未履行倡导职责。

byChoice.en: This centers the capacitated patient's right to refuse treatment and addresses the actual threat in Stage 2.
byChoice.zh: 这把有能力患者拒绝治疗的权利放在中心，并回应了阶段 2 的真正威胁。

byChoice.en: A consult requested as a pressure tactic after refusal is not neutral; it may undermine autonomy.
byChoice.zh: 患者已拒绝后，为施压或安抚家属而安排会诊并不中立，可能削弱自主权。

byChoice.en: The nutritional problem is real, but a clinical problem does not override informed refusal.
byChoice.zh: 营养问题确实存在，但临床问题不能推翻知情拒绝。

correct.en: The immediate ethical risk is that the patient's autonomous refusal may be undermined. Nursing advocacy means protecting the patient's voice, while still addressing family distress through appropriate interdisciplinary support.
correct.zh: 当前最直接的伦理风险是患者自主拒绝可能被削弱。护理倡导意味着保护患者的声音，同时通过合适的跨专业支持处理家属痛苦。

stem.en: Stage 2: The physician suggests scheduling the PEG consult anyway to calm the family. What is the nurse's priority ethical obligation?
stem.zh: 阶段 2：医师建议仍先安排 PEG 会诊以安抚家属。护士最优先的伦理职责是什么？

testTakingStrategy.en: When several concerns compete, identify what is being threatened right now. Here, the threat is not malnutrition alone; it is loss of the patient's autonomous choice.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当多个问题竞争优先级时，要找出当前正在受威胁的是什么。本题中受威胁的不只是营养状态，而是患者自主选择权。

glossary.defZh: 对患者陈述、评估和护理行动的客观、及时记录。
着重缓解症状、明确照护目标并提升生活质量的跨专业照护。
由跨专业团队与患者和家属沟通病情、目标和计划的结构化会议。

options.en: Communicate directly with the physician that scheduling a PEG consult over the documented refusal raises an ethical concern.
options.zh: 直接与医师沟通：在已有拒绝记录的情况下安排 PEG 会诊存在伦理问题。

options.en: Confirm with Mrs. Ellison that her decision remains informed and voluntary and assess whether pressure has affected her choice.
options.zh: 与 Ellison 太太确认其决定仍是知情且自愿的，并评估压力是否影响了她的选择。

options.en: Encourage Mrs. Ellison to meet with GI and reconsider PEG placement for her family's sake.
options.zh: 鼓励 Ellison 太太为了家属而见胃肠科医师并重新考虑 PEG 置管。

options.en: Document her repeated refusal with direct quotes and nursing observations of alertness, orientation, calm affect, and values-based reasoning.
options.zh: 记录她反复拒绝的内容，包括直接引语，以及护士观察到的清醒、定向力正常、情绪平静和基于价值观的推理。

options.en: Defer to David's demand because he holds the DPOAHC document and is threatening escalation.
options.zh: 因为 David 持有 DPOAHC 文件且威胁升级，所以听从他的要求。

options.en: Request palliative-care/social-work support and help arrange a structured family meeting with Mrs. Ellison's consent and participation as she desires.
options.zh: 申请姑息治疗和社工支持，并在 Ellison 太太同意且愿意参与的情况下协助安排结构化家庭会议。

byChoice.en: The DPOAHC is not activated while the patient has capacity; legal threats do not transfer authority to the son.
byChoice.zh: 患者有能力时 DPOAHC 尚未生效；法律威胁不会把决定权转移给儿子。

byChoice.en: Clear documentation protects the patient's stated wishes and creates an accurate record of capacity-related observations.
byChoice.zh: 清楚记录可保护患者明确表达的意愿，并准确记录与能力相关的观察。

byChoice.en: Interdisciplinary support helps address family distress while keeping the patient's goals central.
byChoice.zh: 跨专业支持有助于处理家属痛苦，同时保持患者目标居于中心。

byChoice.en: Direct communication addresses the immediate risk that the consult may be placed despite refusal.
byChoice.zh: 直接沟通可处理会诊可能在患者拒绝后仍被安排的即时风险。

byChoice.en: Ongoing assessment of voluntariness is appropriate because family pressure is present.
byChoice.zh: 由于存在家属压力，持续评估决定是否自愿是适当的。

byChoice.en: This turns the nurse into an agent of family pressure and undermines the patient's autonomy.
byChoice.zh: 这会让护士变成家属压力的执行者，并削弱患者自主权。

correct.en: Appropriate advocacy is coordinated: reassess voluntariness, document clearly, address the physician's plan directly, and bring in palliative care, social work, and a family meeting to support goals-of-care clarification without pressuring the patient.
correct.zh: 适当的倡导是多方面协调进行的：重新评估自愿性，清楚记录，直接处理医师拟安排会诊的问题，并引入姑息治疗、社工和家庭会议，在不施压患者的前提下澄清照护目标。

stem.en: Stage 2: Which nursing actions are appropriate to uphold Mrs. Ellison's wishes and address the family conflict? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 阶段 2：哪些护理措施适合用于维护 Ellison 太太的意愿并处理家属冲突？选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: For SATA advocacy items, select actions that protect the patient, create a record, communicate up the chain, and use team resources. Eliminate actions that persuade, pressure, or defer to the wrong decision-maker.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做多选倡导题时，选择能保护患者、形成记录、向上沟通并使用团队资源的措施。排除劝说、施压或把决定权交给错误对象的措施。

glossary.defZh: 一种结构化沟通方式：情况、背景、评估、建议。
由伦理团队协助处理医疗决策冲突或价值冲突的过程。
当前最可能立即造成伤害或权利受损的问题。

options.en: Finish documenting the refusal first and wait to speak with the physician after the family meeting is arranged.
options.zh: 先完成拒绝记录，等家庭会议安排好后再与医师沟通。

options.en: Ask David to bring the DPOAHC paperwork to the unit before taking further action.
options.zh: 先请 David 把 DPOAHC 文件带到病区，再采取进一步行动。

options.en: Respectfully tell the physician without delay that Mrs. Ellison again declined PEG placement, capacity is documented, and scheduling the consult over refusal raises an ethical concern.
options.zh: 立即且尊重地告知医师：Ellison 太太再次拒绝 PEG，决策能力已有记录，在其拒绝后仍安排会诊存在伦理问题。

options.en: Call the ethics committee first before addressing the concern with the physician.
options.zh: 先联系伦理委员会，再与医师处理此问题。

options.en: Ask Mrs. Ellison whether she will agree to a one-time GI consult so the family can feel reassured.
options.zh: 询问 Ellison 太太是否愿意接受一次胃肠科会诊，好让家属安心。

byChoice.en: Reintroducing the consult to reassure the family can become coercive after the patient has clearly refused.
byChoice.zh: 患者明确拒绝后，为安抚家属再次提出会诊可能形成胁迫。

byChoice.en: The chart already states the DPOAHC activation condition, and waiting on paperwork delays advocacy.
byChoice.zh: 病历已说明 DPOAHC 的生效条件；等待文件会延误倡导。

byChoice.en: Documentation is necessary but does not stop the consult from being placed now.
byChoice.zh: 记录是必要的，但不能阻止会诊现在被安排。

byChoice.en: Ethics consultation may be appropriate if conflict persists, but direct provider communication comes first for the immediate issue.
byChoice.zh: 若冲突持续，伦理会诊可能合适；但对于当前即时问题，应先直接与医师沟通。

byChoice.en: This directly addresses the immediate risk and stays within the nurse's advocacy role.
byChoice.zh: 这直接处理当前风险，并符合护士的倡导职责范围。

correct.en: The physician's proposed consult is the proximate threat to autonomy. The nurse should use clear structured communication to stop the consult from being placed over the patient's refusal and recommend palliative care and a family meeting instead.
correct.zh: 医师拟安排会诊是当前最直接威胁患者自主权的因素。护士应使用清楚、有结构的沟通，防止在患者拒绝后仍安排会诊，并建议转向姑息治疗和家庭会议。

stem.en: Stage 2: After reassessing Mrs. Ellison and confirming that she remains alert, informed, voluntary, and consistent in refusing PEG placement, what is the nurse's first advocacy action?
stem.zh: 阶段 2：护士重新评估 Ellison 太太，并确认她仍然清醒、知情、自愿且一致地拒绝 PEG 置管后，第一项倡导行动应是什么？

testTakingStrategy.en: For 'first action' questions, choose the step that addresses the most immediate threat. Here, the consult order is the immediate threat, so direct provider communication comes before slower support processes.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做“第一步行动”题时，选择能处理最即时威胁的步骤。本题中会诊医嘱是即时威胁，因此应先直接与医师沟通，再进行较慢的支持流程。

glossary.defZh: 判断护理措施是否达到预期目标的过程。
将症状缓解、生活质量和患者目标置于中心的照护方式。
为预期寿命有限且选择舒适照护的患者提供的支持性服务。

rows.en: Nursing notes and the palliative-care assessment consistently document her capacity, values-based reasoning, and refusal.
rows.zh: 护理记录和姑息治疗评估均一致记录她有决策能力、基于价值观推理并拒绝 PEG。

rows.en: No PEG consult has been placed over the patient's refusal.
rows.zh: 未在患者拒绝后仍安排 PEG 会诊。

rows.en: A comfort-focused plan and hospice referral are being developed according to her expressed wishes.
rows.zh: 正在根据她表达的意愿制定以舒适为重点的计划并转介临终关怀。

rows.en: Mrs. Ellison says she is glad someone is listening and asks about hospice options at home.
rows.zh: Ellison 太太说很高兴有人在听她说话，并询问在家接受临终关怀的选择。

rows.en: David threatens legal action to obtain a PEG tube placement.
rows.zh: David 威胁采取法律行动以要求放置 PEG 管。

rows.en: The admission albumin and prealbumin values were low.
rows.zh: 入院时白蛋白和前白蛋白数值偏低。

byChoice.en: Consistent documentation protects her decision across the care team.
byChoice.zh: 一致记录有助于整个照护团队持续保护她的决定。

byChoice.en: Not placing the consult over refusal shows the immediate autonomy threat has been contained.
byChoice.zh: 未在拒绝后仍安排会诊，说明即时的自主权威胁已被控制。

byChoice.en: A comfort-focused plan and hospice referral align care with the patient's expressed goals.
byChoice.zh: 以舒适为重点的计划和临终关怀转介符合患者表达的目标。

byChoice.en: The patient's sense of being heard is a meaningful outcome of advocacy.
byChoice.zh: 患者感到被倾听是护理倡导的重要结果。

byChoice.en: A legal threat reflects ongoing family distress, not failure of the nurse's advocacy.
byChoice.zh: 法律威胁反映家属仍有痛苦和冲突，并不代表护士倡导失败。

byChoice.en: Admission nutritional labs describe clinical status and prognosis; they do not measure whether autonomy is being protected.
byChoice.zh: 入院营养指标反映临床状态和预后，但不衡量患者自主权是否被保护。

correct.en: Effective advocacy is shown by documentation, alignment of the plan with the patient's goals, absence of an unauthorized PEG consult, and the patient's perception that her voice is being heard. Ongoing family distress and nutritional lab abnormalities may still exist, but they do not mean advocacy has failed.
correct.zh: 倡导有效的证据包括：记录一致、照护计划符合患者目标、未安排未经同意的 PEG 会诊，以及患者感到自己的声音被听见。家属痛苦和营养实验室异常可能仍然存在，但这并不代表倡导失败。

stem.en: Stage 3: For each finding, indicate whether it shows effective advocacy for Mrs. Ellison's autonomous refusal.
stem.zh: 阶段 3：请判断每项发现是否表明对 Ellison 太太自主拒绝的护理倡导有效。

testTakingStrategy.en: Outcome evaluation should match the goal of the intervention. The goal was not to make everyone agree or normalize labs; it was to protect the patient's informed refusal.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价结果要与干预目标一致。本题目标不是让所有人都同意，也不是让实验室指标正常，而是保护患者的知情拒绝。

content.en:
The attending physician discusses progressive dysphagia and poor nutritional status with the family and recommends PEG tube placement to maintain nutrition and hydration. Mrs. Ellison listens to the explanation and asks, "Will the tube cure my heart?" and "Will I still be able to eat anything by mouth?" She then states, "I understand what you're telling me. I don't want a feeding tube. I want to eat what I can and be comfortable."
Physician documentation: "Patient demonstrates understanding of risks and benefits of PEG placement, including that PEG does not necessarily eliminate aspiration risk, and continued weight loss without it. She articulates her values and reasoning clearly. Decision-making capacity intact. Patient declines PEG at this time."
Son David tells the nurse: "She doesn't know what she's saying. She's old and she's giving up. You need to talk some sense into her. I'm her power of attorney — I want the tube placed." Daughter Karen calls and says, "My brother and I agree. We want everything done. She's just scared. Can't you convince her?" The nurse confirms that the advance directive activates the son's authority only if Mrs. Ellison loses decisional capacity.
Vitals: HR 88, BP 108/64, RR 20, SpO2 94% on 2 L. Weight 67.8 kg. She is resting comfortably, tolerating small amounts of pureed food and nectar-thick liquids. Telemetry: atrial fibrillation with controlled ventricular rate.
content.zh:
主治医师与家属讨论患者进行性吞咽困难和营养状况不佳，并建议放置 PEG 管以维持营养和水分。Ellison 太太听完解释后问：“这个管子能治好我的心脏吗？”以及“我以后还能不能吃一点东西？”随后她说：“我理解你们说的内容。我不想要喂食管。我想吃多少算多少，并且舒服一点。”
医师记录：“患者表现出理解 PEG 置管风险与获益的能力，包括 PEG 不一定能消除误吸风险，以及不置管可能继续体重下降。她能清楚表达自己的价值观和理由。决策能力完整。患者此时拒绝 PEG。”
儿子 David 对护士说：“她不知道自己在说什么。她老了，只是在放弃。你们要劝醒她。我是她的授权代理人——我要放这个管子。” 女儿 Karen 打电话到病区说：“我和我哥哥意见一致。我们希望什么都做。她只是害怕。你不能说服她吗？” 护士确认预立医疗指示规定：只有在 Ellison 太太丧失决策能力时，儿子的代理权才生效。
生命体征：HR 88 次/分，BP 108/64，RR 20 次/分，SpO2 94%，吸氧 2 L/min。体重 67.8 kg。患者安静休息，可少量耐受糊状食物和花蜜稠液。遥测：心房颤动，心室率受控。

title.zh: PEG 沟通及家属反应
阶段 1：住院第 1 天下午

content.en:
David again tells the attending physician that nobody is listening to the family. The physician privately tells the nurse, "The family is really upset. Maybe we should just schedule the PEG consult and see if she changes her mind once GI comes by. It might calm things down."
The nurse reassesses Mrs. Ellison. She remains alert, oriented, calm, and states without prompting: "I told the doctor yesterday. No tube. I want to go home and be comfortable. I've thought about this for months — this isn't a snap decision." She adds, "My children mean well, but this is my body and my life." When asked about pressure or coercion, she states, "David keeps coming in and telling me I'm being selfish. It upsets me, but it doesn't change my mind." She asks the nurse, "Will you make sure they respect what I want?"
Vitals: HR 90, BP 100/60, RR 20, SpO2 94% on 2 L. Weight 67.2 kg. She ate about 30% of pureed breakfast. BNP 2,410 pg/mL, creatinine 3.4 mg/dL, K 5.3 mEq/L, Na 130 mEq/L.
content.zh:
David 再次告诉主治医师，认为没有人听家属意见。医师私下对护士说：“家属真的很不高兴。也许我们可以先安排 PEG 会诊，等胃肠科来看后再看看她会不会改变主意。这样可能能让事情平静下来。”
护士重新评估 Ellison 太太。她仍然清醒、定向力正常、情绪平静，并主动说：“我昨天已经告诉医生了。不要管子。我想回家，舒服一点。这件事我已经想了好几个月——不是一时冲动的决定。” 她又说：“我的孩子们是好意，但这是我的身体、我的人生。” 护士询问她是否受到压力或胁迫，她说：“David 一直进来，说我自私。这让我难过，但不会改变我的想法。” 她问护士：“你能确保他们尊重我的意愿吗？”
生命体征：HR 90 次/分，BP 100/60，RR 20 次/分，SpO2 94%，吸氧 2 L/min。体重 67.2 kg。糊状早餐约吃了 30%。BNP 2,410 pg/mL，肌酐 3.4 mg/dL，K 5.3 mEq/L，Na 130 mEq/L。

title.zh: 再次拒绝及医师建议
阶段 2：住院第 2 天上午

content.en:
The nurse has documented Mrs. Ellison's repeated, consistent refusal with direct quotes and capacity observations; informed the charge nurse of the ethical concern; requested palliative care; and arranged a family meeting for the next morning with the attending physician, palliative care team, social worker, and both adult children. David states he has contacted a lawyer and "will get a court order" to have the PEG placed.
Mrs. Ellison is resting and tells the nurse she is glad someone is listening to her. She asks about hospice options at home. Vitals: HR 86, BP 102/58, RR 18, SpO2 95% on 2 L. Weight 66.8 kg. She tolerated small amounts of pureed lunch. Telemetry unchanged.
Palliative-care nurse practitioner note: "Mrs. Ellison demonstrates intact decisional capacity, consistent values-based reasoning, and an informed, voluntary refusal of PEG tube placement. Recommend goals-of-care meeting with family, comfort-focused plan of care, and hospice referral per patient's expressed wishes."
content.zh:
护士已在护理记录中记录 Ellison 太太反复且一致的拒绝，包括直接引语和决策能力相关观察；已告知护士长存在伦理问题；已申请姑息治疗；并安排次日上午由主治医师、姑息治疗团队、社工和两名成年子女参加家庭会议。David 表示他已联系律师，并“会拿到法院命令”要求放置 PEG。
Ellison 太太正在休息，并告诉护士，很高兴有人在听她说话。她询问在家接受临终关怀的选择。生命体征：HR 86 次/分，BP 102/58，RR 18 次/分，SpO2 95%，吸氧 2 L/min。体重 66.8 kg。午餐少量糊状食物可耐受。遥测无变化。
姑息治疗护士执业者记录：“Ellison 太太表现出完整的决策能力，基于一致价值观进行推理，并对 PEG 置管作出知情、自愿的拒绝。建议与家属进行照护目标会议，制定以舒适为重点的照护计划，并根据患者明确表达的意愿转介临终关怀。”

title.zh: 护理倡导措施及姑息治疗评估
阶段 3：住院第 2 天傍晚

summary.en: An 82-year-old client with end-stage heart failure, progressive dysphagia, and poor oral intake refuses PEG tube placement after an informed discussion. Her adult children pressure the team to proceed, and her son claims authority under a DPOAHC that activates only if she loses decisional capacity.
summary.zh: 一名 82 岁患者患有终末期心力衰竭、进行性吞咽困难和进食不足。在充分知情沟通后，她拒绝放置 PEG 管。她的成年子女要求医疗团队继续置管，其儿子声称自己可根据医疗保健持久授权书（DPOAHC）作决定，但该授权仅在患者丧失决策能力时才生效。

title.en: Client advocacy for a capacitated older adult refusing PEG placement
title.zh: 为有决策能力且拒绝 PEG 置管的老年患者进行护理倡导

glossary.defZh: 护士主动保护患者权利、意愿和安全，尤其是在患者声音可能被忽视时。
患者理解信息、权衡风险获益、表达选择并说明理由的能力；通常针对具体决定评估。
指定代理人在患者丧失决策能力时代表患者作医疗决定的法律文件。
glossary.termEn: durable power of attorney for health care

glossary.defZh: 患者在理解相关风险、获益和替代方案后，自愿拒绝治疗。
经皮内镜胃造瘘管，用于经胃提供营养、水分或药物。

correct.en: This case centers on protecting a capacitated adult's informed refusal when family pressure and provider ambivalence threaten to override it. The decisive cues are the documented decision-specific capacity assessment, Mrs. Ellison's repeated values-based refusal, absence of coercion changing her decision, and an advance directive that gives the son surrogate authority only if capacity is lost. Appropriate nursing advocacy includes direct communication with the physician, careful documentation, palliative-care and social-work involvement, a structured family meeting, and escalation to ethics or risk management if needed. Effective advocacy is measured by whether the plan of care honors the patient's stated goals and whether she feels heard, not by whether the family agrees.
correct.zh: 本病例的核心是在家属压力和医师态度摇摆可能覆盖患者意愿时，保护有决策能力成人的知情拒绝权。关键线索包括：已记录的针对该决定的决策能力评估、Ellison 太太反复且基于价值观的拒绝、没有胁迫改变其决定，以及预立医疗指示明确儿子只有在她丧失能力时才具有代理权。适当的护理倡导包括直接与医师沟通、仔细记录、介入姑息治疗和社工、安排结构化家庭会议，并在需要时升级至伦理委员会或风险管理。倡导是否有效，应看照护计划是否尊重患者目标、患者是否感到被倾听，而不是看家属是否满意。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

testTakingStrategy.en: Separate medical indication from consent authority. A treatment can be clinically reasonable and still cannot proceed when a capacitated client refuses it.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 要区分“医学上有理由建议治疗”和“谁有权同意治疗”。某项治疗即使在医学上合理，只要有决策能力的患者拒绝，就不能强行进行。

content.en: Admitted 2 days ago for hypertensive urgency; arrival BP 218/114. History: CKD stage 3b, baseline creatinine 1.5 mg/dL/eGFR 37 mL/min; HFpEF; type 2 diabetes. Orders updated at 1400: amlodipine 10 mg PO daily, increased from 5 mg after BP trend 168-174/92-96; lisinopril 20 mg PO daily; metformin 500 mg PO twice daily held per pharmacy renal-dose flag pending repeat labs; sliding-scale insulin per protocol. Telemetry in place. Plan: observe BP response to amlodipine increase over the next 24 hours before discharge consideration.
content.zh: 入院 2 天，原因是高血压急症；到达急诊时 BP 218/114。病史：CKD 3b 期，基线肌酐 1.5 mg/dL/eGFR 37 mL/min；射血分数保留型心力衰竭；2 型糖尿病。1400 更新医嘱：氨氯地平 10 mg PO 每日一次，因 BP 趋势 168-174/92-96 由 5 mg 增量；赖诺普利 20 mg PO 每日一次；二甲双胍 500 mg PO 每日两次，因药房肾功能剂量提醒暂停，等待复查实验室结果；按流程使用滑动比例胰岛素。已使用遥测监护。计划：观察氨氯地平增量后 24 小时内 BP 反应，再考虑出院。

title.zh: 患者背景和当前医嘱

content.en: 1930 assessment: T 36.8 C, HR 78 regular, BP 152/88 left arm sitting, RR 16, SpO2 96% room air. Alert and oriented x4. Heart regular S1/S2, no S3 or murmur. Lungs clear. Trace bilateral pedal edema unchanged. Pain 0/10. Telemetry: normal sinus rhythm without ectopy. MAR: amlodipine 10 mg given at 1700; next amlodipine 0900 tomorrow. Lisinopril 20 mg given at 0900; next dose 0900 tomorrow. No PRN antihypertensive ordered. 0600 labs: Na 139, K 4.4, Cl 102, CO2 22, BUN 34, creatinine 1.6, eGFR 34, glucose 148, calcium 8.8, magnesium 1.9, phosphorus 4.2. CBC: WBC 7,200, Hgb 11.4, platelets 198,000. BNP 320, stable from 340. UA: no protein, no blood, specific gravity 1.018.
content.zh: 1930 评估：T 36.8 C，HR 78 次/分且规则，左臂坐位 BP 152/88，RR 16，室内空气 SpO2 96%。清醒，定向力 x4。心律规则，S1/S2，可未闻及 S3 或杂音。双肺清。双足轻度水肿，较入院无变化。疼痛 0/10。遥测：正常窦性心律，无异位搏动。MAR：1700 已给氨氯地平 10 mg；下一次为明日 0900。0900 已给赖诺普利 20 mg；下一次为明日 0900。未开立 PRN 降压药。0600 实验室：Na 139，K 4.4，Cl 102，CO2 22，BUN 34，肌酐 1.6，eGFR 34，葡萄糖 148，钙 8.8，镁 1.9，磷 4.2。CBC：WBC 7,200，Hgb 11.4，血小板 198,000。BNP 320，较 340 稳定。尿检：无蛋白、无血，尿比重 1.018。

title.zh: 1930 基线评估和 0600 实验室结果

glossary.defZh: 同事之间贬低、排斥、羞辱或破坏专业沟通的行为。
护士在交接护理责任时传递患者关键资料、近期变化和后续计划的过程。
描述可观察行为及其影响，而不是评价对方人格或动机的沟通方式。

segments.en: Renee speaks rapidly during the bedside handoff.
segments.zh: Renee 在床旁交接时语速很快。

segments.en: Renee stands with crossed arms and does not make eye contact.
segments.zh: Renee 双臂交叉站着，并且没有眼神交流。

segments.en: Renee says, "Meds are on the MAR — you can read."
segments.zh: Renee 说：“药物在 MAR 上——你自己会看。”

segments.en: Renee visibly rolls her eyes when Priya asks whether any medications changed, and Mrs. Vega sees it.
segments.zh: Priya 询问药物是否有变更时，Renee 明显翻白眼，而且 Vega 太太看见了。

segments.en: Renee says, "I'm not going to spoon-feed you."
segments.zh: Renee 说：“我不会手把手喂给你。”

segments.en: Renee leaves the room without allowing time for questions.
segments.zh: Renee 没有留下提问时间就离开病房。

segments.en: Renee does not verbally communicate that amlodipine was increased from 5 mg to 10 mg and given at 1700.
segments.zh: Renee 没有口头交代氨氯地平已从 5 mg 增至 10 mg，并已在 1700 给药。

segments.en: Renee does not verbally communicate the hospitalist's instruction to monitor BP q4h for 24 hours.
segments.zh: Renee 没有口头交代住院医嘱要求 24 小时内每 4 小时监测 BP。

segments.en: In the hallway Renee says, "She'll be calling you every five minutes to hold her hand."
segments.zh: Renee 在走廊说：“她每五分钟都会叫你去哄她。”

segments.en: Priya accepts the incomplete report and moves on without clarifying or escalating.
segments.zh: Priya 接受了不完整的交接，没有进一步澄清或升级处理就继续工作。

byChoice.en: Rapid speech can make handoff less effective, but by itself it may reflect time pressure and is not the strongest cue of incivility or a safety omission.
byChoice.zh: 语速快可能影响交接效果，但单独来看也可能只是时间压力；它不是最明确的不文明行为或安全遗漏线索。

byChoice.en: Closed body language contributes to the tone, but the charge nurse should anchor on the concrete dismissive statements and omitted safety information.
byChoice.zh: 封闭的肢体语言会影响氛围，但护士长应重点关注具体的贬低性语言和遗漏的安全信息。

byChoice.en: This dismisses a reasonable clarification question and undermines professional handoff communication.
byChoice.zh: 这句话否定了合理的澄清问题，破坏了专业交接沟通。

byChoice.en: The eye-roll is disrespectful, occurs in front of the patient, and visibly undermines the oncoming nurse.
byChoice.zh: 翻白眼是不尊重的行为，发生在患者面前，并明显削弱接班护士的专业形象。

byChoice.en: This is demeaning language directed at a colleague and is a direct cue of lateral incivility.
byChoice.zh: 这是针对同事的贬低性语言，是横向不文明行为的直接线索。

byChoice.en: Leaving without opportunity for questions prevents a safe closed-loop handoff.
byChoice.zh: 不给提问机会就离开，会阻断安全的闭环交接。

byChoice.en: The same-day dose increase is clinically important and should be verbally communicated during handoff.
byChoice.zh: 当天剂量增加是重要临床变化，应在交接时口头说明。

byChoice.en: The q4h BP monitoring instruction is an answer-bearing safety order; omitting it creates a foreseeable care gap.
byChoice.zh: 每 4 小时监测 BP 是安全相关医嘱；遗漏会造成可预见的护理缺口。

byChoice.en: The hallway comment publicly belittles Priya and normalizes ridicule of a newer nurse.
byChoice.zh: 走廊里的评价公开贬低 Priya，并把嘲笑新护士正常化。

byChoice.en: Priya is not the source of the incivility, but accepting an incomplete handoff without clarification is a safety-relevant cue for coaching.
byChoice.zh: Priya 不是不文明行为的来源，但不澄清就接受不完整交接，是需要指导的安全相关线索。

correct.en: The key cues are the dismissive statements, the eye-roll in front of the patient, the failure to allow questions, the omitted medication-change and monitoring-order information, the public belittling comment, and Priya's failure to advocate for a complete report. Rapid speech and crossed arms contribute to tone but are less specific as isolated cues.
correct.zh: 关键线索包括贬低性话语、在患者面前翻白眼、不给提问机会、遗漏药物变更和监测医嘱、公开贬低同事，以及 Priya 未能要求完整交接。语速快和双臂交叉会影响氛围，但单独来看不如这些线索具体。

stem.en: Stage 1: Highlight the specific cues Marcus should identify as requiring charge-nurse intervention because they show lateral incivility, a safety-relevant handoff omission, or a receiving-nurse response that needs coaching.
stem.zh: 第 1 阶段：请标出 Marcus 应识别为需要护士长介入的具体线索，因为它们显示横向不文明行为、与安全相关的交接遗漏，或接班护士需要指导的反应。

testTakingStrategy.en: For cue-recognition items, separate vague tone cues from concrete behaviors and omissions that can affect client safety.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做识别线索题时，要把笼统的语气/态度线索与会影响患者安全的具体行为和遗漏区分开。

glossary.defZh: 同事之间贬低、排斥、羞辱或破坏专业沟通的行为。
护士在交接护理责任时传递患者关键资料、近期变化和后续计划的过程。
描述可观察行为及其影响，而不是评价对方人格或动机的沟通方式。

columns.zh: 患者安全沟通失败/专业失误

columns.en: Assertive/acceptable communication or not incivility by itself
columns.zh: 坚定且可接受的沟通，或单独来看不是不文明行为

rows.en: "Meds are on the MAR — you can read."
rows.zh: “药物在 MAR 上——你自己会看。”

rows.en: Visible eye-roll in front of the patient when Priya asks about medication changes
rows.zh: Priya 询问药物变更时，在患者面前明显翻白眼

rows.en: Hallway comment that Priya will call every five minutes to "hold her hand"
rows.zh: 在走廊说 Priya 会每五分钟叫人去“哄她”

rows.en: Failure to verbally communicate the amlodipine dose change and q4h BP monitoring order
rows.zh: 未口头交代氨氯地平剂量变更和每 4 小时 BP 监测医嘱

rows.en: Speaking rapidly during a busy change-of-shift handoff
rows.zh: 在繁忙交接班时语速较快

rows.en: Privately telling a newer nurse, "Check the MAR before handoff so we can focus on changes — let's make that our routine."
rows.zh: 私下对新护士说：“交接前先查看 MAR，这样我们可以重点讨论变化——以后就按这个流程来。”

byChoice.en: This statement belittles Priya rather than answering a reasonable handoff question.
byChoice.zh: 这句话贬低 Priya，而不是回答合理的交接问题。

byChoice.en: The eye-roll humiliates the nurse in front of the patient and undermines the handoff.
byChoice.zh: 翻白眼让护士在患者面前难堪，并破坏交接。

byChoice.en: The public hallway comment ridicules a colleague and is not harmless venting.
byChoice.zh: 公开在走廊嘲笑同事，不是无害的抱怨。

byChoice.en: The omission directly removes clinically necessary information from handoff and contributes to a missed monitoring plan.
byChoice.zh: 该遗漏直接使临床必要信息没有进入交接，并导致监测计划漏执行。

byChoice.en: Rapid speech can be problematic for clarity, but without demeaning content it is not incivility by itself.
byChoice.zh: 语速快可能影响清晰度，但没有贬低内容时，单独来看不是不文明行为。

byChoice.en: This statement sets a clear expectation privately and respectfully, which is assertive rather than uncivil.
byChoice.zh: 这句话私下且尊重地设定明确期望，是坚定沟通而不是不文明行为。

correct.en: Incivility is defined by demeaning or disrespectful behavior toward a colleague. The omitted medication and monitoring information is a patient-safety communication failure. Rapid speech alone may reflect workload, and a private, respectful redirect is assertive professional communication.
correct.zh: 不文明行为的核心是贬低或不尊重同事。遗漏药物和监测信息属于患者安全沟通失败。单独的语速快可能反映工作负荷；私下、尊重地纠正属于坚定的专业沟通。

stem.en: Stage 1: Classify each communication behavior.
stem.zh: 第 1 阶段：请将每一种沟通行为分类。

testTakingStrategy.en: Ask whether the behavior corrects practice respectfully or humiliates the person. Firm is not the same as uncivil.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 判断行为是在尊重地纠正实践，还是在羞辱个人。坚定不等于不文明。

glossary.defZh: 医嘱或流程中规定需要通知医护人员的具体阈值或症状。
关键信息未被传递，导致护理计划或监测未按要求执行。
心脏收缩时动脉内的压力。

options.en: A documentation problem that can be resolved after the shift because the client is alert and oriented
options.zh: 这是记录问题；患者清醒定向良好，可等班后再处理

options.en: A client-safety communication breakdown with missed monitoring and a current BP above the provider call threshold
options.zh: 患者安全沟通中断，导致漏监测，且当前 BP 超过通知医护人员的阈值

options.en: Priya's inexperience and failure to independently identify the amlodipine dose increase
options.zh: Priya 经验不足，未能独立发现氨氯地平剂量增加

options.en: The interpersonal conflict between Renee and Priya, which should be mediated before contacting the provider
options.zh: Renee 和 Priya 之间的人际冲突，应先调解后再联系医护人员

byChoice.en: Priya needs coaching, but focusing primarily on her inexperience shifts attention away from the active clinical risk and the failed handoff.
byChoice.zh: Priya 需要指导，但把重点放在她经验不足，会偏离当前临床风险和交接失败。

byChoice.en: The conflict is an upstream cause, but delaying provider notification leaves the client above the call threshold with symptoms.
byChoice.zh: 冲突是上游原因，但延迟通知医护人员会让患者在有症状且超过通知阈值的状态下等待。

byChoice.en: This identifies the active safety problem: missed q4h monitoring and a symptomatic BP elevation above the stated call parameter.
byChoice.zh: 这指出了当前安全问题：漏做每 4 小时监测，且有症状的血压升高已超过明确通知参数。

byChoice.en: This minimizes the event. A symptomatic BP above the call threshold is not merely a documentation issue.
byChoice.zh: 这低估了事件严重性。有症状且超过通知阈值的 BP 不是单纯记录问题。

correct.en: Client safety is the immediate priority. Mrs. Vega is symptomatic and her SBP of 186 exceeds the hospitalist's call parameter of SBP > 180. The incivility and Priya's learning needs matter, but the active care gap must be closed first.
correct.zh: 患者安全是立即优先事项。Vega 太太有症状，SBP 186 已超过住院医规定的 SBP > 180 通知阈值。不文明行为和 Priya 的学习需要都重要，但必须先关闭当前护理缺口。

stem.en: Stage 2: Priya reports that Mrs. Vega's BP is 186/102 with a headache, the amlodipine dose change was not communicated, and the 1800 q4h BP check was missed. What is the priority problem for Marcus to address?
stem.zh: 第 2 阶段：Priya 报告 Vega 太太 BP 为 186/102，并有头痛；氨氯地平剂量变更未被交代，1800 的每 4 小时 BP 检查也漏做。Marcus 优先要处理的问题是什么？

testTakingStrategy.en: When a conduct issue and a client-safety issue coexist, handle the active physiologic/safety risk first, then address the conduct process.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当职业行为问题和患者安全问题同时存在时，先处理当前生理/安全风险，再处理行为和流程问题。

glossary.defZh: 同事之间贬低、排斥、羞辱或破坏专业沟通的行为。
用于记录安全事件、近失误或流程缺陷的机构内部报告。
描述可观察行为及其影响，而不是评价对方人格或动机的沟通方式。

options.en: Speak privately with Priya to acknowledge the inadequate handoff and coach her to ask clarifying questions or escalate incomplete reports.
options.zh: 私下与 Priya 交谈，承认交接不足，并指导她对不完整交接提出澄清问题或升级处理。

options.en: Publicly reprimand Renee at the next staff meeting to set an example.
options.zh: 在下一次员工会议上公开训斥 Renee，以儆效尤。

options.en: Instruct Priya to notify the hospitalist now and report the BP, headache, and missed monitoring.
options.zh: 指导 Priya 立即通知住院医，并报告 BP、头痛和漏监测情况。

options.en: Do not document the incident because the BP spike was caught before serious harm occurred.
options.zh: 不要记录此事件，因为血压升高在造成严重伤害前已被发现。

options.en: Speak privately with Renee, focusing on observed behaviors and the impact on patient care rather than personality.
options.zh: 私下与 Renee 交谈，聚焦观察到的行为及其对患者护理的影响，而不是评价人格。

options.en: Complete the appropriate safety/professional-conduct reporting and notify the nurse manager for follow-up.
options.zh: 完成相应的安全/专业行为报告，并通知护士经理跟进。

byChoice.en: The event involved missed monitoring and a BP above call parameters; lack of severe harm does not remove the need to document.
byChoice.zh: 事件包括漏监测和 BP 超过通知参数；没有严重伤害并不代表无需记录。

byChoice.en: Reporting and manager notification create organizational follow-through for both the safety event and the conduct pattern.
byChoice.zh: 报告和通知护士经理可为安全事件和行为模式建立组织层面的后续处理。

byChoice.en: Public shaming is itself unprofessional and can worsen the unit culture.
byChoice.zh: 公开羞辱本身就是不专业行为，可能进一步恶化科室文化。

byChoice.en: Priya was placed in a difficult situation but still needs coaching on how to obtain a complete handoff and verify recent orders.
byChoice.zh: Priya 处境困难，但仍需要学习如何获得完整交接并核对近期医嘱。

byChoice.en: Private, behavior-focused feedback addresses the professional-conduct problem without attacking character.
byChoice.zh: 私下、聚焦行为的反馈可处理职业行为问题，同时避免人格攻击。

byChoice.en: This closes the active care gap because the BP exceeds the provider's stated call threshold and the client is symptomatic.
byChoice.zh: 这能关闭当前护理缺口，因为 BP 超过医护人员通知阈值且患者有症状。

correct.en: Marcus must address the immediate care gap, then use private behavior-focused conversations, coaching, documentation, and manager notification to address the incivility and system failure. Public reprimand escalates incivility, and not documenting removes accountability.
correct.zh: Marcus 必须先处理当前护理缺口，然后通过私下、聚焦行为的谈话、指导、记录和通知护士经理来处理不文明行为和系统失效。公开训斥会升级不文明行为；不记录会移除问责。

stem.en: Stage 2: Which actions should Marcus include in the charge-nurse response? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第 2 阶段：Marcus 作为护士长应采取哪些措施？请选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: For management-of-care SATA items, choose actions that protect the client now and create accountable follow-up later.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做护理管理类多选题时，选择既能立即保护患者、又能建立后续问责的措施。

glossary.defZh: 医嘱或流程中规定需要通知医护人员的具体阈值或症状。
对某位患者当班护理评估、执行医嘱和沟通负主要责任的护士。
按照医嘱参数、病情变化或机构流程联系医师/高级执业人员。

options.en: Take over the primary nurse's role and call the hospitalist himself without involving Priya.
options.zh: Marcus 自己接管责任护士角色，直接联系住院医，不让 Priya 参与。

options.en: Tell Priya to notify the hospitalist now using the stated call parameter and report the current BP, headache, and missed monitoring.
options.zh: 告诉 Priya 依据明确通知参数立即联系住院医，并报告当前 BP、头痛和漏监测。

options.en: Complete the incident report before contacting the hospitalist so the event is documented accurately.
options.zh: 先完成事件报告，确保记录准确后再联系住院医。

options.en: Call Renee first to hear her perspective on the handoff before taking further action.
options.zh: 先打电话给 Renee，听取她对交接的看法，再采取进一步措施。

options.en: Have Priya recheck the BP at the next q4h interval because the headache is mild.
options.zh: 因为头痛较轻，让 Priya 到下一次每 4 小时间隔时再复测 BP。

byChoice.en: Waiting for the next interval ignores the explicit call parameter and the current symptom.
byChoice.zh: 等到下一次监测忽视了明确通知参数和当前症状。

byChoice.en: Documentation is necessary, but it must not come before provider notification for a symptomatic BP above parameters.
byChoice.zh: 记录是必要的，但不能优先于对有症状且超过参数 BP 的医护人员通知。

byChoice.en: The charge nurse should ensure the call happens and support Priya; completely taking over misses a coaching opportunity unless the situation exceeds Priya's ability despite support.
byChoice.zh: 护士长应确保通话完成并支持 Priya；除非在支持下仍超出 Priya 能力，否则完全接管会错过教学机会。

byChoice.en: Renee's perspective can be addressed later; this delays care while the client is above the call threshold.
byChoice.zh: Renee 的看法可以稍后处理；此时这样做会在患者超过通知阈值时延误护理。

byChoice.en: This immediately addresses the active safety issue while keeping the primary nurse engaged in her role.
byChoice.zh: 这能立即处理当前安全问题，同时让责任护士继续履行职责。

correct.en: The first action is to ensure the hospitalist is notified now because the stated SBP > 180 parameter has been crossed and the client has a headache. Supporting Priya through the call preserves patient safety and builds her competence.
correct.zh: 首要措施是确保立即通知住院医，因为明确的 SBP > 180 参数已被触发，且患者有头痛。护士长支持 Priya 完成通话，既保护患者安全，也培养她的能力。

stem.en: Stage 2: What should Marcus do first?
stem.zh: 第 2 阶段：Marcus 首先应该做什么？

testTakingStrategy.en: For first-action questions, identify the intervention that reduces the current risk without unnecessary delay.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做首要措施题时，找出能立即降低当前风险且不造成不必要延误的措施。

glossary.defZh: 护士在交接护理责任时传递患者关键资料、近期变化和后续计划的过程。
用于记录安全事件、近失误或流程缺陷的机构内部报告。
判断干预是否达到预期临床和流程目标的护理判断步骤。

options.en: Renee and Priya become personally friendly and socialize together during breaks.
options.zh: Renee 和 Priya 私下变得亲近，并在休息时一起社交。

options.en: Subsequent handoffs include verbal medication changes, monitoring orders, and time for clarifying questions.
options.zh: 后续交接包括口头说明药物变更、监测医嘱，并留出澄清问题时间。

options.en: Mrs. Vega's BP decreases from 186/102 to 162/90 and then 154/86, and her headache resolves.
options.zh: Vega 太太 BP 从 186/102 降至 162/90，再到 154/86，头痛消失。

options.en: No further care omissions related to handoff occur, and nurse-manager follow-up is documented.
options.zh: 未再发生与交接相关的护理遗漏，并且护士经理的跟进已记录。

options.en: Priya documents the q4h BP checks and updates the care plan with the current amlodipine dose and monitoring schedule.
options.zh: Priya 记录每 4 小时 BP 检查，并在护理计划中更新当前氨氯地平剂量和监测安排。

options.en: Mrs. Vega's serum creatinine trend improves during the admission.
options.zh: Vega 太太住院期间血清肌酐趋势改善。

byChoice.en: This shows the immediate clinical intervention was effective.
byChoice.zh: 这说明即时临床干预有效。

byChoice.en: Creatinine is relevant to CKD management, but it does not measure whether the handoff failure was resolved.
byChoice.zh: 肌酐与 CKD 管理相关，但不能衡量交接失败是否已解决。

byChoice.en: This shows the missed monitoring plan has been corrected in actual care and documentation.
byChoice.zh: 这说明漏执行的监测计划已在实际护理和记录中得到纠正。

byChoice.en: Absence of repeat omissions and manager follow-up indicate the system response did not stop at a single conversation.
byChoice.zh: 没有重复遗漏且有护士经理跟进，说明系统反应没有停留在一次谈话。

byChoice.en: This directly evaluates whether the handoff communication pattern changed.
byChoice.zh: 这直接评估交接沟通模式是否改变。

byChoice.en: Personal friendship is not required for safe professional communication.
byChoice.zh: 安全的专业沟通不要求双方成为私人朋友。

correct.en: Resolution requires clinical and process evidence: BP improves and symptoms resolve, monitoring is performed and documented, the care plan reflects the order, handoffs become complete and professional, and manager follow-up occurs. Friendship and creatinine trends do not evaluate the communication breakdown.
correct.zh: 解决情况需要临床和流程两方面证据：BP 改善且症状消失，监测已执行并记录，护理计划反映医嘱，交接变得完整且专业，并有护士经理跟进。个人友谊和肌酐趋势不能评价沟通中断是否解决。

stem.en: Stage 3: Which findings best show that Marcus's interventions addressed both the care gap and the communication breakdown? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第 3 阶段：哪些发现最能说明 Marcus 的干预同时处理了护理缺口和沟通中断？请选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: Outcome evaluation should match the original problem: check both the client response and the process that caused the risk.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价结果时要对应原问题：既看患者反应，也看造成风险的流程是否改善。

content.en: Marcus hears Renee rapidly state: 'Vega, room 312, hypertension, CKD, the usual. Vitals have been fine. Meds are on the MAR — you can read.' When Priya asks about medication changes, Renee visibly rolls her eyes in front of Mrs. Vega and says, 'I just told you, it's on the MAR. I'm not going to spoon-feed you.' Renee leaves without allowing questions and does not mention the amlodipine dose increase or q4h BP monitoring instruction. In the hallway, Renee says loudly enough for staff to hear: 'Good luck tonight — she'll be calling you every five minutes to hold her hand.' Priya looks shaken and does not pursue clarification.
content.zh: Marcus 听到 Renee 快速说：“Vega，312 房，高血压、CKD，老样子。生命体征都还好。药物在 MAR 上——你自己会看。” Priya 询问药物是否有变更时，Renee 在 Vega 太太面前明显翻白眼，并说：“我刚说了，在 MAR 上。我不会手把手喂给你。” Renee 未留下提问时间就离开，也没有说明氨氯地平加量或每 4 小时 BP 监测医嘱。走廊里，Renee 用附近员工能听见的音量说：“祝你今晚好运——她每五分钟都会叫你去哄她。” Priya 看起来受到影响，没有继续澄清。

title.zh: 观察到的交接

title.en: Stage 1: 1915-2000, bedside handoff and immediate aftermath
title.zh: 第 1 阶段：1915-2000，床旁交接及其直接后果

content.en: Priya has been taking vitals on the routine q8h schedule. At 2200: T 36.9 C, HR 92, BP 186/102, RR 18, SpO2 96%. Mrs. Vega reports a mild headache 3/10. She is alert and oriented x4, with no visual changes, chest pain, or shortness of breath. Telemetry shows sinus tachycardia at 92, no ST changes. Priya finds the 1400 hospitalist note: 'Monitor BP q4h x 24 hours to assess response to dose increase; call if SBP > 180 or < 110, or if symptomatic hypotension.' The 1800 q4h check was missed. No PRN antihypertensive is ordered. Marcus verifies that SBP > 180 crosses the call threshold.
content.zh: Priya 一直按常规每 8 小时测生命体征。2200：T 36.9 C，HR 92，BP 186/102，RR 18，SpO2 96%。Vega 太太报告轻度头痛 3/10。她清醒定向 x4，无视物改变、胸痛或气短。遥测显示窦性心动过速 92 次/分，无 ST 改变。Priya 找到 1400 住院医记录：“为评估剂量增加后的反应，24 小时内每 4 小时监测 BP；若 SBP > 180 或 < 110，或出现症状性低血压则通知。” 1800 的每 4 小时检查已漏做。未开立 PRN 降压药。Marcus 确认 SBP > 180 已达到通知阈值。

title.zh: 2200 评估和病历复核

title.en: Stage 2: 2200, the care gap reaches the client
title.zh: 第 2 阶段：2200，护理缺口影响到患者

content.en: Marcus instructs Priya to notify the hospitalist now. Priya reports the current BP, headache, and missed monitoring. The hospitalist orders hydralazine 10 mg IV x 1 now, repeat BP in 30 minutes, and q4h BP monitoring, with callback if SBP remains above 170. Hydralazine is given at 2230. At 2300: HR 80, BP 162/90, RR 16, SpO2 97%, headache resolved. At 0200: BP 154/86, HR 76, no symptoms. Priya documents q4h checks and updates the care plan.
content.zh: Marcus 指导 Priya 立即通知住院医。Priya 报告当前 BP、头痛和漏监测情况。住院医开立：立即给予肼屈嗪 10 mg IV x 1，30 分钟后复测 BP，并继续每 4 小时监测 BP；若 SBP 仍高于 170 则回电。2230 给肼屈嗪。2300：HR 80，BP 162/90，RR 16，SpO2 97%，头痛消失。0200：BP 154/86，HR 76，无症状。Priya 记录每 4 小时检查并更新护理计划。

title.zh: 通知医护人员和临床反应

content.en: After the patient is stabilized, Marcus speaks privately with Renee by phone, names the observed behaviors and their impact, and states that the event will be documented through the civility/professional-conduct pathway. Marcus also speaks privately with Priya, acknowledges the inadequate handoff, and coaches her to ask direct questions, request structured SBAR, or escalate incomplete reports to the charge nurse. Priya documents objective clinical facts in the patient chart. Marcus completes a safety report for the communication failure and missed monitoring, separately documents the incivility details through the professional-conduct pathway, and notifies the nurse manager.
content.zh: 患者稳定后，Marcus 私下打电话给 Renee，说明观察到的行为及其影响，并说明将通过文明/专业行为流程记录此事件。Marcus 也私下与 Priya 交谈，承认交接不足，并指导她提出直接问题、要求结构化 SBAR，或将不完整交接升级给护士长。Priya 在患者病历中记录客观临床事实。Marcus 为沟通失败和漏监测完成安全报告，另行通过专业行为流程记录不文明细节，并通知护士经理。

title.zh: 行为和系统跟进
第 3 阶段：2215-0200，干预和解决

summary.en: Mrs. Dolores Vega, age 71, is hospitalized after hypertensive urgency with CKD stage 3b, HFpEF, and type 2 diabetes. The charge nurse, Marcus Chen, observes a dismissive bedside handoff from senior nurse Renee Talbot to newly licensed nurse Priya Anand. A same-day amlodipine dose increase and q4h blood-pressure monitoring instruction are not verbally communicated.
summary.zh: 71 岁的 Dolores Vega 太太因高血压急症后住院，既往有 CKD 3b 期、射血分数保留型心力衰竭和 2 型糖尿病。护士长 Marcus Chen 观察到资深护士 Renee Talbot 向新近取得执照的护士 Priya Anand 进行床旁交接时态度轻慢。当天氨氯地平加量以及每 4 小时监测血压的医嘱未被口头交代。

title.en: Lateral incivility causing a client-safety communication breakdown on a medical-surgical unit
title.zh: 内外科病房中横向不文明行为导致患者安全沟通中断

glossary.defZh: 同事之间贬低、排斥、羞辱或破坏专业沟通的行为。
护士在交接护理责任时传递患者关键资料、近期变化和后续计划的过程。
医嘱或流程中规定需要通知医护人员的具体阈值或症状。
用于记录安全事件、近失误或流程缺陷的机构内部报告。
描述可观察行为及其影响，而不是评价对方人格或动机的沟通方式。

correct.en: This case links lateral incivility to a concrete safety failure. Renee's dismissive handoff and omission of a same-day amlodipine increase and q4h monitoring order contributed to missed monitoring. When Mrs. Vega became symptomatic with SBP 186, Marcus appropriately prioritized provider notification and clinical intervention before conduct management. After the BP improved and the headache resolved, Marcus addressed the professional-conduct pattern through private, behavior-focused conversations, coaching, safety reporting, and nurse-manager follow-up. Effective evaluation requires both clinical improvement and evidence that the handoff process changed.
correct.zh: 本病例将横向不文明行为与具体安全失败联系起来。Renee 的轻慢交接以及遗漏当天氨氯地平加量和每 4 小时监测医嘱，导致监测漏执行。当 Vega 太太出现症状且 SBP 为 186 时，Marcus 正确地先优先通知住院医并进行临床干预，再处理职业行为问题。BP 改善、头痛消失后，Marcus 通过私下聚焦行为的谈话、指导、安全报告和护士经理跟进来处理专业行为模式。有效评价需要同时看到临床改善和交接流程改变的证据。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

testTakingStrategy.en: In unfolding management-of-care cases, follow the safety chain: recognize unprofessional communication, identify how it affects care, close the active client-risk gap, then create accountable follow-up.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 在展开式护理管理病例中，按安全链思考：识别不专业沟通，判断其如何影响护理，先关闭当前患者风险缺口，再建立可问责的后续处理。

content.en:
Facility protocol: This 22-bed community ED is in Level 1 resource-constrained MCI mode when acute casualties exceed available treatment spaces. The protocol requires START triage at the point of entry; full external decontamination of any chemically contaminated casualty before ED entry; red/immediate before yellow/delayed before green/minor; black/expectant casualties receive comfort measures only when resources allow. The decontamination station outside the ambulance entrance is functional.

Resources at 1854: three RNs, one emergency physician, one PA; one trauma bay and two resuscitation bays; two ventilators, with one already in use for an ICU-hold patient; four O-negative PRBC units immediately available; standard airway, albuterol, burn-care, and resuscitation supplies available. Two additional nurses have been called in but are not yet present.

Incident: Industrial explosion and anhydrous-ammonia release at a fertilizer-blending facility. Seven casualties arrive within eight minutes by ambulance and private vehicle.
content.zh:
机构流程：这家22床社区急诊在急性伤员数超过可用治疗空间时进入一级资源受限MCI模式。流程要求在入口处进行START分诊；任何有化学污染的伤员进入急诊治疗区前必须完成体表去污；治疗优先级为红色/立即优先于黄色/延迟，再优先于绿色/轻伤；黑色/预期死亡伤员在资源允许时仅给予舒适护理。救护车入口外的去污站可用。

1854资源：3名RN、1名急诊医师、1名PA；1间创伤间和2间复苏间；2台呼吸机，其中1台已用于滞留ICU患者；血库可立即提供4单位O阴性PRBC；有标准气道设备、albuterol、烧伤护理和复苏用品。已召回2名护士，但尚未到达。

事件：三英里外化肥混合厂发生工业爆炸并释放无水氨。7名伤员在8分钟内通过救护车和私家车抵达。

title.zh: 基线流程与资源

content.en:
Triage-point START findings:
A: 52-year-old man, unresponsive, no spontaneous respirations. Airway repositioned; respirations do not resume. No radial or carotid pulse.
B: 41-year-old woman, ambulatory, alert and conversational. 6 cm left forearm laceration under direct pressure. RR 18, strong radial pulse, capillary refill 2 seconds. No chemical exposure or respiratory complaints.
C: 29-year-old man, nonambulatory on backboard, responsive to voice and follows simple commands but not speaking in sentences. RR 32, weak rapid radial pulse, capillary refill 4 seconds. Open right femur fracture with EMS tourniquet controlling active bleeding. No chemical exposure reported.
D: 36-year-old woman, nonambulatory because of severe respiratory distress, alert, persistent cough, audible inspiratory stridor. RR 32, strong radial pulse, capillary refill 2 seconds. Clothing and hair wet with pungent ammonia-like odor; tearing and erythematous eyes; near ruptured ammonia tank.
E: 48-year-old man, nonambulatory on stretcher, eyes open, follows commands, speaks in short phrases. RR 26, radial pulse present, capillary refill 2 seconds. Partial-thickness burns to both forearms and anterior chest, estimated 18% TBSA. Clothing removed by EMS; wrapped in clean sheet; no skin contamination reported; no stridor.
F: 24-year-old woman, ambulatory, anxious and tearful, no visible injury. RR 20, strong radial pulse, capillary refill under 2 seconds. Ringing in ears and mild headache; parking lot exposure; no chemical exposure.
G: 60-year-old man, unresponsive, apneic after airway repositioning. Radial pulse absent; carotid pulse faint and irregular. Clothing soaked with chemical odor; found next to ruptured ammonia tank.
content.zh:
入口START分诊资料：
A：52岁男性，无反应，无自主呼吸。重新开放气道后仍无呼吸；桡动脉和颈动脉均无脉搏。
B：41岁女性，可行走，清醒且能交谈。左前臂6 cm裂伤，正用直接压迫止血。RR 18，桡动脉强，毛细血管再充盈2秒。无化学暴露或呼吸主诉。
C：29岁男性，不能行走，担架板上；对声音有反应并能按简单指令动作，但不能成句说话。RR 32，桡动脉弱而快，毛细血管再充盈4秒。右股骨开放性骨折，EMS止血带已控制活动性出血。报告无化学暴露。
D：36岁女性，因严重呼吸窘迫不能行走，清醒，持续咳嗽，可闻及吸气性喘鸣。RR 32，桡动脉强，毛细血管再充盈2秒。衣物和头发潮湿并有刺鼻氨味；流泪、眼红；位于氨罐破裂处附近。
E：48岁男性，不能行走，躺在担架上；睁眼，能按指令，短句说话。RR 26，有桡动脉，毛细血管再充盈2秒。双前臂和前胸部分厚度烧伤，估计18% TBSA。EMS已脱去衣物并用清洁床单包裹；报告皮肤无污染；无喘鸣。
F：24岁女性，可行走，焦虑流泪，无明显外伤。RR 20，桡动脉强，毛细血管再充盈少于2秒。耳鸣和轻度头痛；位于停车场；无化学暴露。
G：60岁男性，无反应；重新开放气道后仍无呼吸。无桡动脉脉搏；颈动脉脉搏微弱且不规则。衣物浸湿并有化学气味；在破裂氨罐旁被发现。

title.zh: 入口分诊资料

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: Simple Triage and Rapid Treatment，用于MCI的快速伤员分类方法。
在资源受限时不分配复苏资源、仅在可行时给予舒适护理的分诊类别。
评估外周灌注的快速体征；延迟提示休克或灌注不足。

rows.en: A: apneic after airway repositioning, pulseless
rows.zh: A：重新开放气道后仍无呼吸、无脉搏

rows.en: B: ambulatory, alert, isolated forearm laceration
rows.zh: B：可行走、清醒、单纯前臂裂伤

rows.en: C: nonambulatory, RR 32, capillary refill 4 seconds, altered mental status
rows.zh: C：不能行走，RR 32，毛细血管再充盈4秒，意识改变

rows.en: D: nonambulatory, RR 32, stridor, chemical contamination
rows.zh: D：不能行走，RR 32，喘鸣，化学污染

rows.en: E: nonambulatory burn casualty, RR 26, pulse present, follows commands
rows.zh: E：不能行走的烧伤伤员，RR 26，有脉搏，能按指令

rows.en: F: ambulatory, alert, mild headache and tinnitus
rows.zh: F：可行走、清醒，轻度头痛和耳鸣

rows.en: G: apneic after airway repositioning, chemically contaminated
rows.zh: G：重新开放气道后仍无呼吸，且有化学污染

byChoice.en: Black is correct because apneic after airway repositioning meets the expectant START endpoint in this resource-limited MCI.
byChoice.zh: 黑色正确，因为重新开放气道后仍无呼吸符合资源受限MCI中的START预期死亡终点。

byChoice.en: Green is correct because she is walking, alert, and has an isolated controlled laceration without chemical exposure.
byChoice.zh: 绿色正确，因为她可行走、清醒，只有已控制的局部裂伤且无化学暴露。

byChoice.en: Red is correct because RR 32, delayed capillary refill, weak rapid pulse, and altered mental status indicate immediate life threat.
byChoice.zh: 红色正确，因为RR 32、毛细血管再充盈延迟、脉搏弱快和意识改变提示立即生命威胁。

byChoice.en: Red is correct because nonambulatory respiratory distress with RR 32 and stridor is an immediate airway/breathing threat, even though ED entry must wait for decontamination.
byChoice.zh: 红色正确，因为不能行走且RR 32伴喘鸣属于立即气道/呼吸威胁，即使进入急诊前必须先去污。

byChoice.en: Yellow is correct because significant burns need care, but RR 26, present pulse, capillary refill 2 seconds, and ability to follow commands allow a short delay.
byChoice.zh: 黄色正确，因为大面积烧伤需要处理，但RR 26、有脉搏、毛细血管再充盈2秒且能按指令，允许短暂延迟。

byChoice.en: Green is correct because she is walking independently with normal perfusion and no objective serious injury at the triage point.
byChoice.zh: 绿色正确，因为她能独立行走，灌注正常，入口分诊时无客观严重损伤。

byChoice.en: Black is correct because he remains apneic after airway repositioning; chemical contamination adds a safety barrier but is not the reason to upgrade him to red.
byChoice.zh: 黑色正确，因为重新开放气道后仍无呼吸；化学污染增加安全屏障，但不是将其升为红色的理由。

correct.en: START sorts by walking, breathing, perfusion, and mental status. A and G remain apneic after airway repositioning, so they are black/expectant in this MCI. B and F can walk and have minor complaints, so they are green. C is red because RR is greater than 30, perfusion is poor, and mental status is abnormal. D is red because she is nonambulatory with RR greater than 30 and airway compromise. E is yellow because he is serious but currently breathing under 30, perfusing, and following commands.
correct.zh: START按能否行走、呼吸、灌注和意识状态快速分类。A和G重新开放气道后仍无呼吸，因此在此MCI中为黑色/预期死亡。B和F能行走且主诉较轻，为绿色。C因RR大于30、灌注差且意识异常，为红色。D因不能行走、RR大于30并有气道受损，为红色。E伤势严重但目前RR低于30、灌注尚可且能按指令，因此为黄色。

stem.en: Using the Stage 1 triage-point findings, assign the correct START triage category to each casualty.
stem.zh: 根据第1阶段入口分诊资料，为每名伤员选择正确的START分诊类别。

testTakingStrategy.en: In START questions, apply the algorithm before emotional or visual severity cues: walk, breathe after airway repositioning, perfusion, mental status.
testTakingStrategy.zh: START题先按算法，不被情绪或视觉冲击带偏：能否行走、开放气道后是否呼吸、灌注、意识状态。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 伤员数量超过常规资源，需要特殊分诊和资源分配的事件。
及时、适度资源干预后较可能存活的伤员。
缓解痛苦和维护尊严的护理，不等同于积极复苏。

options.en: Chemical contamination alone makes a casualty ineligible for treatment, regardless of breathing status or resources.
options.zh: 只要有化学污染，伤员就没有治疗资格，与呼吸状态或资源无关。

options.en: In this resource-limited MCI, casualties who remain apneic after airway repositioning are expectant so resuscitation resources can be directed to salvageable casualties.
options.zh: 在此资源受限MCI中，重新开放气道后仍无呼吸的伤员归为预期死亡，以便将复苏资源用于可挽救伤员。

options.en: They are deprioritized mainly because they are older than the other casualties and younger clients should always be treated first.
options.zh: 他们主要因为年龄较大而降级，年轻伤员总是应优先治疗。

options.en: Pulseless adults in the ED must always receive CPR first, even during an activated MCI protocol.
options.zh: 急诊内无脉搏成人任何时候都必须先CPR，即使已启动MCI流程。

byChoice.en: This applies to routine ED care, but the activated MCI protocol changes resource allocation for non-salvageable casualties.
byChoice.zh: 这适用于常规急诊护理，但启动MCI流程后，对不可挽救伤员的资源分配会改变。

byChoice.en: This is the governing MCI principle and matches the START finding of apnea after airway repositioning.
byChoice.zh: 这正是MCI的主导原则，也符合重新开放气道后仍无呼吸的START判断。

byChoice.en: Contamination requires decontamination before ED entry, but it is not an automatic denial of all care; D is contaminated and still red/immediate.
byChoice.zh: 污染要求进入急诊前先去污，但并不自动等于拒绝所有治疗；D有污染仍为红色/立即。

byChoice.en: START does not prioritize by age here; it uses breathing, perfusion, and mental status in the context of resource limits.
byChoice.zh: 此处START不按年龄优先，而按呼吸、灌注、意识并结合资源限制分类。

correct.en: Disaster triage shifts from routine one-patient rescue to greatest good for the greatest number. A and G meet the facility's START black criteria after airway repositioning. CPR, ventilator use, and one-to-one nursing would consume scarce resources needed for C, D, and E, who are more salvageable with timely intervention.
correct.zh: 灾难分诊从常规的单个患者全力抢救转为最大多数人的最大利益。A和G在重新开放气道后符合机构START黑色标准。CPR、呼吸机和一对一护理会消耗C、D、E这些及时处理可挽救伤员所需的稀缺资源。

stem.en: Which explanation best describes why Casualties A and G do not receive CPR or advanced resuscitation during the initial MCI response?
stem.zh: 哪一项最能解释为什么A和G在MCI初期不接受CPR或高级复苏？

testTakingStrategy.en: When a disaster stem conflicts with routine instincts, name the governing protocol and ask which action preserves resources for salvageable clients.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当灾难题干与常规本能冲突时，先找主导流程，再问哪项行动能把资源留给可挽救患者。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 移除或稀释化学污染物，以保护患者、医护和环境。
大量失血导致循环灌注不足的危急状态。
在当前资源和限制下，干预能否立即带来生存获益。

options.en: Move Casualty E first because burns over 18% TBSA are visually severe and need fluid resuscitation.
options.zh: 先移动E，因为18% TBSA烧伤视觉上严重且需要补液。

options.en: Move Casualty C into the trauma bay while Casualty D completes decontamination outside the ED.
options.zh: 在D于急诊外完成去污期间，将C送入创伤间。

options.en: Wait until all seven casualties have full head-to-toe assessments before assigning the trauma bay.
options.zh: 等7名伤员均完成全身详细评估后再分配创伤间。

options.en: Bring Casualty D directly into the ED because airway problems always override decontamination barriers.
options.zh: 因气道问题总是优先于去污屏障，直接将D带入急诊。

byChoice.en: Correct: this accounts for treatability now, hemorrhage time-sensitivity, and the hard decontamination barrier for D.
byChoice.zh: 正确：这同时考虑了当下可治疗性、出血的时间敏感性，以及D必须先去污的硬性屏障。

byChoice.en: E needs burn care but is yellow by START because he is breathing adequately, perfusing, and following commands.
byChoice.zh: E需要烧伤护理，但按START为黄色，因为其呼吸、灌注和意识暂时稳定。

byChoice.en: Full assessments before treatment would delay life-saving interventions; START is the initial assessment during the acute MCI phase.
byChoice.zh: 治疗前做完整评估会延误救命干预；MCI急性期START就是初始评估。

byChoice.en: This misapplies single-patient ABCs; contaminated ED entry could expose staff and other casualties and collapse response capacity.
byChoice.zh: 这是误用单个患者ABCs；带污染进入急诊会暴露员工和其他伤员，削弱应对能力。

correct.en: C can receive life-saving hemorrhage treatment immediately and is deteriorating. D is also red, but the facility protocol prohibits ED entry until decontamination and re-triage are complete. Using the trauma bay for C during D's required decontamination interval maximizes treatment of salvageable casualties without contaminating the ED.
correct.zh: C可立即接受挽救生命的出血处理且正在恶化。D同样是红色，但机构流程禁止其在完成去污和重新分诊前进入急诊。D必须去污的间隙用于C的创伤救治，既最大化可挽救伤员治疗，又避免污染急诊。

stem.en: Two red-category casualties are present at the start of Stage 1: Casualty C with hemorrhagic shock and no contamination, and Casualty D with stridor and ammonia contamination. Which casualty should enter the ED treatment area first?
stem.zh: 第1阶段开始时有两名红色伤员：C为失血性休克且无污染，D有喘鸣且被氨污染。哪名伤员应先进入急诊治疗区？

testTakingStrategy.en: For two immediate clients, add feasibility and safety to ABCs: who can safely receive an effective intervention right now?
testTakingStrategy.zh: 两个立即处理患者之间比较时，在ABCs之外加入可行性和安全性：谁现在能安全接受有效干预？

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 为严重出血快速提供血制品的机构流程。
缓解支气管痉挛、改善通气的药物。
一个护理行动占用资源后，其他患者无法使用这些资源的代价。

options.en: Initiate the ordered massive transfusion protocol for Casualty C.
options.zh: 按医嘱为C启动大量输血流程。

options.en: Apply high-flow humidified oxygen, administer ordered bronchodilator therapy, and prepare difficult-airway equipment for Casualty D after decontamination.
options.zh: D去污后给予高流量湿化氧、按医嘱给予支气管扩张治疗，并准备困难气道设备。

options.en: Continue ordered IV burn resuscitation and transfer planning for stable Casualty E.
options.zh: 继续为稳定的E执行医嘱IV烧伤复苏并安排转运。

options.en: Assign one nurse to start CPR on Casualty A or G while the red casualties are being treated.
options.zh: 在红色伤员处理期间，指派一名护士为A或G开始CPR。

options.en: Keep Casualties B and F deferred with basic self-care instructions until reinforcement nurses can assess them.
options.zh: 让B和F暂缓处理并遵循基本自我护理指示，直到增援护士可以评估。

options.en: Require complete head-to-toe assessments and full routine charting on all casualties before starting treatment.
options.zh: 开始治疗前要求所有伤员先完成从头到脚评估和完整常规记录。

byChoice.en: Incorrect: START triage is the initial assessment in the acute MCI phase; full documentation follows stabilization when feasible.
byChoice.zh: 错误：MCI急性期START分诊就是初始评估；完整记录在稳定后可行时再补充。

byChoice.en: Correct: C has worsening hemorrhagic shock and the blood bank has immediately available O-negative units.
byChoice.zh: 正确：C失血性休克恶化，血库有可立即使用的O阴性血。

byChoice.en: Correct: B and F are green-category casualties and can safely wait with basic instructions during the acute resource crunch.
byChoice.zh: 正确：B和F为绿色伤员，在急性资源紧张期可在基本指示下安全等待。

byChoice.en: Correct: E is serious but stable; burn resuscitation and transfer planning are appropriate and do not require disproportionate staffing.
byChoice.zh: 正确：E伤势严重但稳定；烧伤复苏和转运安排合适，且不会不成比例消耗人力。

byChoice.en: Incorrect: CPR on expectant casualties would consume a nurse and likely the only available ventilator without proportional survival benefit.
byChoice.zh: 错误：为预期死亡伤员CPR会消耗护士，且可能占用唯一可用呼吸机，却缺乏相称生存获益。

byChoice.en: Correct: after decontamination, D's persistent stridor and hypoxemia require airway readiness and ordered respiratory therapy.
byChoice.zh: 正确：去污后D仍有喘鸣和低氧，需要准备气道并执行医嘱呼吸治疗。

correct.en: Appropriate MCI actions address immediate or near-immediate threats in salvageable casualties using proportionate resources: hemorrhage control and transfusion for C, airway/respiratory treatment for decontaminated D, protocol burn stabilization and transfer for E, and safe deferral of green casualties. CPR on black casualties and routine full assessment before treatment would divert scarce nurse-minutes from salvageable casualties.
correct.zh: 适当的MCI行动是用相称资源处理可挽救伤员的立即或近立即威胁：C的止血和输血，D去污后的气道/呼吸治疗，E的烧伤流程稳定和转运，以及安全暂缓绿色伤员。为黑色伤员CPR或治疗前进行完整常规评估会把稀缺护理时间从可挽救伤员处转移走。

stem.en: During Stage 2, which actions are appropriate disaster-phase nursing actions? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第2阶段中，哪些行动属于适当的灾难急性期护理行动？请选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: For SATA disaster questions, select actions that save salvageable lives now and reject actions that consume scarce staff for deferrable or futile care.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 灾难SATA题选择现在能挽救可救生命的行动，排除为可延后或无效护理消耗稀缺人力的行动。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 保护工作人员免受化学、感染或其他危害暴露的装备。
污染物从患者或衣物转移给医护、其他患者或环境。
在病情或环境条件改变后再次评估分诊等级。

options.en: Perform copious water irrigation for the full facility-protocol duration, including eyes and exposed skin.
options.zh: 按机构流程完成充分清水冲洗，包括眼部和暴露皮肤。

options.en: Initiate definitive airway and respiratory treatment with monitoring in the ED.
options.zh: 在急诊监测下开始明确的气道和呼吸治疗。

options.en: Don appropriate PPE before approaching the contaminated casualty.
options.zh: 接近被污染伤员前先穿戴适当PPE。

options.en: Remove and bag contaminated clothing and personal items.
options.zh: 脱去并装袋污染衣物和个人物品。

options.en: Move the casualty into the ED treatment area only after decontamination is complete.
options.zh: 仅在去污完成后将伤员转入急诊治疗区。

options.en: Perform post-decontamination reassessment and re-triage.
options.zh: 去污后重新评估并重新分诊。

byChoice.en: This must be first because an unprotected nurse can become another casualty and reduce the response workforce.
byChoice.zh: 必须第一步，因为未防护护士可能成为新增伤员并减少应对人力。

byChoice.en: Definitive monitored respiratory treatment occurs inside the ED after the contamination barrier is resolved.
byChoice.zh: 明确且有监测的呼吸治疗应在污染屏障解除后于急诊内进行。

byChoice.en: This follows PPE because clothing traps and transfers ammonia contamination.
byChoice.zh: 这一步在PPE之后，因为衣物会滞留并转移氨污染。

byChoice.en: Reassessment after decontamination detects deterioration and verifies the current triage category before ED entry.
byChoice.zh: 去污后重新评估可发现恶化，并在进入急诊前确认当前分诊类别。

byChoice.en: This follows clothing removal and must not be shortened below the facility protocol when the patient is visibly contaminated.
byChoice.zh: 这一步在脱衣后进行；患者有明显污染时，不应短于机构流程要求。

byChoice.en: ED entry is safe only after decontamination has been completed and re-triage has occurred.
byChoice.zh: 只有去污完成并重新分诊后，进入急诊才安全。

correct.en: PPE protects the nurse before contact. Clothing removal reduces ongoing contamination and prevents transfer. Irrigation completes the facility decontamination requirement, with eyes and skin addressed. Reassessment and re-triage confirm the current status before ED entry. Only then can the patient enter the treatment area for monitored oxygen, medications, and airway backup.
correct.zh: PPE先保护护士再接触患者。脱衣可减少持续污染并避免转移。冲洗完成机构去污要求，重点处理眼部和皮肤。重新评估和重新分诊在进入急诊前确认当前状态。之后患者才可进入治疗区，接受监测下吸氧、用药和气道备用处理。

stem.en: Place the steps for safely managing chemically contaminated Casualty D in the correct order.
stem.zh: 请将安全处理被化学污染的D的步骤按正确顺序排列。

testTakingStrategy.en: For hazardous-materials ordered-response items, rescuer safety and contamination control come before routine treatment location and definitive care.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 危险化学品排序题中，救援者安全和污染控制先于常规治疗地点和明确治疗。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 用于判断护理或系统反应是否有效的衡量点。
非左心衰导致的肺泡/肺间质液体聚集，可见于严重吸入损伤。
事件后评估流程表现、资源使用和改进机会的过程。

options.en: The salvageable red-category casualties, C and D, are alive and clinically improving after timely treatment.
options.zh: 可挽救的红色伤员C和D在及时治疗后存活并临床改善。

options.en: Effectiveness is best shown by complete routine nursing charting for every casualty during the acute phase.
options.zh: 有效性最好由急性期每名伤员完整常规护理记录证明。

options.en: The green-category casualties, B and F, were safely deferred and then discharged without deterioration.
options.zh: 绿色伤员B和F被安全暂缓，随后无恶化出院。

options.en: No staff or other casualties show evidence of secondary ammonia contamination inside the ED.
options.zh: 急诊内无工作人员或其他伤员出现二次氨污染证据。

options.en: The response is effective only if all seven casualties survive.
options.zh: 只有7名伤员全部存活，反应才算有效。

options.en: The yellow-category burn casualty, E, remains stable and has an accepted burn-center transfer.
options.zh: 黄色烧伤伤员E保持稳定，并已被烧伤中心接收转运。

byChoice.en: Incorrect: disaster triage is not judged by zero mortality; expectant deaths can occur despite correct triage.
byChoice.zh: 错误：灾难分诊不能以零死亡评价；即使分诊正确，预期死亡伤员仍可能死亡。

byChoice.en: Correct: avoiding secondary contamination preserves ED function and is a key hazmat-MCI safety outcome.
byChoice.zh: 正确：避免二次污染可维持急诊功能，是化学MCI的重要安全结局。

byChoice.en: Correct: safe deferral and later discharge of B and F supports that green categorization was appropriate.
byChoice.zh: 正确：B和F安全暂缓后出院，支持绿色分类合适。

byChoice.en: Correct: C's hemorrhage is controlled and D's airway status is improving, showing immediate resources reached salvageable red casualties.
byChoice.zh: 正确：C出血受控，D气道状态改善，说明立即资源用于了可挽救红色伤员。

byChoice.en: Correct: E tolerated delayed-category management without deterioration and is moving to the needed higher level of care.
byChoice.zh: 正确：E在延迟类别管理下未恶化，并正转向所需更高级别护理。

byChoice.en: Incorrect: abbreviated triage tags and MCI logs are appropriate during the acute phase; full charting is not the main effectiveness metric.
byChoice.zh: 错误：急性期使用简化分诊标签和MCI记录是合适的；完整常规记录不是主要有效性指标。

correct.en: MCI effectiveness is judged by survival and stabilization of salvageable casualties, safe delay of minor casualties, successful transfer of serious delayed casualties, and preservation of staff/environmental safety. Two deaths do not by themselves show failure when those patients met expectant criteria. Routine full documentation is important after the acute phase but is not the key outcome metric during active disaster triage.
correct.zh: MCI有效性要看可挽救伤员是否存活并稳定、轻伤员是否能安全延迟处理、严重延迟伤员是否成功稳定转运，以及工作人员和环境是否安全。若两名死亡者符合预期死亡标准，死亡人数本身并不代表失败。常规完整记录在急性期后很重要，但不是主动灾难分诊时的关键结局指标。

stem.en: At Stage 3, which findings indicate the disaster triage and resource allocation were effective? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第3阶段中，哪些结果提示灾难分诊和资源分配有效？请选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate disaster outcomes against the disaster goal: more salvageable lives saved and no avoidable system harm, not routine ED perfection.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价灾难结局要按灾难目标：挽救更多可挽救生命并避免可预防系统伤害，而不是常规急诊的完美标准。

content.en: 1854-1909: The charge nurse completes START assessment of all seven casualties within six minutes. D and G are identified as chemically contaminated and cannot enter the ED until decontamination is complete and re-triage is performed. D is moved to the outdoor decontamination station; PPE-equipped staff remove clothing and begin full irrigation per facility protocol. During decontamination, D's stridor persists and RR rises to 36. G remains outside the ED entrance and is later found pulseless. A remains apneic and pulseless after airway repositioning; no further resuscitation is started under MCI protocol. C enters the trauma bay first. His tourniquet is effective, IV access is established, HR 128, BP 88/62, and he remains responsive to voice only. E enters a resuscitation bay; burn fluid resuscitation is started, HR 102, BP 118/74, RR 24, SpO2 94% on room air. B and F are directed to the waiting area with basic instructions.
content.zh: 1854-1909：charge nurse在6分钟内完成7名伤员的START评估。D和G被识别为化学污染伤员，完成去污并重新分诊前不得进入急诊。D被转移到室外去污站；穿戴PPE的人员脱去衣物，并按机构流程开始充分冲洗。去污过程中，D的喘鸣持续，RR升至36。G留在急诊入口外，随后发现无脉搏。A重新开放气道后仍无呼吸、无脉搏；按MCI流程不再启动进一步复苏。C首先进入创伤间；止血带有效，建立IV通路，HR 128，BP 88/62，仍仅对声音有反应。E进入复苏间；开始烧伤补液，HR 102，BP 118/74，RR 24，室内空气SpO2 94%。B和F被引导至候诊区并给予基本指示。

title.zh: 第1阶段更新

title.en: Stage 1: Minutes 0-15, triage-point sorting and decontamination initiation
title.zh: 第1阶段：0-15分钟，入口分诊和开始去污
