content.en: 1909-1934: D completes the facility's decontamination irrigation and is re-assessed: alert and oriented, stridor audible without stethoscope, RR 34, SpO2 89% on room air, HR 112, BP 134/86. She is cleared to enter the ED and moved into the second resuscitation bay. Humidified oxygen by non-rebreather at 15 L/min is applied; nebulized albuterol and IV dexamethasone are ordered; airway equipment, continuous pulse oximetry, bronchodilator therapy, and difficult-airway backup are prepared. After the first albuterol treatment, SpO2 improves to 92% but stridor persists; anesthesiology standby is requested. C's BP falls to 82/58 after 1 L warmed normal saline, HR 134, tourniquet in place, and mental status worsens to pain-only response. Massive transfusion is activated; two units O-negative PRBCs are initiated; orthopedics is contacted for emergent operative fixation. E remains stable after 500 mL LR: HR 98, BP 122/76, RR 22, SpO2 95% on 2 L nasal cannula; morphine is given and burn-center transfer is initiated. G is confirmed deceased outside the ED and covered per MCI morgue protocol. Two additional nurses arrive at 1929; one is assigned to D and one begins formal assessment of B and F.
content.zh: 1909-1934：D完成机构规定的去污冲洗并重新评估：清醒定向，不用听诊器即可听到喘鸣，RR 34，室内空气SpO2 89%，HR 112，BP 134/86。确认可进入急诊后，被转入第二间复苏间。给予15 L/min非再呼吸面罩湿化氧；医嘱雾化albuterol和IV dexamethasone；准备气道设备、连续脉搏血氧监测、支气管扩张治疗和困难气道备用方案。第一次albuterol后SpO2升至92%，但喘鸣仍在；请求麻醉科待命。C在1 L温生理盐水后BP降至82/58，HR 134，止血带仍在位，意识恶化为仅对疼痛有反应。启动大量输血；开始2单位O阴性PRBC；联系骨科进行急诊手术固定。E在500 mL LR后仍稳定：HR 98，BP 122/76，RR 22，2 L鼻导管SpO2 95%；给予morphine并启动烧伤中心转运。G在急诊外确认死亡，并按MCI太平间流程覆盖。1929又到达2名护士；一名分配给D，一名开始正式评估B和F。

title.zh: 第2阶段更新

title.en: Stage 2: Minutes 15-40, treatment-area management and decontamination completion
title.zh: 第2阶段：15-40分钟，治疗区处理和完成去污

content.en: 1934-2009: C returns after emergent external fixation and hemorrhage control. HR 108, BP 98/64, RR 20, SpO2 97% on 4 L nasal cannula. He received four units PRBCs total and is now responsive to voice and following commands; urine output is 25 mL in the past hour. D improves after additional albuterol and dexamethasone: stridor diminished, SpO2 94% on oxygen, RR 24, speaking in full sentences. Because severe ammonia exposure can worsen after arrival, she remains under continued observation/admission-level monitoring for recurrent airway compromise and noncardiogenic pulmonary edema. E is accepted by the burn center, hemodynamically stable, pain 4/10, awaiting helicopter transport. B's laceration is irrigated and sutured, tetanus prophylaxis given, and she is discharged with wound-care instructions. F has intact tympanic membranes, normal neurologic exam, and improving headache; she is discharged after observation with blast-injury precautions. At 2000 the charge nurse performs a re-triage sweep: five treated, two deceased (A and G), two discharged (B and F), one awaiting transfer (E), and two improving in the ED (C and D).
content.zh: 1934-2009：C在急诊外固定和止血后返回。HR 108，BP 98/64，RR 20，4 L鼻导管SpO2 97%。共输注4单位PRBC；现在对声音有反应并能按指令动作；过去1小时尿量25 mL。D在追加albuterol和dexamethasone后改善：喘鸣减轻，吸氧下SpO2 94%，RR 24，能完整说话。由于严重氨暴露到院后仍可能恶化，她继续接受观察/住院级监测，以防再次气道受损和非心源性肺水肿。E已被烧伤中心接收，血流动力学稳定，疼痛4/10，等待直升机转运。B的裂伤已冲洗和缝合，给予破伤风预防，并带伤口护理指导出院。F鼓膜完整，神经检查正常，头痛改善；观察后带爆炸伤注意事项出院。2000，charge nurse完成重新分诊巡视：5名接受治疗，2名死亡（A和G），2名出院（B和F），1名等待转运（E），2名在急诊内改善（C和D）。

title.zh: 第3阶段更新

title.en: Stage 3: Minutes 40-75, reassessment, re-triage, and resource reallocation
title.zh: 第3阶段：40-75分钟，重新评估、重新分诊和资源再分配

summary.en: A community ED with limited staff and treatment space receives seven casualties after an industrial explosion and anhydrous-ammonia release. The charge nurse must apply START triage, protect the ED from chemical contamination, allocate scarce resources to salvageable casualties, and evaluate whether the MCI response was effective.
summary.zh: 一家人员和治疗空间有限的社区急诊在工业爆炸和无水氨释放后接收7名伤员。charge nurse必须应用START分诊，防止急诊被化学污染，将稀缺资源分配给可挽救伤员，并评估MCI应对是否有效。

title.en: Mass-casualty START triage with chemical contamination in a resource-limited emergency department
title.zh: 资源受限急诊中伴化学污染的大规模伤亡START分诊

payload.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

glossary.defZh: 伤员数超过常规治疗资源，需要灾难分诊和资源分配的事件。
按行走、呼吸、灌注和意识快速分类伤员的方法。
移除或稀释污染物以防持续暴露和二次污染。
在资源受限时不分配积极复苏资源的分诊类别。

correct.en: This case tests disaster nursing judgment: applying START triage objectively, recognizing that expectant categorization changes resuscitation decisions in resource-constrained MCI mode, sequencing contaminated-casualty care to protect staff and the ED, allocating scarce treatment spaces and blood products to salvageable casualties, and evaluating the response by survival of salvageable casualties and absence of secondary contamination rather than by zero mortality.
correct.zh: 本病例考查灾难护理判断：客观应用START分诊；认识到资源受限MCI中预期死亡分类会改变复苏决策；按顺序处理污染伤员以保护工作人员和急诊；将稀缺治疗空间和血制品分配给可挽救伤员；并以可挽救伤员存活和无二次污染来评价应对，而不是以零死亡为标准。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

testTakingStrategy.en: Anchor on the disaster protocol first, then apply airway/breathing/circulation and safety within the limits of salvageability, contamination control, and available resources.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 先抓住灾难流程，再在可挽救性、污染控制和可用资源限制内应用气道/呼吸/循环和安全原则。

content.en: Three weeks before arrival, the client had four days of bloody diarrhea, fever, and cramping. Stool culture at urgent care grew Campylobacter jejuni. He now reports five days of tingling and burning pain that began in both feet and ascended to the mid-thighs. Two days ago he had difficulty climbing stairs; today he had to grip the handrail to climb one flight. He denies shortness of breath, dysphagia, visual changes, bowel or bladder incontinence, or urinary retention at presentation.
content.zh: 到院前3周，患者曾有4天血性腹泻、发热和腹部绞痛；急诊门诊粪便培养提示空肠弯曲杆菌阳性。现在他诉5天前双足开始刺痛和烧灼痛，并逐渐上行至大腿中部。2天前开始爬楼困难，今天爬一层楼必须抓扶手。初诊时否认气短、吞咽困难、视觉改变、大小便失禁或尿潴留。

title.zh: 初始病史

content.en: T 36.8 C, HR 82, BP 126/78, RR 16, SpO2 98% on room air. Alert and oriented, no acute respiratory distress. Cranial nerves II-XII intact. Upper extremity strength 5/5. Lower extremity strength: hip flexion 4/5, knee extension 4/5, ankle dorsiflexion 3/5, great toe extension 3/5 bilaterally. Subjective stocking-distribution paresthesias to the knees; light touch and pinprick intact. Achilles and patellar reflexes absent bilaterally; biceps and brachioradialis reflexes trace. Plantar responses absent, no clonus, no sensory level, rectal tone normal. Wide-based gait with bilateral foot drop; Romberg positive. Lungs clear with symmetric expansion; heart rhythm regular.
content.zh: 体温98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，心率82次/分，血压126/78 mmHg，呼吸16次/分，室内空气SpO2 98%。神志清楚、定向力正常，无急性呼吸窘迫。第II-XII脑神经完整。上肢肌力5/5。下肢肌力：双侧髋屈曲4/5、膝伸展4/5、踝背屈3/5、拇趾伸展3/5。主诉膝以下袜套样感觉异常；轻触觉和针刺觉完整。双侧跟腱和髌腱反射消失；肱二头肌和桡骨膜反射1+。跖反应消失，无阵挛，无躯干感觉平面，直肠张力正常。宽基底步态伴双侧足下垂；Romberg征阳性。双肺清晰、胸廓扩张对称；心律规则。

title.zh: 初始评估

content.en: CBC, BMP, magnesium, phosphorus, calcium, CRP, ESR, TSH, hepatic panel, urinalysis, and CK are unremarkable. MRI thoracic/lumbar spine shows no cord compression, epidural abscess, or transverse myelitis signal; mild cauda equina nerve-root enhancement is present. Lumbar puncture: opening pressure 14 cmH2O, CSF protein 98 mg/dL, CSF glucose 62 mg/dL with serum glucose 96 mg/dL, CSF WBC 3 cells/uL, CSF RBC 0, Gram stain negative. Baseline bedside pulmonary function: FVC 3.6 L (42 mL/kg; about 75% predicted) and MIP -62 cmH2O. Nerve conduction studies show prolonged distal motor latencies, reduced conduction velocities, conduction block, and prolonged F-wave latencies consistent with acute inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy.
content.zh: CBC、BMP、镁、磷、钙、CRP、ESR、TSH、肝功能、尿液分析和CK均无明显异常。胸腰椎MRI未见脊髓压迫、硬膜外脓肿或横贯性脊髓炎信号；可见轻度马尾神经根强化。腰穿：开放压14 cmH2O，CSF蛋白98 mg/dL，CSF葡萄糖62 mg/dL（血糖96 mg/dL），CSF白细胞3个/uL，CSF红细胞0，革兰染色阴性。基线床旁肺功能：FVC 3.6 L（42 mL/kg，约为预计值75%），MIP -62 cmH2O。神经传导检查显示远端运动潜伏期延长、传导速度降低、传导阻滞和F波潜伏期延长，符合急性炎性脱髓鞘性多发神经病。

title.zh: 诊断资料

glossary.defZh: 深腱反射消失，是周围神经或下运动神经元受累的重要体征。
可引起胃肠炎，也是GBS常见感染后诱因之一。
躯干某一水平以下感觉改变，常提示脊髓病变而非单纯周围神经病变。

segments.en: Three weeks ago, stool culture grew Campylobacter jejuni after bloody diarrhea with fever.
segments.zh: 3周前血性腹泻伴发热后，粪便培养检出空肠弯曲杆菌。

segments.en: He reports five days of tingling and burning pain that began in both feet and ascended to the mid-thighs.
segments.zh: 他诉5天前双足开始刺痛和烧灼痛，并上行至大腿中部。

segments.en: He had difficulty climbing stairs and now must grip the handrail to climb one flight.
segments.zh: 他爬楼困难，现在爬一层楼必须抓扶手。

segments.en: SpO2 is 98% on room air.
segments.zh: 室内空气SpO2为98%。

segments.en: Upper extremity strength is 5/5 at presentation.
segments.zh: 初诊时上肢肌力为5/5。

segments.en: Lower extremity strength is reduced with bilateral ankle dorsiflexion 3/5 and great toe extension 3/5.
segments.zh: 下肢肌力下降，双侧踝背屈3/5、拇趾伸展3/5。

segments.en: Achilles and patellar reflexes are absent bilaterally.
segments.zh: 双侧跟腱反射和髌腱反射消失。

segments.en: There is no sensory level on the trunk and rectal tone is normal.
segments.zh: 躯干无感觉平面，直肠张力正常。

segments.en: The gait is wide-based with bilateral foot drop.
segments.zh: 步态宽基底并伴双侧足下垂。

segments.en: CBC, electrolytes, CK, ESR, and CRP are unremarkable.
segments.zh: CBC、电解质、CK、ESR和CRP无明显异常。

byChoice.en: A Campylobacter diarrheal illness 1-4 weeks before neurologic symptoms is a classic postinfectious trigger for GBS.
byChoice.zh: 神经症状前1-4周发生空肠弯曲杆菌性腹泻，是GBS经典的感染后诱因。

byChoice.en: Ascending paresthesias and pain over days fit the early peripheral nerve pattern of GBS.
byChoice.zh: 数日内上行的感觉异常和疼痛符合GBS早期周围神经受累模式。

byChoice.en: New stair-climbing difficulty shows functional progression, not a benign sensory complaint.
byChoice.zh: 新出现的爬楼困难显示功能正在进展，而不是良性的感觉主诉。

byChoice.en: Normal SpO2 does not rule out neuromuscular respiratory decline; it is not one of the key recognition cues in the initial neurologic pattern.
byChoice.zh: 正常SpO2不能排除神经肌肉性呼吸下降；它不是初始神经模式中的关键识别线索。

byChoice.en: Normal arm strength at presentation does not negate the lower-extremity ascending pattern and is not a key cue by itself.
byChoice.zh: 初诊时上肢肌力正常并不能否定下肢上行受累模式，本身不是关键线索。

byChoice.en: Bilateral distal leg weakness and foot dorsiflexion loss show symmetric motor involvement.
byChoice.zh: 双侧远端下肢无力和踝背屈下降显示对称性运动受累。

byChoice.en: Areflexia is a hallmark lower-motor-neuron clue in GBS.
byChoice.zh: 反射消失是GBS典型的下运动神经元线索。

byChoice.en: No sensory level and normal rectal tone help distinguish peripheral neuropathy from acute spinal cord pathology.
byChoice.zh: 无感觉平面且直肠张力正常，有助于区分周围神经病变与急性脊髓病变。

byChoice.en: Wide-based gait with bilateral foot drop demonstrates clinically important motor impairment.
byChoice.zh: 宽基底步态伴双侧足下垂提示具有临床意义的运动障碍。

byChoice.en: Normal inflammatory markers, electrolytes, and CK help rule out other processes but are not the main urgency cues for GBS recognition.
byChoice.zh: 炎症指标、电解质和CK正常有助于排除其他疾病，但不是识别GBS紧急性的主要线索。

correct.en: The urgent pattern is a recent Campylobacter infection followed by rapidly progressive, symmetric, ascending sensory symptoms and weakness with areflexia and foot drop. The absence of a sensory level and preserved rectal tone make a spinal cord syndrome less likely, supporting urgent neurologic evaluation for GBS with respiratory monitoring.
correct.zh: 紧急模式是近期空肠弯曲杆菌感染后出现快速进展、对称、上行性感觉症状和无力，并伴反射消失和足下垂。无感觉平面且直肠张力保留，使脊髓综合征可能性较低，支持紧急神经科评估GBS并进行呼吸监测。

stem.en: Highlight the findings that should make the nurse urgently communicate concern for Guillain-Barre syndrome rather than treating the client as stable because he is still ambulatory.
stem.zh: 请标出哪些发现应使护士紧急沟通对格林-巴利综合征的担忧，而不是因为患者仍能行走就认为其稳定。

testTakingStrategy.en: In acute weakness questions, first decide whether the pattern is upper motor neuron, lower motor neuron, neuromuscular junction, or muscle. Ascending symmetric weakness with areflexia after infection points to peripheral nerve disease and requires respiratory planning even before oxygen saturation falls.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到急性无力题，先判断模式属于上运动神经元、下运动神经元、神经肌肉接头还是肌肉疾病。感染后对称性上行无力伴反射消失指向周围神经病变，即使氧饱和度尚未下降也需要考虑呼吸计划。

glossary.defZh: CSF蛋白升高但细胞数正常或接近正常，是GBS的支持性发现。
最大吸气后用力呼出的空气量，可反映通气肌能力。
也称NIF，数值越不负通常表示吸气肌越弱。

columns.zh: 主要呼吸趋势监测指标

rows.en: CSF protein 98 mg/dL with CSF WBC 3 cells/uL
rows.zh: CSF蛋白98 mg/dL，CSF白细胞3个/uL

rows.en: Nerve conduction studies show slowed conduction, conduction block, and prolonged F-wave latencies
rows.zh: 神经传导检查显示传导减慢、传导阻滞和F波潜伏期延长

rows.en: Serial bedside FVC and MIP measurements
rows.zh: 连续床旁FVC和MIP测量

rows.en: SpO2 remains 98% on room air at presentation
rows.zh: 初诊时室内空气SpO2仍为98%

rows.en: Baseline FVC 42 mL/kg and MIP -62 cmH2O
rows.zh: 基线FVC 42 mL/kg，MIP -62 cmH2O

byChoice.en: High CSF protein with a normal WBC count is albuminocytologic dissociation, a characteristic supportive finding in GBS; it is not the pleocytosis expected in bacterial meningitis.
byChoice.zh: CSF蛋白升高而白细胞正常属于蛋白细胞分离，是支持GBS的典型发现；这不是细菌性脑膜炎常见的白细胞显著增多。

byChoice.en: Slowed conduction, conduction block, and prolonged F waves are demyelinating features consistent with AIDP.
byChoice.zh: 传导减慢、传导阻滞和F波延长是脱髓鞘特征，符合AIDP。

byChoice.en: Serial FVC and MIP are the key respiratory measurements because they show whether inspiratory and ventilatory muscle strength is declining.
byChoice.zh: 连续FVC和MIP是关键呼吸测量，因为它们显示吸气和通气肌力是否下降。

byChoice.en: Pulse oximetry is a lagging marker in neuromuscular respiratory failure and can falsely reassure the nurse early in the decline.
byChoice.zh: 在神经肌肉性呼吸衰竭中，脉搏血氧是滞后指标，早期可能使护士误以为安全。

byChoice.en: The baseline values are currently adequate but must be trended; falling FVC or a less negative MIP would indicate worsening respiratory muscle function.
byChoice.zh: 基线数值目前尚可，但必须追踪趋势；FVC下降或MIP变得不那么负，表示呼吸肌功能恶化。

correct.en: Albuminocytologic dissociation and demyelinating nerve conduction findings support GBS/AIDP. FVC and MIP directly track respiratory muscle capacity and must be followed serially. A normal SpO2 can be misleading because oxygenation may remain normal until ventilatory failure is advanced.
correct.zh: 蛋白细胞分离和脱髓鞘性神经传导结果支持GBS/AIDP。FVC和MIP直接反映呼吸肌能力，必须连续追踪。正常SpO2可能误导，因为氧合可在通气衰竭已很严重时才下降。

stem.en: For each finding, choose the interpretation that best guides the nurse's understanding of the diagnosis and ongoing monitoring.
stem.zh: 针对每项发现，选择最能指导护士理解诊断和后续监测的解释。

testTakingStrategy.en: When the lungs are healthy but muscles are weak, do not anchor on oxygen saturation. Choose measures that test mechanics: vital capacity, inspiratory force, cough strength, and bulbar protection.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当肺本身健康但肌肉无力时，不要锚定氧饱和度。应选择能测试机械功能的指标：肺活量、吸气力、咳嗽能力和延髓/吞咽保护功能。

glossary.defZh: GBS最常见变异型，主要累及周围神经髓鞘。
glossary.termZh: 急性炎性脱髓鞘性多发神经病

glossary.defZh: 包括痉挛、反射亢进、Babinski征等，常提示中枢神经通路病变。
重复使用肌肉后加重、休息后改善的无力，典型见于重症肌无力。

options.en: Myasthenia gravis crisis
options.zh: 重症肌无力危象

options.en: Transverse myelitis
options.zh: 横贯性脊髓炎

options.en: Acute spinal cord compression
options.zh: 急性脊髓压迫

options.en: Guillain-Barre syndrome, acute inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy variant
options.zh: 格林-巴利综合征，急性炎性脱髓鞘性多发神经病变型

byChoice.en: Transverse myelitis usually causes cord signal abnormality, a sensory level, and early bowel/bladder dysfunction; these are absent at presentation.
byChoice.zh: 横贯性脊髓炎通常有脊髓信号异常、感觉平面和早期大小便功能障碍；本例初诊时没有这些表现。

byChoice.en: Myasthenia gravis causes fatigable fluctuating weakness, often ocular or bulbar first, and reflexes are preserved; this client has fixed ascending weakness with areflexia.
byChoice.zh: 重症肌无力造成易疲劳、波动性无力，常先累及眼肌或延髓肌，且反射保留；本例为固定性上行无力伴反射消失。

byChoice.en: This option integrates all major cues: preceding Campylobacter infection, ascending symmetric weakness, areflexia, CSF protein elevation without pleocytosis, and demyelinating NCS.
byChoice.zh: 此选项整合了所有主要线索：先前弯曲杆菌感染、对称性上行无力、反射消失、CSF蛋白升高但无白细胞增多、以及脱髓鞘性神经传导检查。

byChoice.en: Cord compression would be expected to show cord imaging abnormality, a sensory level, and often upper-motor-neuron signs; the MRI is negative and the reflex pattern is lower motor neuron.
byChoice.zh: 脊髓压迫通常会有脊髓影像异常、感觉平面，并常有上运动神经元体征；本例MRI阴性，反射模式为下运动神经元受累。

correct.en: GBS/AIDP best explains postinfectious onset, symmetric ascending weakness, areflexia, albuminocytologic dissociation, demyelinating nerve conduction findings, and lack of cord signs. The other diagnoses have key expected findings that are absent or contradicted by the case.
correct.zh: GBS/AIDP最能解释感染后发病、对称性上行无力、反射消失、蛋白细胞分离、脱髓鞘性神经传导结果以及缺乏脊髓体征。其他诊断预期会出现的关键发现，在本病例中缺失或被事实反驳。

stem.en: The nurse is comparing the most likely diagnosis with acute spinal cord compression, transverse myelitis, and myasthenia gravis. Which diagnosis best matches the full clinical picture?
stem.zh: 护士正在将最可能的诊断与急性脊髓压迫、横贯性脊髓炎和重症肌无力进行比较。哪项诊断最符合完整临床表现？

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not diagnose acute weakness by the word 'ascending' alone. Match the reflexes, imaging, sensory level, bowel/bladder pattern, and weakness type to the disease process.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要仅凭“上行”一词诊断急性无力。要把反射、影像、感觉平面、大小便模式和无力类型与疾病过程相匹配。

glossary.defZh: 用于调节免疫反应的血制品，可用于GBS等疾病。
去除含有致病抗体或炎症介质的血浆并替换的治疗。
反映吸气肌产生负压能力，数值越不负通常表示肌力越差。

options.en: Per the case parameters, FVC less than 20 mL/kg or MIP weaker than -30 cmH2O should trigger preparation for intubation/escalation.
options.zh: 根据本病例参数，FVC低于20 mL/kg或MIP弱于-30 cmH2O时，应准备插管/升级处理。

options.en: If a corticosteroid order appears for GBS treatment alone, the nurse should clarify it before administration.
options.zh: 如果出现仅用于治疗GBS的糖皮质激素医嘱，护士应在给药前澄清。

options.en: A falling FVC and a MIP that becomes less negative indicate weakening respiratory muscles.
options.zh: FVC下降且MIP变得不那么负，提示呼吸肌变弱。

options.en: IVIG and plasma exchange are disease-modifying therapies used for GBS; IVIG should be started as ordered.
options.zh: IVIG和血浆置换是GBS的疾病修饰治疗；应按医嘱开始IVIG。

options.en: Normal SpO2 means the client is not at risk for respiratory failure during the next several hours.
options.zh: SpO2正常表示患者在未来数小时内没有呼吸衰竭风险。

options.en: High-dose corticosteroids are expected first-line therapy because GBS is immune-mediated.
options.zh: 由于GBS是免疫介导性疾病，预计一线治疗应为大剂量糖皮质激素。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. The common 'autoimmune equals steroids' shortcut is unsafe here; corticosteroids are not recommended as GBS treatment.
byChoice.zh: 错误。把“自身免疫”等同于“用激素”的捷径在此不安全；糖皮质激素不推荐用于GBS治疗。

byChoice.en: Correct. These are the provider-stated case thresholds, and the nurse should act before waiting for severe hypoxemia.
byChoice.zh: 正确。这些是本病例医嘱规定的阈值，护士应在严重低氧前采取行动。

byChoice.en: Correct. Clarifying a potentially inappropriate disease-specific order is within safe nursing practice.
byChoice.zh: 正确。澄清可能不适合该疾病的医嘱属于安全护理实践。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. SpO2 can remain normal until neuromuscular ventilatory failure is advanced.
byChoice.zh: 错误。SpO2可在神经肌肉性通气衰竭已很严重时仍保持正常。

byChoice.en: Correct. MIP is a negative pressure; movement from -62 to -26 cmH2O is weaker, not stronger.
byChoice.zh: 正确。MIP是负压；从-62变为-26 cmH2O表示更弱，而不是更强。

byChoice.en: Correct. IVIG is the ordered immunotherapy and should not be delayed once prepared unless a safety issue arises.
byChoice.zh: 正确。IVIG是医嘱免疫治疗，准备好后不应无故延迟，除非出现安全问题。

correct.en: The ordered IVIG is appropriate disease-modifying therapy. Respiratory decisions in this case are driven by serial FVC and MIP: falling FVC and less negative MIP mean worsening muscle strength. The case-stated escalation thresholds are FVC less than 20 mL/kg or MIP weaker than -30 cmH2O. Corticosteroids are not recommended for GBS treatment and should be clarified if ordered for that purpose.
correct.zh: 医嘱IVIG是合适的疾病修饰治疗。本病例的呼吸决策由连续FVC和MIP驱动：FVC下降且MIP不那么负表示肌力恶化。病例规定的升级阈值为FVC低于20 mL/kg或MIP弱于-30 cmH2O。糖皮质激素不推荐用于GBS治疗，若为此目的开立应澄清。

stem.en: The provider has diagnosed GBS and ordered IVIG, serial FVC/MIP, and ICU notification if respiratory parameters decline. Which statements show correct nursing understanding of the treatment plan and provider-stated respiratory thresholds? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 医生已诊断GBS，并医嘱IVIG、连续FVC/MIP监测，以及若呼吸参数下降则通知ICU。哪些说法体现护士正确理解治疗计划和医嘱规定的呼吸阈值？选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a case gives explicit provider thresholds, use those thresholds. Then check whether the action is nursing implementation, monitoring, or clarification of an unsafe order.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当病例给出明确医嘱阈值时，应使用这些阈值。再判断行动属于护理执行、监测，还是澄清不安全医嘱。

glossary.defZh: 影响吞咽、咳嗽、咽反射和分泌物清除的肌无力，会增加误吸和气道风险。
自主神经调节异常，可导致心率、血压、胃肠和膀胱功能波动。
将气管导管置入气管以保护气道并支持机械通气。

options.en: Maintain continuous cardiac telemetry and anticipate treatment of labile blood pressure with short-acting titrated agents as ordered.
options.zh: 维持连续心电监护，并预期按医嘱使用短效可滴定药物处理血压波动。

options.en: Prepare for and assist with emergent endotracheal intubation.
options.zh: 准备并协助紧急气管插管。

options.en: Ensure suction, oxygen delivery equipment, IV access, rapid sequence medication readiness as directed, and continuous monitoring are in place.
options.zh: 确保吸引、供氧设备、静脉通路、按医嘱准备快速序贯插管用药，以及连续监测到位。

options.en: Continue the IVIG infusion on schedule through the airway transition unless a separate infusion reaction or safety issue occurs.
options.zh: 除非发生单独的输注反应或安全问题，应在气道处理过程中按计划继续IVIG输注。

options.en: Wait for SpO2 to fall below 90% before escalating airway management.
options.zh: 等待SpO2降至90%以下后再升级气道管理。

options.en: Initiate BiPAP as the preferred substitute for intubation because he is still awake.
options.zh: 因为患者仍清醒，优先使用BiPAP替代插管。

byChoice.en: Correct. These are immediate nursing preparations that support safe intubation and post-intubation stabilization.
byChoice.zh: 正确。这些是护士为安全插管和插管后稳定所需的立即准备。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Waiting for worse hypoxemia risks respiratory arrest because SpO2 is a late marker in neuromuscular failure.
byChoice.zh: 错误。等待更严重低氧会增加呼吸骤停风险，因为SpO2在神经肌肉衰竭中是滞后指标。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. BiPAP does not protect the airway and is unsafe when cough and gag are impaired with a downward trajectory.
byChoice.zh: 错误。BiPAP不能保护气道；在咳嗽和咽反射受损且病情下降时不安全。

byChoice.en: Correct. Intubation treats respiratory failure but does not replace immunotherapy for the underlying GBS.
byChoice.zh: 正确。插管处理呼吸衰竭，但不能替代治疗GBS本身的免疫治疗。

byChoice.en: Correct. FVC 19 mL/kg and MIP -26 cmH2O meet the case thresholds, and ineffective cough/absent gag make airway protection urgent.
byChoice.zh: 正确。FVC 19 mL/kg和MIP -26 cmH2O达到本病例阈值，且咳嗽无效/咽反射消失使气道保护十分紧急。

byChoice.en: Correct. GBS dysautonomia can cause tachycardia, bradycardia, arrhythmias, and abrupt BP changes requiring close monitoring and titrated therapy.
byChoice.zh: 正确。GBS自主神经功能障碍可导致心动过速、心动过缓、心律失常和突发血压变化，需要密切监测和滴定治疗。

correct.en: Both provider-stated respiratory thresholds have been crossed, and the clinical signs confirm impending ventilatory failure with poor airway protection. The nurse should prepare for intubation, support safe airway management, continue disease-modifying IVIG, and maintain telemetry because dysautonomia can cause dangerous BP and rhythm swings.
correct.zh: 两个医嘱规定的呼吸阈值均已越过，临床表现证实即将发生通气衰竭并伴气道保护差。护士应准备插管，支持安全气道管理，继续疾病修饰性IVIG，并维持心电监护，因为自主神经功能障碍可导致危险的血压和心律波动。

stem.en: At hour 20, the client has FVC 19 mL/kg, MIP -26 cmH2O, ineffective cough, diaphoresis, labored RR 28, SpO2 93% on 2 L nasal cannula, autonomic instability, and unilateral absent gag reflex. Which nursing actions are priorities? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第20小时，患者FVC 19 mL/kg、MIP -26 cmH2O、咳嗽无效、出汗、RR 28且费力、2 L鼻导管下SpO2 93%、自主神经不稳定，并有单侧咽反射消失。哪些护理行动是优先事项？选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: When objective thresholds and clinical signs both point to airway failure, act on the airway. Do not use a still-awake client or a not-yet-critical SpO2 as reassurance.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当客观阈值和临床表现都指向气道/通气失败时，应处理气道。不要因为患者仍清醒或SpO2尚未极低就感到放心。

clozeStem.en: The client's day-5 findings are most consistent with {{1}}. Extubation is {{2}} because {{3}}. The narrowing heart-rate and blood-pressure swings suggest {{4}}, and nursing care should continue to include {{5}}.
clozeStem.zh: 患者第5天的表现最符合 {{1}}。因为 {{3}}，所以 {{2}}。心率和血压波动范围缩小提示 {{4}}，护理仍应包括 {{5}}。

options.en: resolution of GBS and readiness for discharge
options.zh: GBS已缓解并准备出院

options.en: the expected plateau phase after progression
options.zh: 进展期后的预期平台期

options.en: clear failure of IVIG requiring automatic repeat dosing
options.zh: IVIG明确失败，需要自动重复给药

options.en: unrelated to respiratory muscle measurements
options.zh: 与呼吸肌测量无关

options.en: not yet indicated
options.zh: 尚不适合

options.en: safe now because SpO2 is adequate
options.zh: 因SpO2足够而现在安全

options.en: the bowel sounds have returned
options.zh: 肠鸣音已经恢复

options.en: FVC 13 mL/kg and MIP -22 cmH2O remain below the case's safe extubation trajectory
options.zh: FVC 13 mL/kg且MIP -22 cmH2O仍低于本病例安全拔管所需趋势

options.en: the CSF protein is still elevated
options.zh: CSF蛋白仍然升高

options.en: new bacterial meningitis
options.zh: 新发细菌性脑膜炎

options.en: worsening spinal cord compression
options.zh: 脊髓压迫加重

options.en: improving autonomic stability
options.zh: 自主神经稳定性改善

options.en: stopping rehabilitation until the client can move independently
options.zh: 在患者能自主活动前停止康复

options.en: DVT prevention, passive range of motion, pain control, communication support, and psychosocial care
options.zh: DVT预防、被动关节活动、疼痛控制、沟通支持和心理社会护理

options.en: repeating lumbar puncture daily to follow CSF protein
options.zh: 每日重复腰穿以追踪CSF蛋白

glossary.defZh: GBS进展停止但尚未明显恢复的阶段，可持续数天至数周。
通过颈部气管开口建立长期气道，用于预计需要较长时间通气支持的患者。
由护理人员或治疗师移动患者关节，以减少僵硬、挛缩和并发症。

byChoice.en: The plateau phase is expected after progression; lack of rapid reversal does not automatically mean IVIG failure.
byChoice.zh: 进展期后的平台期是预期过程；没有快速逆转并不自动表示IVIG失败。

byChoice.en: Extubation is not yet indicated because the measured respiratory mechanics remain weak despite some improvement.
byChoice.zh: 尽管有所改善，但呼吸力学测量仍弱，因此尚不适合拔管。

byChoice.en: FVC 13 mL/kg and MIP -22 cmH2O are the relevant barriers to extubation; CSF protein and bowel sounds do not determine ventilator readiness.
byChoice.zh: FVC 13 mL/kg和MIP -22 cmH2O是拔管的相关障碍；CSF蛋白和肠鸣音不能决定是否可脱机/拔管。

byChoice.en: Narrower HR and BP ranges indicate improving autonomic regulation compared with earlier ICU swings.
byChoice.zh: 与早期ICU波动相比，HR和BP范围缩小提示自主神经调节改善。

byChoice.en: Complication prevention, rehabilitation, pain control, communication, and psychosocial support remain nursing priorities during ventilator-dependent plateau.
byChoice.zh: 在依赖呼吸机的平台期，预防并发症、康复、疼痛控制、沟通和心理社会支持仍是护理重点。

correct.en: The day-5 findings fit the plateau phase: weakness has stopped worsening and autonomic and bowel findings are improving, but respiratory mechanics remain too weak for extubation. Slow recovery is expected, and nursing care must continue prevention of complications, rehabilitation support, pain management, communication support, and attention to fear and helplessness.
correct.zh: 第5天表现符合平台期：无力不再恶化，自主神经和肠道表现改善，但呼吸力学仍太弱，不适合拔管。GBS恢复通常缓慢，护理必须继续预防并发症、支持康复、管理疼痛、提供沟通支持，并关注恐惧和无助感。

stem.en: Complete the nurse's evaluation of the day-5 ICU status.
stem.zh: 完成护士对ICU第5天状态的评估。

testTakingStrategy.en: For evaluate-outcomes items, compare the trend across systems. Improvement in one domain does not equal readiness for discharge or extubation if the priority domain remains unsafe.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做评估结果题时，要跨系统比较趋势。某一方面改善并不等于可出院或拔管；若优先领域仍不安全，就不能升级为“恢复”。

content.en: Neurology confirms Guillain-Barre syndrome, AIDP variant. Orders include IVIG 0.4 g/kg/day IV for 5 days, serial FVC and MIP every 4 hours, continuous telemetry, enoxaparin and SCDs for DVT prophylaxis, gabapentin for neuropathic pain, strict intake/output, and bladder scan if no void within 6 hours. At hour 4, FVC is 3.4 L (40 mL/kg) and MIP -58 cmH2O. Tingling reaches the fingertips and grip/wrist extension are 4+/5. At hour 8, FVC is 3.1 L (36 mL/kg), MIP -48 cmH2O, single-breath count 14, SpO2 97% on room air, RR 18, and mild bilateral facial weakness appears. At hour 12, FVC is 2.6 L (31 mL/kg), MIP -38 cmH2O, single-breath count 10, RR 20, SpO2 96% on room air, accessory muscle use appears, cough is weaker, upper and lower extremity strength decline, and bladder scan shows 420 mL after no void for 4 hours. Foley catheter is ordered; ICU is notified of the trajectory.
content.zh: 神经内科确认格林-巴利综合征，AIDP变异型。医嘱包括IVIG 0.4 g/kg/day IV连续5天、每4小时测FVC和MIP、连续心电监护、依诺肝素和SCD预防DVT、加巴喷丁治疗神经痛、严格记录出入量，以及6小时未排尿时膀胱扫描。第4小时，FVC 3.4 L（40 mL/kg），MIP -58 cmH2O；麻木刺痛到达指尖，握力和腕伸展4+/5。第8小时，FVC 3.1 L（36 mL/kg），MIP -48 cmH2O，单次呼气计数14，室内空气SpO2 97%，RR 18，并出现轻度双侧面瘫。第12小时，FVC 2.6 L（31 mL/kg），MIP -38 cmH2O，单次呼气计数10，RR 20，室内空气SpO2 96%，出现辅助呼吸肌使用、咳嗽变弱，上下肢肌力下降，4小时未排尿后膀胱扫描420 mL。医嘱置入Foley导尿管；因病情趋势通知ICU。

title.zh: 阶段1：最初12小时
阶段1：最初12小时

content.en: At hour 16, FVC is 2.0 L (24 mL/kg) and MIP -32 cmH2O. The client is anxious, speaks in shorter sentences, says he feels like he is breathing through a straw, has RR 24 and shallow, HR 112, labile BP ranging 156/98 to 98/62 within 30 minutes, occasional PVCs, worsening facial weakness, inability to lift arms above the head, lower extremities 2/5 proximally and 1/5 distally, and absent gag reflex on the left side. He transfers to ICU for impending respiratory failure. At hour 20, FVC is 1.6 L (19 mL/kg) and MIP -26 cmH2O. He speaks only a few words at a time, cannot cough effectively, is diaphoretic, has SpO2 93% on 2 L nasal cannula, HR 118, BP 162/100, RR 28 and labored. The provider orders emergent endotracheal intubation. He is intubated without complication and placed on assist-control ventilation; post-intubation ABG is pH 7.34, PaCO2 48, PaO2 142, HCO3 25. IVIG continues on schedule.
content.zh: 第16小时，FVC 2.0 L（24 mL/kg），MIP -32 cmH2O。患者焦虑，说话句子变短，称自己像“通过吸管呼吸”，RR 24且浅快，HR 112，30分钟内血压在156/98至98/62之间波动，偶发PVC，面瘫加重，无法将手臂举过头，下肢近端2/5、远端1/5，左侧咽反射消失。因即将发生呼吸衰竭转入ICU。第20小时，FVC 1.6 L（19 mL/kg），MIP -26 cmH2O。患者一次只能说几个词，无法有效咳嗽，出汗，2 L鼻导管下SpO2 93%，HR 118，BP 162/100，RR 28且费力。医生医嘱紧急气管插管。插管顺利后使用辅助控制通气；插管后ABG为pH 7.34、PaCO2 48、PaO2 142、HCO3 25。IVIG按计划继续。

title.zh: 阶段2：转入ICU并气管插管
阶段2：转入ICU并气管插管

content.en: The client remains intubated and mechanically ventilated. IVIG is completed through day 5. Autonomic instability persists initially with HR 56-128, BP 88/54-172/104, and two brief self-terminating SVT runs. Short-acting agents are titrated for BP swings. On ICU day 3, ileus develops with absent bowel sounds and abdominal distension; NG tube is placed to low intermittent suction and enteral feeding is held. By ICU day 4, weakness plateaus: upper extremities 2/5, lower extremities 1/5, stable facial weakness, absent gag bilaterally. FVC on a brief spontaneous breathing trial is 0.9 L (11 mL/kg) and MIP -18 cmH2O. He communicates by blinking and mouthing words, is tearful, and fears he will never walk again. Passive ROM, DVT prophylaxis, pain control, and SLP communication support continue. By ICU day 5, autonomic swings narrow to HR 68-102 and BP 104/66-146/88. Bowel sounds return and enteral nutrition restarts. FVC is 1.1 L (13 mL/kg) and MIP -22 cmH2O, improved from nadir but still below safe extubation parameters. The ICU team discusses possible tracheostomy if FVC does not improve toward at least 20 mL/kg over the next several days.
content.zh: 患者继续气管插管和机械通气。IVIG完成至第5天。早期仍有自主神经不稳定，HR 56-128，BP 88/54-172/104，并有2次短暂自行终止的SVT。团队使用短效药物滴定处理血压波动。ICU第3天出现肠麻痹，肠鸣音消失并腹胀；置入NG管低间歇吸引并暂停肠内喂养。到ICU第4天，肌无力进入平台期：上肢2/5，下肢1/5，面瘫稳定，双侧咽反射消失。短暂自主呼吸试验中FVC 0.9 L（11 mL/kg），MIP -18 cmH2O。患者通过眨眼和口型交流，流泪，并担心自己再也无法行走。继续被动ROM、DVT预防、疼痛控制和SLP沟通支持。到ICU第5天，自主神经波动缩小至HR 68-102、BP 104/66-146/88。肠鸣音恢复并重新开始肠内营养。FVC 1.1 L（13 mL/kg），MIP -22 cmH2O，较最低点改善但仍低于安全拔管参数。ICU团队讨论若未来数日FVC未向至少20 mL/kg改善，可能需要气管切开。

title.zh: 阶段3：ICU第2至第5天
阶段3：ICU第2至第5天

summary.en: A 32-year-old previously healthy man presents with five days of progressive ascending paresthesias, neuropathic leg pain, wide-based gait, bilateral foot drop, and absent lower-extremity deep tendon reflexes after a Campylobacter jejuni diarrheal illness three weeks earlier. Initial oxygenation is normal, but the care team obtains baseline and serial bedside FVC and MIP measurements because Guillain-Barre syndrome can progress rapidly to neuromuscular respiratory failure.
summary.zh: 一名既往健康的32岁男性在3周前发生空肠弯曲杆菌性腹泻后，出现5天进行性上行性感觉异常、神经性腿痛、宽基底步态、双侧足下垂以及下肢深腱反射消失。初始氧合正常，但医疗团队安排基线和连续床旁FVC与MIP测量，因为格林-巴利综合征可迅速进展为神经肌肉性呼吸衰竭。

title.en: Guillain-Barre syndrome with progressive respiratory compromise after Campylobacter enteritis
title.zh: 弯曲杆菌肠炎后发生进行性呼吸受累的格林-巴利综合征

glossary.defZh: 急性免疫介导的周围神经病，可导致上行性无力、反射消失、自主神经功能障碍和呼吸衰竭。
GBS常见变异型，以周围神经髓鞘受损为主。
glossary.termZh: 急性炎性脱髓鞘性多发神经病

glossary.defZh: 因呼吸肌无力导致通气不足，早期SpO2可仍正常。
心率、血压和胃肠/膀胱功能出现不可预测波动。

correct.en: This case follows the clinical judgment arc of GBS after Campylobacter infection: recognizing ascending symmetric weakness with areflexia; interpreting albuminocytologic dissociation and demyelinating NCS as supportive diagnostic data; prioritizing GBS over cord compression, transverse myelitis, and myasthenia gravis; using serial FVC and MIP rather than SpO2 alone to detect neuromuscular respiratory decline; preparing for intubation once the case thresholds and airway-protection findings are met; and evaluating plateau-phase recovery while continuing complication prevention and psychosocial support.
correct.zh: 本病例体现了空肠弯曲杆菌感染后GBS的临床判断过程：识别对称性上行无力伴反射消失；将蛋白细胞分离和脱髓鞘性神经传导检查解释为支持性诊断资料；在脊髓压迫、横贯性脊髓炎和重症肌无力之间优先考虑GBS；使用连续FVC和MIP而不是仅凭SpO2发现神经肌肉性呼吸下降；当病例阈值和气道保护受损表现达到时准备插管；并在平台期评估恢复，同时继续预防并发症和提供心理社会支持。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

testTakingStrategy.en: Track what changed over time. In GBS, the dangerous change is not oxygenation first; it is loss of respiratory muscle strength, cough, bulbar protection, and autonomic stability.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 追踪随时间变化的内容。在GBS中，危险变化首先不是氧合，而是呼吸肌力、咳嗽、延髓/吞咽保护和自主神经稳定性的丧失。

content.en: Mrs. Torrance is postoperative day 1 after ORIF of a left tibial plateau fracture. She is alert, oriented, and participates in care. Emergency contact/authorized contact listed in the chart: adult daughter Megan Torrance only. The facility policy requires the nurse who discovers or witnesses a potential privacy breach to immediately mitigate exposure, notify the charge nurse, complete an electronic incident report, and ensure same-shift notification to the unit manager and Privacy Officer. Incident reports are quality-improvement documents and must not be referenced in the medical record.
content.zh: Torrance女士左胫骨平台骨折ORIF术后第1天。她清醒、定向力正常，并参与自己的照护。病历中列出的紧急/授权联系人仅为成年女儿Megan Torrance。机构政策要求发现或目击潜在隐私泄露的护士立即控制暴露、通知 charge nurse、完成电子事件报告，并确保同班次通知单元经理和隐私官。事件报告属于质量改进文件，不得在病历中提及。

title.en: Baseline client profile and facility policy
title.zh: 基线患者资料与机构政策

content.en: 0715 vital signs: T 99 °F (37.2 °C), HR 78/min, BP 134/82 mm Hg, RR 14/min, SpO2 97% on room air. Dressing is clean, dry, and intact; distal neurovascular status is intact. Pain is 4/10. 0600 labs: Hgb 11.4 g/dL, creatinine 1.3 mg/dL, eGFR 52 mL/min, glucose 168 mg/dL. Mrs. Torrance says she is worried about how long she will be off work and whether her employer will learn details of her medical condition.
content.zh: 0715生命体征：T 99 °F (37.2 °C)，HR 78次/分，BP 134/82 mm Hg，RR 14次/分，室内空气SpO2 97%。敷料清洁、干燥、完整；远端神经血管状态完整。疼痛4/10。0600化验：Hgb 11.4 g/dL，肌酐1.3 mg/dL，eGFR 52 mL/min，血糖168 mg/dL。Torrance女士表示担心自己要停工多久，以及雇主是否会知道她病情细节。

title.zh: 0715评估与0600实验室资料

glossary.defZh: 患者未指定可接收其健康信息的人。
包含姓名、出生日期、病历号、腕带或其他足以识别患者资料的照片或视频。
关闭门、降低音量、使用私密区域等减少无意披露的措施。

options.en: Mrs. Torrance reports pain of 4 out of 10 while the nurse performs the routine morning assessment.
options.zh: 护士进行常规晨间评估时，Torrance女士报告疼痛4/10。

options.en: RN Casey opens Mrs. Torrance's operative report and medication record out of curiosity without a care role.
options.zh: Casey护士没有照护职责，却因好奇打开Torrance女士的手术记录和用药记录。

options.en: A caller who is not listed as an authorized contact asks for Mrs. Torrance's laboratory results and discharge timing.
options.zh: 未列为授权联系人的来电者要求得知Torrance女士的化验结果和出院时间。

options.en: A nursing student photographs the wound on a personal phone with the hospital identification band visible.
options.zh: 护生用个人手机拍摄伤口照片，且照片中能看到医院身份腕带。

options.en: The employer faxes the nursing unit requesting admission records and operative reports without a signed authorization.
options.zh: 雇主将索取入院记录和手术报告的传真发到护理单元，但未附患者签署的授权书。

options.en: Two nurses discuss another client's HIV status by name in the hallway where a visitor can hear.
options.zh: 两名护士在走廊按姓名讨论另一名患者的HIV状态，旁边访客能够听见。

byChoice.en: Do not disclose information to a caller who is not verified and not authorized by the patient.
byChoice.zh: 来电者未核实且未获患者授权时，不能披露患者信息。

byChoice.en: An employer's request routed to the unit without patient authorization or confirmed legal basis must not be released by nursing staff.
byChoice.zh: 雇主请求发到护理单元且无患者授权或已确认法律依据时，护理人员不能释放资料。

byChoice.en: Pain assessment by the assigned nurse is part of routine care and is not a disclosure to an unauthorized person.
byChoice.zh: 负责护士进行疼痛评估属于常规照护，并不是向未授权人员披露。

byChoice.en: A visitor hearing another patient's name, HIV status, and medications means reasonable safeguards were not used during verbal communication.
byChoice.zh: 访客能听到另一名患者的姓名、HIV状态和用药，说明口头沟通未采取合理保护措施。

byChoice.en: Viewing PHI without a treatment, payment, or operations purpose is an unauthorized access even if the information is not repeated to anyone.
byChoice.zh: 没有治疗、付款或运营需要而查看PHI，即使没有转述给他人，也属于未经授权访问。

byChoice.en: The photo contains identifiers and was taken on a personal phone without written consent, so it requires immediate containment and reporting.
byChoice.zh: 照片包含身份识别信息，且未经书面同意用个人手机拍摄，因此需要立即控制并上报。

correct.en: The unverified caller, curiosity-driven chart access, unauthorised employer request, identifiable photo on a personal device, and hallway report all create actual or potential privacy violations. The pain report during routine assessment is ordinary patient-care information used by the assigned nurse and is not itself a privacy event.
correct.zh: 未核实且未授权的来电、因好奇查看病历、雇主未授权索取病历、在个人设备上形成可识别患者身份的照片，以及在走廊可被旁人听到的交班，均属于实际或潜在隐私问题。常规评估中的疼痛报告是负责护士用于照护的信息，本身不是隐私事件。

stem.en: Which events from the morning require privacy follow-up by RN Jordan? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 上午发生的哪些事件需要Jordan护士进行隐私相关跟进？选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: Separate routine care from disclosure risk. Ask whether an unauthorized person accessed, received, or could hear identifiable health information.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 把常规照护与披露风险分开判断。重点看是否有未授权人员访问、接收或可能听到可识别的健康信息。

glossary.defZh: HIPAA允许使用或披露PHI的常见机构目的，但必须与工作职责相关。
在采取合理保护措施的情况下仍可能附带发生的有限披露。
患者允许特定个人或机构接收其健康信息的有效许可。

columns.en: Completed impermissible access or identifiable record as it occurred
columns.zh: 已经发生的未经允许访问或形成可识别记录

columns.en: Conditionally permissible only after authorization or legal basis is verified through the proper process
columns.zh: 只有通过正确流程核实授权或法律依据后才可能允许

columns.en: Verbal incidental disclosure risk because reasonable safeguards were not used
columns.zh: 因未采取合理保护措施造成的口头偶然披露风险

rows.en: RN Casey's curiosity-based EHR access
rows.zh: Casey护士因好奇访问电子病历

rows.en: Student's identifiable wound photograph on a personal phone
rows.zh: 护生用个人手机拍摄可识别身份的伤口照片

rows.en: Employer fax asking for records without authorization
rows.zh: 雇主无授权传真索取病历

rows.en: Caller claiming to be the patient's husband asks for results
rows.zh: 自称患者丈夫的来电者索要结果

rows.en: Hallway report about another patient's HIV status
rows.zh: 走廊交班谈及另一名患者HIV状态

byChoice.en: Curiosity is not a permitted treatment, payment, or healthcare-operations purpose for EHR access.
byChoice.zh: 好奇心不是治疗、付款或医疗运营所允许的电子病历访问目的。

byChoice.en: The photograph created an identifiable record on a personal device without consent.
byChoice.zh: 该照片在未经同意的情况下，在个人设备上形成了可识别患者身份的记录。

byChoice.en: Workers' compensation wording does not let a unit nurse release records; HIM must verify authorization or legal authority and minimum-necessary scope.
byChoice.zh: 写有工伤赔偿并不代表单元护士可以释放病历；HIM必须核实授权或法律依据以及最低必要范围。

byChoice.en: Being a spouse does not automatically authorize disclosure; the nurse must verify identity and the patient's permission.
byChoice.zh: 配偶身份并不会自动授权披露；护士必须核实身份并确认患者许可。

byChoice.en: Incidental disclosures are tolerated only when reasonable safeguards are used; naming a patient and HIV status within visitor earshot fails that standard.
byChoice.zh: 只有在采取合理保护措施时，偶然披露才可能被接受；在访客能听到的地方说出患者姓名和HIV状态不符合这一标准。

correct.en: RN Casey's access and the student's identifiable photo are completed impermissible events as they occurred. The employer and phone requests might be handled only through proper authorization or legal authority, but they are not disclosures the unit nurse can make as presented. The hallway report is a verbal disclosure risk because staff failed to use reasonable safeguards in a public area.
correct.zh: Casey护士访问病历和护生拍摄可识别照片，是已经发生的不当事件。雇主和电话请求只有在通过正确流程确认授权或法律依据后才可能处理，但按目前情形护理单元不能披露。走廊交班属于口头披露风险，因为工作人员在公共区域未采取合理保护措施。

stem.en: Classify each privacy event using the best description.
stem.zh: 用最恰当的描述对每个隐私事件进行分类。

testTakingStrategy.en: Classify the event by the pathway: internal access, external request, or verbal communication. Then ask whether the proper authorization, role, or safeguard exists.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 先按路径分类：内部访问、外部请求或口头沟通。再判断是否存在适当授权、工作角色或保护措施。

glossary.defZh: 记录谁在何时查看了哪些电子病历内容的系统日志。
在机构内工作或受机构管理、可能接触PHI的人。
有意打开或查看信息，而不是采取保护措施后仍无法避免的有限暴露。

options.en: The student's photograph that is still on one device and has not yet been transmitted
options.zh: 护生照片仍在一台设备上且尚未传送

options.en: RN Casey's unauthorized access to Mrs. Torrance's EHR
options.zh: Casey护士未经授权访问Torrance女士的电子病历

options.en: The unverified caller's request for results before any information is released
options.zh: 未核实来电者在信息尚未披露前索要结果

options.en: Mrs. Torrance's concern that her employer may learn details of her condition
options.zh: Torrance女士担心雇主会得知她病情细节

options.en: The employer's fax request before any records are released
options.zh: 雇主在尚未释放病历前发来的传真请求

byChoice.en: The fax request is inappropriate as submitted, but no records have been released and the request can be redirected to HIM.
byChoice.zh: 传真请求按目前情况不恰当，但病历尚未释放，可转给HIM处理。

byChoice.en: The photograph requires urgent containment and reporting, but in this case it is still limited to one device and has not been transmitted; RN Casey's EHR access is the broadest completed access exposure.
byChoice.zh: 照片需要紧急控制和上报，但在本病例中仍限于一台设备且未传送；Casey护士访问电子病历是范围最广的已发生访问暴露。

byChoice.en: The caller created a disclosure risk, but the nurse had not released information and can prevent disclosure by verifying authorization with the patient.
byChoice.zh: 来电造成披露风险，但护士尚未透露信息，可通过向患者核实授权来防止披露。

byChoice.en: The patient's concern is important context, not a completed unauthorized access event.
byChoice.zh: 患者的担心是重要背景，但不是已发生的未经授权访问事件。

byChoice.en: This is the priority because the information was actually viewed by a workforce member without a permitted purpose.
byChoice.zh: 这是优先项，因为工作人员已经在没有允许目的的情况下实际查看了资料。

correct.en: RN Casey intentionally opened Mrs. Torrance's operative report and MAR without any care, consultation, payment, or operations role. That is a completed exposure of PHI by a workforce member and requires immediate containment and formal reporting. The photo is also serious, but the skeleton frames RN Casey's EHR access as the broader, logged access with ongoing system-risk implications.
correct.zh: Casey护士在没有照护、会诊、付款或运营职责的情况下，故意打开Torrance女士的手术记录和MAR。这是工作人员已完成的PHI暴露，需要立即控制并正式上报。照片同样严重，但本病例将Casey护士的电子病历访问设定为范围更广、可由审计追踪且有持续系统风险的优先事件。

stem.en: Which event is the clearest completed, non-incidental unauthorized access that requires formal breach-response investigation?
stem.zh: 哪一项是最明确、已经发生且非偶然的未经授权访问，需要启动正式隐私事件调查？

testTakingStrategy.en: When several privacy problems occur, prioritize the completed exposure with the broadest scope and ongoing system access risk.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 多个隐私问题同时发生时，优先处理已经发生、范围较广且有持续系统访问风险的暴露。

glossary.defZh: 用于机构质量改进和风险管理的内部报告，不属于患者临床病历。
发送到错误部门或位置的文件请求或资料，需要保护并转给正确流程处理。
手机照片可能自动上传到云端账号或其他设备的功能。

options.en: Secure the employer fax and redirect the request to HIM rather than releasing records from the nursing unit.
options.zh: 妥善保管雇主传真并将请求转给HIM，不从护理单元释放病历。

options.en: Have the student delete the identifiable photo, including recently deleted storage, in the presence of RN Jordan and the instructor; report for Privacy Officer follow-up.
options.zh: 让护生在Jordan护士和指导老师在场时删除可识别照片，包括最近删除文件夹；并上报由隐私官跟进。

options.en: Document in Mrs. Torrance's medical record that incident reports were filed for the privacy breaches.
options.zh: 在Torrance女士病历中记录已为隐私泄露提交事件报告。

options.en: Interrupt the hallway report and move the nurses to a private space to finish patient-specific communication.
options.zh: 打断走廊交班，让护士转到私密空间完成涉及患者的信息沟通。

options.en: Release no information to Robert; ask Mrs. Torrance whether she authorizes him and document her restriction if she declines.
options.zh: 不向Robert透露信息；询问Torrance女士是否授权他接收信息，如拒绝则记录她的限制。

options.en: Ask RN Casey to exit the chart, notify the charge nurse, complete the incident report, and keep the report out of the medical record.
options.zh: 要求Casey护士退出病历，通知 charge nurse，完成事件报告，并且不要把事件报告写入病历。

byChoice.en: Immediate deletion limits exposure, but reporting is still needed because cloud syncing or other retention must be investigated.
byChoice.zh: 立即删除可限制暴露，但仍需上报，因为是否云端同步或保留还需调查。

byChoice.en: The patient controls who receives information; she later states Robert should not receive information.
byChoice.zh: 患者有权决定谁可接收信息；她之后明确表示Robert不能接收信息。

byChoice.en: Records requests belong with HIM, which can verify authorization or legal authority and apply minimum-necessary limits.
byChoice.zh: 病历请求应由HIM处理，由其核实授权或法律依据并执行最低必要范围。

byChoice.en: This follows the facility sequence: mitigate active access, notify the charge nurse, then complete formal reporting outside the clinical chart.
byChoice.zh: 这符合机构流程：先控制正在发生的访问，通知 charge nurse，再在临床病历之外完成正式报告。

byChoice.en: Moving the report to a private area stops an ongoing verbal disclosure risk.
byChoice.zh: 将交班移至私密区域可以停止正在发生的口头披露风险。

byChoice.en: The medical record should contain clinical care documentation, not references to incident reports or risk-management documents.
byChoice.zh: 病历应记录临床照护内容，而不是事件报告或风险管理文件。

correct.en: The correct response combines immediate mitigation, proper reporting, and prevention of further disclosure for each event. The nurse should not reference the incident report in the patient's medical record because the incident report is a quality-improvement/risk-management document kept separate from clinical documentation.
correct.zh: 正确处理包括对每个事件立即控制暴露、按正确链条上报，并防止进一步披露。护士不能在患者病历中提及事件报告，因为事件报告属于质量改进/风险管理文件，应与临床病历分开保存。

stem.en: Which actions should RN Jordan include in the response to the morning privacy events? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: Jordan护士应将哪些措施纳入上午隐私事件的处理？选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: For privacy events, choose actions that contain the exposure and route the issue to the correct reporting channel. Reject actions that put risk-management documents in the chart.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 处理隐私事件时，选择能控制暴露并把问题送入正确上报渠道的措施。排除把风险管理文件写入病历的做法。

glossary.defZh: 立即采取措施减少已发生或正在发生的隐私风险。
机构规定的逐级通知路径，例如 charge nurse、unit manager、Privacy Officer。
负责调查隐私事件并决定是否需要进一步通知或纠正措施的机构人员。

options.en: Ask RN Casey to close the record or log out immediately, then notify the charge nurse and follow the breach-reporting chain.
options.zh: 立即要求Casey护士关闭病历或退出登录，然后通知 charge nurse 并按隐私事件上报链处理。

options.en: Tell RN Casey that discipline will be imposed and require her to write an apology to the patient.
options.zh: 告诉Casey护士将受到纪律处分，并要求她给患者写道歉信。

options.en: Complete the electronic incident report first, then tell the charge nurse after the report is submitted.
options.zh: 先完成电子事件报告，提交后再告知 charge nurse。

options.en: Wait until the end of the shift so all privacy events can be reported together.
options.zh: 等到本班结束后，将所有隐私事件一起上报。

byChoice.en: This stops the active exposure and starts the required reporting chain.
byChoice.zh: 此举可停止正在发生的暴露，并启动必要的上报链。

byChoice.en: Discipline is a management function; the nurse's immediate role is containment and reporting.
byChoice.zh: 纪律处分属于管理职责；护士的即时角色是控制和上报。

byChoice.en: Filing is required, but the policy sequence starts with mitigation and charge nurse notification.
byChoice.zh: 提交报告是必要的，但流程顺序是先控制暴露并通知 charge nurse。

byChoice.en: Delaying allows unauthorized access risk to continue and violates the immediate-mitigation expectation.
byChoice.zh: 延迟会让未经授权访问风险持续，也违反立即控制暴露的要求。

correct.en: The first step is immediate mitigation: stop the active unauthorized access by having RN Casey leave the record. The nurse then notifies the charge nurse and follows the facility's reporting chain. Discipline and patient notification are handled through management and the Privacy Officer's process, not by the discovering nurse acting independently.
correct.zh: 第一步是立即减轻/控制暴露：让Casey护士离开病历，停止正在发生的未经授权访问。随后通知 charge nurse，并按机构上报链处理。纪律处分和正式通知患者应由管理层和隐私官流程处理，而不是发现事件的护士自行处理。

stem.en: RN Jordan sees RN Casey actively viewing Mrs. Torrance's record without a care role. What is the nurse's first action?
stem.zh: Jordan护士看到Casey护士正在无照护职责地查看Torrance女士病历。护士的第一步行动是什么？

testTakingStrategy.en: The first action for an active breach is containment, not paperwork or discipline. Stop the exposure before moving through the reporting chain.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 正在发生的隐私事件，第一步是控制暴露，不是先做文书或处分。先停止暴露，再进入上报流程。

glossary.defZh: 由机构评估未经允许的访问或披露是否达到需要正式通知的程度。
电子系统记录访问时间、访问者和查看内容的日志。
阻止进一步访问、传播或披露的措施。

options.en: Mrs. Torrance's postoperative vital signs remain stable and the wound dressing is clean and dry.
options.zh: Torrance女士术后生命体征稳定，伤口敷料清洁干燥。

options.en: The Privacy Officer has started the breach-determination process and preserved the EHR audit trail.
options.zh: 隐私官已启动隐私事件判定流程，并保留电子病历审计追踪。

options.en: Robert has not called back by the end of the shift, so the breach response is complete.
options.zh: Robert在本班结束前没有再来电，因此隐私事件处理已完成。

options.en: No PHI was released to Robert or to the employer from the nursing unit.
options.zh: 护理单元未向Robert或雇主释放PHI。

options.en: The student's photo was deleted and reported for investigation of possible cloud syncing, and the nursing program was notified.
options.zh: 护生照片已删除，并已上报调查可能的云端同步；护理项目也已获通知。

options.en: Incident reports are complete and are not referenced in Mrs. Torrance's medical record.
options.zh: 事件报告已完成，且未在Torrance女士病历中提及。

byChoice.en: Deletion plus reporting addresses both immediate containment and the unresolved risk of transmission or cloud storage.
byChoice.zh: 删除并上报同时处理了即时控制和可能传输/云端储存的未决风险。

byChoice.en: The patient's restriction remains in force regardless of whether Robert calls again; the response is not complete solely because he stopped calling.
byChoice.zh: 无论Robert是否再次来电，患者的限制都仍然有效；不能仅因他未再来电就认为处理完成。

byChoice.en: Clinical stability does not show that a privacy breach was contained, reported, or investigated.
byChoice.zh: 临床稳定不能证明隐私事件已被控制、上报或调查。

byChoice.en: Preventing release to unauthorized external parties confirms containment of the phone and fax risks.
byChoice.zh: 防止向未授权外部人员释放资料，说明电话和传真风险已被控制。

byChoice.en: Audit-trail preservation and Privacy Officer review are essential for determining whether patient notification is required.
byChoice.zh: 保留审计追踪并由隐私官审查，是判断是否需要通知患者的关键。

byChoice.en: This confirms formal reporting occurred while protecting the separation between incident reporting and clinical documentation.
byChoice.zh: 这确认已完成正式上报，同时保持事件报告与临床病历分离。

correct.en: Appropriate outcomes focus on containment, reporting, Privacy Officer investigation, audit-trail preservation, and prevention of unauthorized release. Stable postoperative findings are clinically good but do not evaluate the privacy response. Whether Robert calls again does not determine whether the required breach-response steps were completed.
correct.zh: 适当结局应关注暴露是否被控制、是否完成上报、隐私官是否调查、审计追踪是否保存，以及是否防止未经授权披露。术后稳定是好的临床情况，但不能评价隐私事件处理。Robert是否再次来电，也不能决定必需的隐私事件处理步骤是否完成。

stem.en: Which findings best show that the privacy events have been contained and appropriately reported? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 哪些发现最能说明这些隐私事件已被控制并得到适当上报？选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate privacy outcomes with privacy-process evidence, not physiologic stability. Look for containment, reporting, investigation, and prevention.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价隐私事件结局要看隐私流程证据，而不是生理稳定。寻找控制、上报、调查和预防措施。

content.en: 0745: A caller says he is Robert Torrance, the client's husband, and asks for lab results and discharge timing. Robert is not listed as an authorized contact. 0830: RN Casey, assigned to another pod and with no care role, is seen scrolling through Mrs. Torrance's operative report and MAR because of personal interest in orthopedic notes. 0945: The employer faxes the unit requesting admission records, operative report, and anticipated return-to-work date for workers' compensation processing; no signed patient authorization is attached. 1015: A nursing student uses a personal smartphone to photograph the wound for a class presentation; the hospital ID wristband is visible, and there is no written consent. 1025: Two nurses give report in the hallway and discuss another patient's HIV status and medication regimen by name while a visitor can hear. Mrs. Torrance remains clinically stable at 1030.
content.zh: 0745：一名来电者自称是患者丈夫Robert Torrance，要求得知化验结果和出院时间；Robert未列为授权联系人。0830：Casey护士被分配在另一护理区且无照护职责，却因个人对骨科记录感兴趣而浏览Torrance女士的手术记录和MAR。0945：雇主将传真发到护理单元，要求入院记录、手术报告和预计返工日期以处理工伤赔偿；未附患者签署的授权书。1015：一名护生用个人智能手机拍摄伤口，准备课堂汇报；医院身份腕带可见，且无书面同意。1025：两名护士在走廊交班，按姓名讨论另一名患者的HIV状态和用药，旁边访客能够听到。1030时Torrance女士临床状况仍稳定。

title.zh: 上午隐私线索
阶段1：0730-1030，披露事件陆续发生

content.en: RN Jordan mitigates each exposure in real time while formal follow-up continues. Mrs. Torrance states she and Robert are legally separated and she does not want him to receive any information; only Megan remains authorized. RN Casey is dismissive and says she did not share the information. The charge nurse confirms the access is unauthorized and directs incident reporting and Privacy Officer notification. RN Jordan does not release employer records, secures the fax, and contacts HIM, which states that release requires a signed authorization or valid legal basis and must be processed through HIM. The student confirms the photo was not shared; RN Jordan has the student delete it immediately, including recently deleted storage, with the instructor present, and reports the event for Privacy Officer review of possible cloud syncing. RN Jordan moves the hallway report to a private area. By 1200, incident reporting is complete and is not documented in the medical record.
content.zh: Jordan护士对每次暴露实时采取控制措施，同时正式跟进持续进行。Torrance女士表示她与Robert已合法分居，不希望他获得任何信息；仍只授权Megan。Casey护士不以为然，称自己没有分享信息。charge nurse确认该访问未经授权，并要求完成事件报告和通知隐私官。Jordan护士未向雇主释放资料，妥善保管传真并联系HIM；HIM说明释放资料需要患者签署授权或有效法律依据，且必须由HIM处理。护生确认照片未分享；Jordan护士在指导老师在场时让护生立即删除照片，包括最近删除存储，并上报由隐私官评估可能的云端同步。Jordan护士将走廊交班移至私密区域。到1200，事件报告已完成，且未记录在病历中。

title.zh: 控制与上报措施
阶段2：1030-1400，控制暴露与上报

content.en: At 1430, the Privacy Officer states RN Casey's access will be investigated through the formal breach-determination process using the EHR audit trail. The student's photo is also reviewed as a potential breach. At 1500, HIM confirms no employer records will be released without a signed authorization or valid legal basis. At 1530, Mrs. Torrance asks about a concern with her chart; RN Jordan acknowledges the facility is aware of a concern and the Privacy Officer is handling it, without naming staff or disclosing investigation details. At 1700, safeguards under review include fax-machine signage to redirect records requests to HIM, instructor reinforcement of the no-identifiable-photo policy, an in-service on minimum-necessary access and audit trails, and staff review of private spaces for report. By 1900, the client remains clinically stable.
content.zh: 1430，隐私官表示将使用电子病历审计追踪，通过正式隐私事件判定流程调查Casey护士的访问。护生照片也作为潜在隐私事件审查。1500，HIM确认没有患者签署授权或有效法律依据，不会向雇主释放资料。1530，Torrance女士询问自己的病历是否出了问题；Jordan护士承认机构已知晓相关关注点并由隐私官处理，但不透露工作人员姓名或调查细节。1700，正在审查的防护措施包括在传真机旁张贴标识，提醒将病历请求转至HIM；指导老师强化禁止可识别患者照片的政策；开展最低必要访问和审计追踪的短讲；并复习在私密空间交班。到1900，患者临床状况仍稳定。

title.zh: 隐私官审查与防护措施
阶段3：1400-1900，后续跟进与系统防护

summary.en: Mrs. Elaine Torrance, a 58-year-old postoperative orthopedic client, is stable after open reduction and internal fixation of a left tibial plateau fracture. During the day shift, RN Jordan must recognize, contain, report, and evaluate several privacy risks and unauthorized PHI exposures.
summary.zh: Elaine Torrance女士，58岁，因左胫骨平台骨折行切开复位内固定术后，目前病情稳定。白班期间，Jordan护士必须识别、控制、上报并评价多起隐私风险和未经授权的PHI暴露。

title.en: Multiple HIPAA disclosure events during one shift
title.zh: 同一班次内发生多起HIPAA披露事件

glossary.defZh: 可识别患者身份的健康资料，例如姓名、出生日期、病历号、诊断、治疗记录或检查结果。
使用或披露健康信息时，只限于达到合法目的所需的最少资料。
发现可能的隐私泄露后，立即控制暴露、按机构流程上报、由隐私官调查并评估是否需要通知患者。
负责病历资料调阅、授权核查和合法披露流程的部门。

correct.en: This case tests real-time recognition and response to multiple privacy problems. The nurse must identify unauthorized access, unverified external requests, identifiable images on personal devices, and verbal disclosures without reasonable safeguards. The priority completed exposure is RN Casey's curiosity-based EHR access, which requires immediate containment and formal breach-response reporting. Appropriate management includes refusing unauthorized disclosure, redirecting records requests to HIM, deleting and reporting the student photo, moving report to a private area, notifying the charge nurse and Privacy Officer, preserving audit evidence, and keeping incident reports out of the medical record.
correct.zh: 本病例考查护士对多起隐私问题的实时识别和处理。护士必须识别未经授权访问、未核实的外部请求、个人设备上的可识别照片，以及未采取合理保护措施的口头披露。最优先且已发生的暴露是Casey护士因好奇访问电子病历，需要立即控制并正式上报。适当处理包括拒绝未授权披露、将病历请求转给HIM、删除并上报护生照片、将交班移到私密区域、通知 charge nurse 和隐私官、保留审计证据，并且不要把事件报告写入病历。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

testTakingStrategy.en: In HIPAA items, do not assume disclosure is harmless because the person seems involved. Verify authorization, limit access to job-related need, contain active exposure first, and use the facility reporting chain.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做HIPAA题时，不要因为对方看似相关就认为披露无害。要核实授权，将访问限制在工作需要内，先控制正在发生的暴露，并使用机构上报链。

content.en: Diagnosis: stage IIIB diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. Treatment: cycle 2 day 10 R-CHOP. Oncology note: expected count nadir window. Admission reason: poor oral intake and dehydration. Allergies: none known. Line: triple-lumen PICC, flushed and patent. Baseline admission vitals: T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C), HR 78, BP 118/72, RR 14, SpO₂ 98% room air. Standing order: for any single oral temperature ≥ 101 °F (38.3 °C) or oral temperature ≥ 100.4 °F (38.0 °C) sustained over one hour, obtain blood cultures (two peripheral sets and one PICC lumen per local order) and notify oncology immediately.
content.zh: 诊断：IIIB 期弥漫大 B 细胞淋巴瘤。治疗：R-CHOP 第 2 周期第 10 天。肿瘤科记录：处于预期血细胞计数低谷期。入院原因：进食差和脱水。过敏史：无已知药物过敏。管路：三腔 PICC，已冲管且通畅。入院基线生命体征：T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，HR 78，BP 118/72，RR 14，室内空气 SpO₂ 98%。常规医嘱：任何单次口温 ≥ 101 °F (38.3 °C)或口温 ≥ 100.4 °F (38.0 °C)持续 1 小时，采集血培养（按本机构医嘱采两组外周血和一个 PICC 管腔样本）并立即通知肿瘤科。

title.zh: 基线病史和常规医嘱

content.en: 1415: client reports sudden cold, shaky feeling; visible rigors. Vitals: T 102 °F (38.9 °C) oral, HR 104, BP 108/68, RR 20, SpO₂ 96% room air. Skin warm/flushed over trunk; fingertips cool and slightly mottled; capillary refill 3 seconds. Mucous membranes dry with a small intact oral mucositis area on left buccal mucosa. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, non-tender, normoactive bowel sounds. PICC site without erythema, drainage, or tenderness; dressing clean/dry/intact. Alert and oriented; feels awful. Urine output prior 4 hours: 180 mL. No perianal complaints; no rectal assessment performed. 1420 CBC: WBC 0.6 ×10³/µL, ANC 180/µL, Hgb 9.8 g/dL, platelets 112 ×10³/µL. BMP: Na 137, K 3.9, Cl 101, CO₂ 24, BUN 18, creatinine 0.9, glucose 118. Lactate 1.4 mmol/L. UA clear, no WBCs or nitrites.
content.zh: 1415：患者报告突然觉得冷、发抖；可见寒战。生命体征：口温 102 °F (38.9 °C)，HR 104，BP 108/68，RR 20，室内空气 SpO₂ 96%。躯干皮肤温暖潮红；指尖发凉、轻度花斑；毛细血管再充盈 3 秒。黏膜干燥，左侧颊黏膜有一小处完整口腔黏膜炎。双肺清晰。腹部柔软、无压痛，肠鸣音正常。PICC 部位无红斑、渗液或压痛；敷料清洁、干燥、完整。神志清楚，定向力完整，自述感觉很糟。前 4 小时尿量 180 mL。无肛周不适，未进行直肠评估。1420 CBC：WBC 0.6 ×10³/µL，ANC 180/µL，Hgb 9.8 g/dL，血小板 112 ×10³/µL。BMP：Na 137，K 3.9，Cl 101，CO₂ 24，BUN 18，肌酐 0.9，血糖 118。乳酸 1.4 mmol/L。尿检清亮，无 WBC、无亚硝酸盐。

title.zh: 初始评估和 1420 实验室结果

glossary.defZh: 中性粒细胞数量过低，导致患者难以抵抗细菌和真菌感染。
用于判断感染防御能力的中性粒细胞绝对数量。
强烈发抖，常提示菌血症或全身炎症反应。
化疗后血细胞计数预计降到最低的时间段。

segments.en: At 1415 the client has visible rigors and says she feels suddenly cold and shaky.
segments.zh: 1415，患者出现明显寒战，并说自己突然觉得很冷、发抖。

segments.en: Oral temperature is 102.0 °F (38.9 °C).
HR is 104/min.
segments.zh: 心率为 104 次/分。

segments.en: BP is 108/68 mm Hg.
segments.zh: 血压为 108/68 mm Hg。

segments.en: Fingertips are cool and slightly mottled with capillary refill of 3 seconds.
segments.zh: 指尖发凉、轻度花斑，毛细血管再充盈时间为 3 秒。

segments.en: Lung sounds are clear bilaterally.
segments.zh: 双肺呼吸音清晰。

segments.en: The PICC insertion site is clean, dry, intact, and non-tender.
segments.zh: PICC 置管部位清洁、干燥、完整，且无压痛。

segments.en: The left buccal mucosa has a small intact area of oral mucositis.
segments.zh: 左侧颊黏膜有一小处完整的口腔黏膜炎。

segments.en: WBC is 0.6 ×10³/µL with ANC 180/µL during the expected chemotherapy nadir.
segments.zh: 预期化疗低谷期内，WBC 为 0.6 ×10³/µL，ANC 为 180/µL。

segments.en: Lactate is 1.4 mmol/L.
segments.zh: 乳酸为 1.4 mmol/L。

byChoice.en: Rigors are a systemic inflammatory cue and are not a routine chemotherapy complaint in this context.
byChoice.zh: 寒战是全身炎症反应线索，在此情境下不能当作普通化疗不适处理。

byChoice.en: A single oral temperature of 102 °F (38.9 °C) exceeds the standing fever threshold and requires immediate action.
byChoice.zh: 单次口温 102 °F (38.9 °C) 已超过医嘱发热阈值，需要立即处理。

byChoice.en: Tachycardia reinforces the systemic response and increases concern for early sepsis progression.
byChoice.zh: 心动过速加强了全身反应的判断，并增加早期脓毒症进展的担忧。

byChoice.en: This blood pressure is lower than baseline but is not the key emergency cue at the first assessment; it becomes more concerning when it later drops to 92/58.
byChoice.zh: 该血压低于基线，但在首次评估时并非最关键的急症线索；之后降至 92/58 时才更提示恶化。

byChoice.en: Cool mottled fingertips and delayed refill suggest early peripheral vasoconstriction and impaired perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 指尖发凉、花斑和再充盈延迟提示早期外周血管收缩及灌注受损。

byChoice.en: Clear lung sounds are reassuring but do not reduce urgency because neutropenic clients may lack localizing inflammatory signs.
byChoice.zh: 双肺清晰是相对安心的发现，但中性粒细胞减少患者可能缺乏局部炎症体征，因此不能降低紧急程度。

byChoice.en: A clean, non-tender PICC site does not rule out bloodstream infection because erythema or drainage may be absent in severe neutropenia.
byChoice.zh: PICC 部位清洁且无压痛不能排除血流感染，因为严重中性粒细胞减少时可没有红肿或渗液。

byChoice.en: Oral mucositis is a possible portal of entry and should be monitored, but this small intact lesion is not itself the acute change that defines the emergency.
byChoice.zh: 口腔黏膜炎可能是感染入口，需要观察；但这个小且完整的病灶本身不是定义急症的急性变化。

byChoice.en: ANC 180/µL confirms severe neutropenia during the expected nadir, so fever can progress rapidly to sepsis.
byChoice.zh: ANC 180/µL 证实预期低谷期内严重中性粒细胞减少，因此发热可迅速进展为脓毒症。

byChoice.en: A lactate of 1.4 mmol/L is not elevated at this moment; later lactate rise is what signals worsening perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 此时乳酸 1.4 mmol/L 未升高；之后乳酸上升才提示灌注恶化。

correct.en: The fever exceeds the standing single-reading threshold, and rigors, tachycardia, severe neutropenia during the nadir, and early peripheral vasoconstriction make this a time-critical emergency. Clear lungs, a normal-appearing PICC site, and normal lactate do not rule out serious infection in a neutropenic client.
correct.zh: 体温超过医嘱中单次读数的发热阈值；寒战、心动过速、低谷期严重中性粒细胞减少以及早期外周血管收缩共同提示这是时间紧迫的急症。双肺清晰、PICC 部位外观正常和乳酸正常，并不能排除中性粒细胞减少患者的严重感染。

stem.en: Highlight the Stage 1 findings that are significant cues of a time-critical neutropenic fever emergency.
stem.zh: 请标出第 1 阶段提示中性粒细胞减少性发热为时间紧迫急症的重要线索。

testTakingStrategy.en: In oncology nadir questions, treat fever plus severe neutropenia as the danger signal even when the source exam looks normal.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到肿瘤治疗低谷期题目时，即使感染来源检查看似正常，也要把发热加严重中性粒细胞减少视为危险信号。

clozeStem.en: The nurse should obtain ordered blood cultures {{d1}}, then start empiric IV antibiotics {{d2}}, because {{d3}}.
clozeStem.zh: 护士应 {{d1}} 取得医嘱要求的血培养，然后 {{d2}} 开始经验性 IV 抗生素，因为 {{d3}}。

options.en: after the antibiotic infusion is complete
options.zh: 在抗生素输注完成后

options.en: only if a local source of infection is found
options.zh: 只有找到局部感染来源时

options.en: before the first antibiotic dose
options.zh: 在首次抗生素给药前

options.en: within the ordered one-hour window
options.zh: 在医嘱规定的 1 小时窗口内

options.en: after culture results identify the organism
options.zh: 等培养结果确定病原体后

options.en: after the fever has persisted for another hour
options.zh: 等发热再持续 1 小时后

options.en: neutropenic clients usually produce obvious localizing infection signs
options.zh: 中性粒细胞减少患者通常会出现明显局部感染体征

options.en: antibiotics are unsafe until all imaging is completed
options.zh: 所有影像检查完成前使用抗生素不安全

options.en: cultures preserve diagnostic yield while rapid empiric therapy limits progression
options.zh: 培养可保留诊断价值，同时快速经验性治疗可限制病情进展

glossary.defZh: 在病原体尚未确定前，根据最可能病原和病情严重程度立即给予的抗生素。
用于检测血液中细菌或真菌并指导后续抗感染治疗的检查。
检查结果显示阴性，但实际上存在疾病或病原体。

byChoice.en: Blood cultures are drawn before antibiotic exposure so the culture result is interpretable; drawing them afterward risks false-negative results.
byChoice.zh: 血培养应在接触抗生素前采集，结果才更可解释；之后采集会增加假阴性风险。

byChoice.en: The order specifies prompt first-dose administration; waiting for speciation or another fever check would misuse the time-critical pathway.
byChoice.zh: 医嘱要求及时给首次剂量；等待菌种鉴定或再次测温会错误使用这一时间紧迫流程。

byChoice.en: The two requirements are complementary: cultures support targeted therapy later, and empiric antibiotics protect the client now.
byChoice.zh: 这两个要求相辅相成：培养为后续靶向治疗提供依据，经验性抗生素则立即保护患者。

correct.en: Cultures before antibiotics preserve the chance of identifying the organism, but this should take minutes, not delay treatment. The provider order pairs rapid cultures with prompt empiric antibiotics because the severely neutropenic client has little innate immune defense.
correct.zh: 抗生素前采集培养可保留识别病原体的机会，但这应在几分钟内完成，不能延误治疗。医嘱将快速采集培养与及时经验性抗生素配对，是因为严重中性粒细胞减少患者几乎没有足够的先天免疫防御。

stem.en: Complete the reasoning chain for the Stage 1 cultures-and-antibiotics requirement.
stem.zh: 请完成第 1 阶段关于培养和抗生素要求的临床推理链。

testTakingStrategy.en: When two urgent actions seem to compete, ask whether one is a brief prerequisite that protects later care without delaying the lifesaving intervention.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当两个紧急措施看似冲突时，判断其中一个是否是短时间即可完成、能保护后续治疗价值且不延误救命措施的前置步骤。

glossary.defZh: 组织灌注不足或氧利用异常时可升高的指标。
尿量减少，常提示肾灌注不足或容量/循环问题。
在患者急性恶化时提供紧急评估和升级处理的团队。
用于扩充血管内容量、改善灌注的静脉液体。

options.en: Apply supplemental oxygen by nasal cannula to support tissue oxygenation during the perfusion crisis.
options.zh: 经鼻导管给予氧气，以在灌注危机中支持组织氧合。

options.en: Reposition the client supine and start the ordered isotonic crystalloid bolus while reassessing perfusion and lung status.
options.zh: 协助患者平卧，并开始医嘱的等渗晶体液快速补液，同时复评灌注和肺部情况。

options.en: Redraw blood cultures from new sites before the antibiotic regimen is broadened.
options.zh: 在扩大抗生素方案前，从新部位重新采集血培养。

options.en: Activate the rapid response team and notify the oncologist with the BP drop, HR rise, urine-output decline, and lactate rise.
options.zh: 启动快速反应团队，并向肿瘤科医生报告血压下降、心率升高、尿量减少和乳酸升高。

byChoice.en: This is first because hypotension, rising lactate, delayed capillary refill, and falling urine output indicate inadequate perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 此项排第一，因为低血压、乳酸升高、再充盈延迟和尿量下降说明灌注不足。

byChoice.en: Team activation and oncology notification must follow immediately so broader antibiotics, possible vasopressors, and higher-level care are not delayed.
byChoice.zh: 随后必须立即启动团队并通知肿瘤科，以免延误扩大抗生素、可能的升压药和更高级别护理。

byChoice.en: Oxygen is appropriate because oxygen delivery is threatened, but it does not replace fluid resuscitation and escalation for the perfusion problem.
byChoice.zh: 给予氧气是合适的，因为氧输送受到威胁；但它不能替代针对灌注问题的补液复苏和升级处理。

byChoice.en: Repeat cultures are important before broadened antibiotics, but they should not delay the first perfusion-restoring actions during hemodynamic deterioration.
byChoice.zh: 扩大抗生素前重复培养很重要，但在血流动力学恶化时不能延误最先恢复灌注的措施。

correct.en: The Stage 2 findings show progression toward sepsis with hypotension, rising lactate, oliguria, tachycardia, and slower responses. Restoring perfusion and escalating the team come first; oxygen supports the oxygen-delivery problem, and repeat cultures should precede the antibiotic change without delaying resuscitation.
correct.zh: 第 2 阶段表现为向脓毒症进展：低血压、乳酸升高、少尿、心动过速和反应变慢。首先要恢复灌注并升级团队；氧气支持氧输送问题；重复培养应在调整抗生素前完成，但不能延误复苏。

stem.en: At Stage 2, place the nurse's immediate priority actions in the order they should be ensured. Some bedside tasks may overlap, but the sequence should reflect the dominant priorities.
stem.zh: 在第 2 阶段，请按护士应确保完成的优先顺序排列立即措施。部分床旁操作可重叠进行，但排序应反映主要优先级。

testTakingStrategy.en: For deterioration with shock cues, prioritize perfusion restoration and team escalation before diagnostic tasks that can safely follow within minutes.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到休克线索的病情恶化时，先恢复灌注并升级团队，再做可在几分钟内随后完成的诊断任务。

glossary.defZh: 为减少感染暴露而采取的手卫生、访客、饮食和环境控制措施。
化疗等因素导致的口腔或胃肠道黏膜炎症和脆弱。
防止病原体污染无菌部位、设备或管路的操作方法。

options.en: Allow fresh flowers if the water is changed daily and the vase is kept away from the bed.
options.zh: 如果每天换水且花瓶远离床边，可以允许鲜花。

options.en: Follow the facility low-microbial/food-safety protocol for food brought to the client.
options.zh: 对患者食物遵循机构低微生物/食品安全方案。

options.en: Require hand hygiene before entry and restrict visitors who are ill.
options.zh: 进入病房前必须手卫生，并限制患病访客。

options.en: Minimize unnecessary invasive procedures and use meticulous aseptic technique for every PICC access.
options.zh: 尽量减少不必要的侵入性操作，每次使用 PICC 时严格无菌操作。

options.en: Use gentle oral care with a soft toothbrush and non-alcohol rinse for the mucositis site.
options.zh: 对口腔黏膜炎部位使用软毛牙刷和无酒精漱口液进行温和口腔护理。

options.en: Avoid rectal temperatures, rectal medications, enemas, and rectal assessment unless specifically ordered for an overriding reason.
options.zh: 避免直肠测温、直肠给药、灌肠和直肠评估，除非因更重要原因有明确医嘱。

byChoice.en: Food-safety precautions reduce exposure to organisms from unwashed, undercooked, unpasteurized, or unverifiable foods.
byChoice.zh: 食品安全措施可减少来自未清洗、未煮熟、未巴氏消毒或无法确认安全食物的病原体暴露。

byChoice.en: Hand hygiene and restricting ill visitors reduce exposure to organisms during the nadir.
byChoice.zh: 手卫生和限制患病访客可减少低谷期病原体暴露。

byChoice.en: Each avoidable skin or line breach can become a source of bloodstream infection in severe neutropenia.
byChoice.zh: 在严重中性粒细胞减少时，每一次可避免的皮肤或管路破口都可能成为血流感染来源。

byChoice.en: Gentle oral care prevents additional mucosal trauma while still reducing oral microbial burden.
byChoice.zh: 温和口腔护理既可减少口腔微生物负荷，又可避免进一步黏膜损伤。

byChoice.en: Fresh flowers and standing water are avoided because they can harbor organisms; moving them away from the bed does not remove the risk.
byChoice.zh: 应避免鲜花和积水，因为可能携带病原体；把它们远离床边并不能消除风险。

byChoice.en: Rectal instrumentation can injure colonized mucosa and introduce organisms the client cannot defend against.
byChoice.zh: 直肠操作可能损伤定植菌丰富的黏膜，并引入患者无法抵御的病原体。

correct.en: Severe neutropenia requires reducing microbial exposure and avoiding preventable mucosal or skin breaks. Rectal instrumentation is avoided, visitors and food are controlled by protocol, oral care should protect fragile mucosa, and all line access must be aseptic and necessary.
correct.zh: 严重中性粒细胞减少需要减少微生物暴露，并避免可预防的黏膜或皮肤破损。应避免直肠操作，按方案管理访客和食物，口腔护理要保护脆弱黏膜，所有管路操作都必须严格无菌且有必要。

stem.en: Which nursing interventions are appropriate modifications for this severely neutropenic client? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 对于这名严重中性粒细胞减少患者，哪些护理措施属于适当调整？请选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: For neutropenia precautions, think: reduce exposure, protect mucosa, and avoid unnecessary breaks in skin or lines.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 判断中性粒细胞减少防护时，抓住三点：减少暴露、保护黏膜、避免不必要的皮肤或管路破口。

glossary.defZh: 患者随时间表现出的改善、稳定或恶化方向。
血管内导管可能成为来源的血流感染。
血液向组织输送氧气和营养的过程。

rows.en: Temperature trend: 39.4 → 38.6 → 100.6 °F (38.1 °C)
Heart rate trend: 118 → 106 → 96/min
Blood pressure trend: 92/58 → 100/64 → 106/68 mm Hg
Urine output improves from 15 mL/hr to 45-55 mL/hr
rows.zh: 尿量从 15 mL/hr 改善至 45-55 mL/hr

rows.en: Lactate decreases from 3.2 to 2.0 mmol/L
rows.zh: 乳酸从 3.2 降至 2.0 mmol/L

rows.en: Mental status improves from slower responses to alert and conversational
rows.zh: 精神状态从反应变慢改善为清醒并能交谈

rows.en: Preliminary Gram-positive organism is reported in the PICC lumen bottle
rows.zh: PICC 管腔培养瓶初步报告革兰阳性菌

byChoice.en: The temperature is still abnormal, but the downward trend after treatment supports improvement rather than ongoing worsening.
byChoice.zh: 体温仍异常，但治疗后下降趋势支持改善而非继续恶化。

byChoice.en: A falling heart rate shows reduced physiologic stress and supports response to treatment.
byChoice.zh: 心率下降说明生理应激减轻，支持治疗有反应。

byChoice.en: Recovering blood pressure suggests perfusion is improving after fluid resuscitation and therapy escalation.
byChoice.zh: 血压恢复提示补液复苏和治疗升级后灌注改善。

byChoice.en: Urine output is a direct perfusion marker; improvement from oliguria supports better renal perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 尿量是直接灌注指标；从少尿改善支持肾灌注变好。

byChoice.en: The lactate is not fully normal, but the downward trend suggests tissue perfusion is improving.
byChoice.zh: 乳酸尚未完全正常，但下降趋势提示组织灌注在改善。

byChoice.en: Improved alertness supports better cerebral perfusion and overall stabilization.
byChoice.zh: 意识改善支持脑灌注和总体稳定性变好。

byChoice.en: This result must be communicated because it may indicate catheter-related bloodstream infection and may change the plan once speciation returns.
byChoice.zh: 该结果必须沟通，因为可能提示导管相关血流感染，待菌种鉴定后可能改变治疗计划。

correct.en: The overall trajectory is improving because perfusion and systemic response markers are reversing: lower temperature and heart rate, recovering blood pressure, better urine output, falling lactate, and improved alertness. The positive PICC-lumen culture is important and must be reported, but it does not erase the improving hemodynamic trend.
correct.zh: 总体轨迹在改善，因为灌注和全身反应指标正在逆转：体温和心率下降、血压恢复、尿量改善、乳酸下降、意识更清醒。PICC 管腔培养阳性很重要，必须报告，但不会否定血流动力学改善趋势。

stem.en: At Stage 3, classify how each finding should be used to evaluate the client's trajectory.
stem.zh: 在第 3 阶段，请判断每项发现应如何用于评估患者病情轨迹。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate outcomes by trending the same cues that signaled danger; one new lab result can require follow-up without overturning the whole trend.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评估效果时，要追踪最初提示危险的同一组线索；一个新的化验结果可能需要跟进，但不一定推翻整体趋势。

glossary.defZh: 用于降低发热的药物，如对乙酰氨基酚或布洛芬。
因可能危及生命而需要立即到急诊或指定急救地点接受评估。
患者可能觉得不严重的轻度发热，但在中性粒细胞减少时仍可很危险。

options.en: Take acetaminophen or ibuprofen first, then call the clinic the next morning if the fever returns.
options.zh: 先服用对乙酰氨基酚或布洛芬；如果发热复发，第二天早上再打电话给门诊。

options.en: Go for immediate evaluation for rigors, shaking chills, sudden lightheadedness, confusion, or rapid heartbeat even if a fever has not yet been confirmed.
options.zh: 即使尚未确认发热，若出现寒战、发抖、突然头晕、意识混乱或心跳很快，也应立即就医评估。

options.en: Use an oral thermometer for temperature checks and do not take rectal temperatures.
options.zh: 使用口温计测量体温，不要测直肠温。

options.en: If there are no localizing symptoms, wait unless the fever is above 102.2 °F (39 °C).
options.zh: 如果没有局部症状，除非体温超过 102.2 °F (39 °C)，否则可以等待。

options.en: Seek emergency care immediately for any single oral temperature of 101 °F (38.3 °C) or higher.
options.zh: 任何单次口温达到或超过 101 °F (38.3 °C)时，应立即急诊就医。

options.en: Seek emergency care for oral temperature of 100.4 °F (38.0 °C) or higher that persists for one hour, per oncology instructions.
options.zh: 按肿瘤科指导，口温达到或超过 100.4 °F (38.0 °C)并持续 1 小时时，应急诊就医。

byChoice.en: The sustained-temperature threshold also triggers emergency care when it persists for one hour.
byChoice.zh: 体温达到持续阈值并持续 1 小时时，也应急诊就医。

byChoice.en: Waiting for a higher fever or localizing symptoms is unsafe because neutropenic clients may lack local inflammatory signs.
byChoice.zh: 等待更高发热或局部症状不安全，因为中性粒细胞减少患者可能没有局部炎症体征。

byChoice.en: This is the single-reading fever threshold in the oncology instructions and should trigger emergency evaluation.
byChoice.zh: 这是肿瘤科指导中的单次读数发热阈值，应触发急诊评估。

byChoice.en: Rigors or sudden systemic symptoms can signal bacteremia or sepsis even before the client captures a temperature reading.
byChoice.zh: 寒战或突然全身症状可在患者测到体温前提示菌血症或脓毒症。

byChoice.en: Antipyretics can mask the fever and delay recognition and antibiotics; the client should seek guidance/evaluation before suppressing the fever.
byChoice.zh: 退热药会掩盖发热并延误识别和抗生素治疗；患者应在压低体温前寻求指导/评估。

byChoice.en: Oral measurement matches the plan; rectal temperatures can injure mucosa and introduce organisms during neutropenia.
byChoice.zh: 口温测量符合计划；直肠测温在中性粒细胞减少时可能损伤黏膜并引入病原体。

correct.en: Teaching must be specific and action-oriented because fever during the nadir can be the only early sign of life-threatening infection. The client should use oral temperature thresholds from the oncology plan, avoid rectal measurements, avoid masking fever with antipyretics before evaluation, and seek care for systemic illness cues even before a temperature is confirmed.
correct.zh: 教育必须具体、以行动为导向，因为低谷期发热可能是危及生命感染的唯一早期征象。患者应使用肿瘤科计划中的口温阈值，避免直肠测温，评估前不要用退热药掩盖发热，并且即使尚未确认体温，出现全身不适线索也应就医。

stem.en: Which discharge-readiness teaching should the nurse give about seeking emergency care during future chemotherapy nadir periods? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 关于未来化疗低谷期何时需要急诊就医，护士应提供哪些出院准备教育？请选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: For discharge teaching, convert the emergency into exact numbers and exact actions the client can follow at home.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做出院教育题时，要把急症转换成患者在家能执行的具体数字和具体行动。

content.en: The nurse identifies fever and rigors, obtains vital signs and labs, and draws blood cultures from two peripheral sites and one PICC lumen at 1425 per standing order. Oncology is notified at 1430. The oncologist confirms neutropenic fever and orders empiric broad-spectrum IV antibiotics to start as soon as possible, with the first dose within one hour of documented fever. Orders also include chest X-ray, repeat lactate in four hours, and normal saline at 125 mL/hr. Antibiotic infusion begins via the PICC at 1445, 15 minutes after cultures. Neutropenic precautions sign: no fresh flowers/plants; follow facility low-microbial/food-safety protocol; hand hygiene before entry; no ill visitors. No rectal temperatures, rectal medications, or unnecessary invasive procedures. Chest X-ray at 1455: no infiltrate or effusion.
content.zh: 护士识别发热和寒战，获取生命体征和实验室检查，并于 1425 按常规医嘱从两个外周部位和一个 PICC 管腔采集血培养。1430 通知肿瘤科。肿瘤科医生确认中性粒细胞减少性发热，并医嘱尽快开始经验性广谱 IV 抗生素，首次剂量须在记录发热后 1 小时内给予。医嘱还包括胸片、4 小时后复查乳酸、0.9% 氯化钠 125 mL/hr。1445 经 PICC 开始抗生素输注，距离培养采集 15 分钟。门口张贴中性粒细胞减少防护标识：禁止鲜花/植物；遵循机构低微生物/食品安全方案；进入前手卫生；患病访客不得探视。不得直肠测温、直肠给药或做不必要的侵入性操作。1455 胸片：无浸润或积液。

title.zh: 第 1 阶段临床经过

title.en: Stage 1: 1415 to 1500, fever recognized and first antibiotic started
title.zh: 第 1 阶段：1415 至 1500，识别发热并开始首次抗生素

content.en: 1600: rigors have stopped and the client feels slightly better. 1730: restless and lightheaded when sitting up. 1745 vitals: T 102.9 °F (39.4 °C), HR 118, BP 92/58, RR 24, SpO₂ 94% room air. Capillary refill 4 seconds. Alert but slower to respond and fatigued. Urine output over the past 4 hours: 60 mL. 1800 lactate: 3.2 mmol/L, up from 1.4. The nurse repositions the client supine, initiates an isotonic crystalloid bolus per sepsis protocol with reassessment, applies O₂ 2 L/min nasal cannula, notifies oncology and rapid response, and redraws blood cultures. The oncologist broadens antibiotics. Oral mucositis and PICC site are unchanged; lungs remain clear.
content.zh: 1600：寒战停止，患者感觉稍好。1730：烦躁，坐起时头晕。1745 生命体征：T 102.9 °F (39.4 °C)，HR 118，BP 92/58，RR 24，室内空气 SpO₂ 94%。毛细血管再充盈 4 秒。仍清醒但回答变慢、疲乏。过去 4 小时尿量 60 mL。1800 乳酸：3.2 mmol/L，高于 1.4。护士协助患者平卧，按脓毒症方案开始等渗晶体液快速补液并复评，给予鼻导管 O₂ 2 L/min，通知肿瘤科和快速反应团队，并重新采集血培养。肿瘤科医生扩大抗生素覆盖。口腔黏膜炎和 PICC 部位无变化；双肺仍清晰。

title.zh: 第 2 阶段临床经过
第 2 阶段：1500 至 1800，血流动力学恶化

content.en: After the bolus and broadened antibiotics: 1930 vitals T 101.5 °F (38.6 °C), HR 106, BP 100/64, RR 20, SpO₂ 96% on 2 L nasal cannula. More alert and conversational. Urine output 1800-2000: 90 mL. Lactate at 2100: 2.0 mmol/L. Capillary refill 3 seconds. 2200 vitals T 100.6 °F (38.1 °C), HR 96, BP 106/68, RR 18, SpO₂ 97% on 2 L; urine output 2000-2200: 110 mL. Initial blood cultures pending. At 1030 next morning, microbiology reports a preliminary Gram-positive organism in the PICC lumen bottle at 20 hours, with speciation and sensitivities to follow.
