Oncology states the client will remain inpatient on IV antibiotics until afebrile for at least 48 hours and ANC shows early recovery. The nurse begins discharge-readiness teaching for future cycles.
content.zh: 补液和扩大抗生素后：1930 生命体征 T 101.5 °F (38.6 °C)，HR 106，BP 100/64，RR 20，鼻导管 2 L 下 SpO₂ 96%。患者更清醒并能交谈。1800-2000 尿量 90 mL。2100 乳酸：2.0 mmol/L。毛细血管再充盈 3 秒。2200 生命体征 T 100.6 °F (38.1 °C)，HR 96，BP 106/68，RR 18，鼻导管 2 L 下 SpO₂ 97%；2000-2200 尿量 110 mL。初始血培养待出。次日 1030，微生物实验室报告 20 小时培养的 PICC 管腔瓶初步见革兰阳性菌，菌种和药敏待出。肿瘤科说明患者需继续住院接受 IV 抗生素，直到至少 48 小时无发热且 ANC 出现早期恢复。护士开始针对未来疗程进行出院准备教育。

title.zh: 第 3 阶段临床经过

title.en: Stage 3: 1800 to 1030 next morning, response and discharge-readiness teaching
title.zh: 第 3 阶段：1800 至次日 1030，治疗反应和出院准备教育

summary.en: A 58-year-old woman with stage IIIB diffuse large B-cell lymphoma is on day 10 of cycle 2 R-CHOP and is in the expected count nadir window. She was admitted two days ago for poor oral intake and dehydration. A triple-lumen PICC is patent. Standing orders require blood cultures and immediate oncology notification for a single oral temperature ≥ 100.9 °F (38.3 °C) or temperature ≥ 100.4 °F (38.0 °C) sustained over one hour.
summary.zh: 一名 58 岁女性，患 IIIB 期弥漫大 B 细胞淋巴瘤，正在第 2 个 R-CHOP 周期第 10 天，处于预期血细胞计数低谷期。她两天前因进食差和脱水入院。三腔 PICC 通畅。常规医嘱要求：单次口温 ≥ 100.9 °F (38.3 °C) 或体温 ≥ 100.4 °F (38.0 °C) 持续 1 小时时，采集血培养并立即通知肿瘤科。

title.zh: 化疗低谷期中性粒细胞减少性发热

glossary.defZh: 中性粒细胞减少患者出现达到阈值的发热，需按急症处理。
glossary.termZh: 中性粒细胞减少性发热

glossary.defZh: 化疗后血细胞计数最低、感染风险最高的时期。
感染引起的全身反应导致器官灌注或功能受损。
用于长期静脉治疗的中心静脉通路，可成为感染来源。
glossary.termZh: 经外周置入中心静脉导管

correct.en: This case centers on recognizing fever during chemotherapy nadir as a neutropenic emergency, preserving culture yield without delaying empiric antibiotics, preventing portals of entry, escalating promptly when perfusion worsens, and teaching exact home return precautions. Stage 2 shows progression toward neutropenic sepsis; Stage 3 shows improvement by reversing perfusion markers while still requiring inpatient antibiotics and follow-up of the positive PICC-lumen culture.
correct.zh: 本病例重点是识别化疗低谷期发热为中性粒细胞减少相关急症，在不延误经验性抗生素的前提下保留培养诊断价值，预防感染入口，灌注恶化时及时升级处理，并用具体标准进行居家返院教育。第 2 阶段显示向中性粒细胞减少性脓毒症进展；第 3 阶段通过灌注指标逆转显示改善，但仍需住院 IV 抗生素并跟进 PICC 管腔培养阳性结果。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

testTakingStrategy.en: Follow the timeline: first recognize the emergency, then protect diagnostic cultures while starting treatment, then respond to shock cues, then evaluate trends and teach return precautions.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 按时间线思考：先识别急症，再在开始治疗的同时保护培养诊断价值，然后应对休克线索，最后评估趋势并教育返院标准。

content.en: A 71-year-old woman with HFrEF (EF 30%), type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and mild CKD was admitted 4 days ago for acute decompensated heart failure after running out of furosemide because she could not afford the refill. She was treated with IV furosemide, transitioned to new oral torsemide 40 mg daily, had lisinopril increased to 20 mg daily, and received a new carvedilol prescription. She lives alone in a second-floor walk-up apartment with no elevator and has no home scale. Her daughter lives 90 minutes away and works full-time. The attending entered a discharge order this morning with a target discharge time of 11:00 AM during bed-throughput pressure.
content.zh: 一名 71 岁女性，有射血分数降低型心衰（EF 30%）、2 型糖尿病、高血压和轻度慢性肾病。4 天前因买不起 furosemide 续药而停药，发生急性失代偿性心衰入院。住院期间接受 IV furosemide，改为新的口服 torsemide 40 mg 每日一次，lisinopril 增至每日 20 mg，并新增 carvedilol。她独居在无电梯的二楼公寓，家中没有体重秤；女儿住在 90 分钟路程外且全职工作。由于床位周转压力，医生今晨开立出院医嘱，目标上午 11:00 出院。

title.zh: 入院背景与出院情境

content.en: The client is fatigued and slightly short of breath while talking. Vital signs: T 36.8 C, HR 92 regular, BP 108/68, RR 22, SpO2 93% on room air. Weight today 78.2 kg; admission weight 84.6 kg; yesterday 79.0 kg. Fine crackles remain at the lung bases, trace bilateral pedal edema, no visible JVD at 45 degrees, warm/dry skin, capillary refill 2 seconds. She reports mild dizziness after sitting up to use the commode. No chest pain; alert and oriented. Labs: Na 138, K 3.4, Cl 96, CO2 30, BUN 38, creatinine 1.8 mg/dL (baseline outpatient 1.4; admission 1.6), glucose 142, BNP 680 pg/mL (admission 2,400; yesterday 820), Hgb 11.4, WBC 7.2, platelets 210, Mg 1.7, INR 1.0, albumin 3.0.
content.zh: 患者疲惫，讲话时略感气短。生命体征：T 36.8 C，HR 92 次/分且规则，BP 108/68，RR 22 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 93%。今日体重 78.2 kg；入院 84.6 kg；昨日 79.0 kg。双肺底仍有细湿啰音，双足轻微水肿，45 度时无可见颈静脉怒张，皮肤温暖干燥，毛细血管再充盈 2 秒。她报告坐起使用便盆后有轻度头晕。无胸痛；意识清楚，定向力正常。实验室：Na 138，K 3.4，Cl 96，CO2 30，BUN 38，肌酐 1.8 mg/dL（门诊基线 1.4；入院 1.6），葡萄糖 142，BNP 680 pg/mL（入院 2,400；昨日 820），Hgb 11.4，WBC 7.2，血小板 210，Mg 1.7，INR 1.0，白蛋白 3.0。

title.en: Morning assessment and laboratory data at 07:15
title.zh: 07:15 早晨评估与实验室资料

glossary.defZh: 患者是否能在生理、功能、理解、用药取得和居家支持方面安全出院。
让患者用自己的话复述教育重点，以确认理解。
心衰评估中常用的血液指标；下降可提示治疗反应，但不能单独决定出院安全。

segments.en: The client is alert and oriented to person, place, time, and situation.
segments.zh: 患者对人、地点、时间和情况均定向力正常。

segments.en: Resting RR is 22/min with SpO2 93% on room air.
segments.zh: 静息时呼吸频率 22 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 为 93%。

segments.en: Weight decreased from 84.6 kg on admission to 78.2 kg today.
segments.zh: 体重从入院时 84.6 kg 降至今天 78.2 kg。

segments.en: Jugular venous distension is no longer visible at 45 degrees.
segments.zh: 床头抬高 45 度时已看不到颈静脉怒张。

segments.en: Bilateral pedal edema improved from 2+ on admission to trace today.
segments.zh: 双侧足部水肿从入院时 2+ 改善为轻微。

segments.en: During hallway ambulation of about 40 feet, SpO2 decreased to 89% on room air and oxygen was needed for recovery.
segments.zh: 在走廊步行约 40 英尺时，室内空气 SpO2 降至 89%，需要吸氧后才恢复。

segments.en: The client cannot explain the purpose of torsemide, what to do for sudden weight gain, or which symptoms require calling the provider.
segments.zh: 患者无法说明 torsemide 的用途、体重突然增加时该怎么做，或哪些症状需要联系医护人员。

segments.en: The new diuretic has a $95/month copay, and medication cost was the reason she stopped her prior furosemide.
segments.zh: 新的利尿剂每月自付 95 美元，而药费负担正是她之前停用 furosemide 的原因。

segments.en: She lives alone in a second-floor walk-up apartment and has no home scale.
segments.zh: 她独居在没有电梯的二楼公寓，家中没有体重秤。

segments.en: BNP decreased from 2,400 pg/mL on admission to 680 pg/mL today.
segments.zh: BNP 从入院时 2,400 pg/mL 降至今天 680 pg/mL。

segments.en: Creatinine is 1.8 mg/dL, above her outpatient baseline of 1.4 mg/dL.
segments.zh: 肌酐为 1.8 mg/dL，高于门诊基线 1.4 mg/dL。

byChoice.en: Normal orientation is reassuring and does not by itself make the discharge unsafe.
byChoice.zh: 定向力正常是令人放心的资料，本身不是出院不安全的原因。

byChoice.en: Borderline resting oxygenation with tachypnea shows residual respiratory compromise before the exertion required at home.
byChoice.zh: 静息氧合临界且呼吸偏快，提示在回家所需活动前仍有呼吸储备不足。

byChoice.en: The weight loss shows response to diuresis, but it does not prove that the client can manage safely at home.
byChoice.zh: 体重下降说明利尿治疗有效，但不能证明患者能在家安全管理。

byChoice.en: Resolved JVD supports improvement in congestion; it is not a discharge barrier.
byChoice.zh: 颈静脉怒张消退支持淤血改善，不是出院障碍。

byChoice.en: Improved edema is a positive treatment response, not an active barrier.
byChoice.zh: 水肿改善是治疗有效的表现，不是当前障碍。

byChoice.en: Desaturation with only minimal ambulation and need for oxygen recovery directly conflict with the stairs and exertion required at home.
byChoice.zh: 仅少量步行即低氧并需吸氧恢复，直接不符合其回家后需要爬楼和活动的要求。

byChoice.en: Failed teach-back means the client cannot yet carry out the medication, weight-monitoring, and symptom-response plan independently.
byChoice.zh: 回授失败说明患者尚不能独立执行用药、体重监测和症状处理计划。

byChoice.en: Unaffordable diuretic therapy recreates the same adherence barrier that precipitated the admission.
byChoice.zh: 利尿剂负担不起会重现导致本次入院的同一服药障碍。

byChoice.en: Living alone, stairs, and no scale create environmental and monitoring barriers for heart-failure self-management.
byChoice.zh: 独居、楼梯和没有体重秤构成心衰自我管理的环境与监测障碍。

byChoice.en: A falling BNP supports improvement, but biomarkers do not override functional, comprehension, and access barriers.
byChoice.zh: BNP 下降支持病情改善，但生物标志物不能抵消功能、理解和用药取得方面的障碍。

byChoice.en: Creatinine above baseline during ongoing diuresis signals unresolved renal-risk monitoring before discharge.
byChoice.zh: 在继续利尿时肌酐高于基线，提示出院前仍需关注肾功能风险。

correct.en: The unsafe-discharge cues are residual respiratory compromise, exertional desaturation requiring oxygen recovery, failed teach-back, unaffordable diuretic therapy, unsafe home environment/no scale, and creatinine above baseline. Improving weight, edema, JVD, and BNP show treatment response but do not prove discharge readiness.
correct.zh: 出院不安全的线索包括仍有呼吸受限、活动后低氧且需吸氧恢复、回授失败、利尿剂负担不起、居家环境/无体重秤不安全，以及肌酐高于基线。体重、水肿、颈静脉怒张和 BNP 改善说明治疗有效，但不能证明已具备出院准备。

stem.en: Using the Stage 1 information, highlight the findings that are red flags for unsafe discharge today.
stem.zh: 根据第 1 阶段资料，标出提示今天出院不安全的危险信号。

testTakingStrategy.en: For discharge-readiness questions, separate evidence of treatment response from evidence that the client can safely carry out the plan at home.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做出院准备度题时，要把“治疗有反应”和“患者能否在家安全执行计划”分开判断。

glossary.defZh: 若未解决会直接影响出院安全的生理、功能、认知、经济或环境问题。
用于排出多余液体的药物，可能影响钾、镁和肾功能。
经济能力、住房、交通、社会支持等会影响健康结局的非医学因素。

columns.en: Resolved/improving or not a discharge barrier

rows.en: SpO2 decreases to 89% after 40 feet of ambulation.
rows.zh: 步行 40 英尺后 SpO2 降至 89%。

rows.en: JVD is no longer visible at 45 degrees.
rows.zh: 床头抬高 45 度时已看不到颈静脉怒张。

rows.en: The client cannot identify when to call the provider for weight gain or symptoms.
rows.zh: 患者无法说明体重增加或症状出现时何时联系医护人员。

rows.en: The new diuretic costs $95/month and is not affordable.
rows.zh: 新的利尿剂每月 95 美元，患者负担不起。

rows.en: Weight is down 6.4 kg since admission and 0.8 kg since yesterday.
rows.zh: 体重较入院下降 6.4 kg，较昨天下降 0.8 kg。

rows.en: The client lives alone in a second-floor walk-up apartment.
rows.zh: 患者独居在没有电梯的二楼公寓。

rows.en: Creatinine is 1.8 mg/dL, above a baseline of 1.4 mg/dL.
rows.zh: 肌酐 1.8 mg/dL，高于基线 1.4 mg/dL。

rows.en: The client is afebrile and has no chest pain.
rows.zh: 患者无发热且无胸痛。

rows.en: Potassium is 3.4 mEq/L while loop diuretic therapy is continuing.
rows.zh: 继续使用袢利尿剂时钾为 3.4 mEq/L。

rows.en: BNP is trending down from 2,400 to 680 pg/mL.
rows.zh: BNP 从 2,400 pg/mL 降至 680 pg/mL。

byChoice.en: Exertional desaturation is a functional and physiologic barrier, especially with stairs at home.
byChoice.zh: 活动后低氧是功能和生理障碍，尤其患者家中需要爬楼。

byChoice.en: Resolved JVD is an improvement in congestion, not a current barrier.
byChoice.zh: 颈静脉怒张消退是淤血改善，不是当前障碍。

byChoice.en: Inability to state weight and symptom actions is a comprehension barrier to self-management.
byChoice.zh: 无法说明体重和症状处理措施，是自我管理的理解障碍。

byChoice.en: Medication non-affordability is a direct clinical barrier because it caused the current decompensation.
byChoice.zh: 药物负担不起是直接临床障碍，因为它导致了本次失代偿。

byChoice.en: Weight loss shows response to therapy; it does not remove the discharge barriers.
byChoice.zh: 体重下降说明治疗有反应，但不能消除出院障碍。

byChoice.en: Stairs and living alone are environmental/social barriers when the client cannot tolerate minimal ambulation.
byChoice.zh: 当患者不能耐受少量步行时，楼梯和独居就是环境/社会障碍。

byChoice.en: Creatinine above baseline is an unresolved clinical monitoring concern during diuresis.
byChoice.zh: 利尿期间肌酐高于基线，是未解决的临床监测问题。

byChoice.en: Afebrile status and no chest pain are reassuring findings, not active discharge barriers.
byChoice.zh: 无发热、无胸痛是令人放心的资料，不是当前出院障碍。

byChoice.en: Low-normal potassium during loop-diuretic therapy can worsen with continued diuresis and needs correction/monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 使用袢利尿剂时钾偏低正常，继续利尿可能进一步下降，需要补充或监测。

byChoice.en: Downtrending BNP supports improved heart-failure status but does not prove safe transition home.
byChoice.zh: BNP 下降支持心衰改善，但不能证明能安全过渡回家。

correct.en: Active barriers include exertional hypoxemia, failed self-management understanding, medication unaffordability, unsafe home environment/lack of support, creatinine above baseline, and low-normal potassium during diuresis. Improving congestion markers and reassuring negatives do not make discharge safe by themselves.
correct.zh: 当前障碍包括活动后低氧、自我管理理解失败、药物负担不起、居家环境/支持不足、肌酐高于基线，以及利尿期间钾偏低正常。淤血指标改善和阴性体征本身不能说明出院安全。

stem.en: For each Stage 1 finding, classify whether it is an active barrier to safe discharge or a resolved/improving finding that does not remove the other barriers.
stem.zh: 对每个第 1 阶段发现进行分类：它是安全出院的当前障碍，还是已改善/非障碍且不能抵消其他风险的发现。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a question asks you to classify cues, do not let a single improving trend erase barriers in other domains.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当题目要求分类线索时，不要让单一改善趋势掩盖其他领域的障碍。

glossary.defZh: 护士代表患者安全和权益发声，并推动解决风险。
因床位或流程需求而推动快速出院或转运的运营压力。

options.en: Give extra written instructions and avoid challenging the provider because the discharge order is active.
options.zh: 提供更多书面说明，不质疑医嘱，因为出院医嘱已经生效。

options.en: Advocate to hold or modify the discharge because the plan is unsafe despite improving biomarkers.
options.zh: 主张暂缓或修改出院计划，因为尽管指标改善，目前计划仍不安全。

options.en: Proceed with discharge because the BNP is lower and the client has completed four hospital days.
options.zh: 因 BNP 降低且已住院四天，所以按计划出院。

options.en: Delay advocacy until bed management confirms whether an emergency department patient still needs the bed.
options.zh: 等床位管理确认急诊患者是否仍需要床位后再进行倡导。

byChoice.en: Throughput pressure is not the priority. Advocacy should not wait for operational confirmation when patient safety barriers are present.
byChoice.zh: 床位周转压力不是优先事项；出现患者安全障碍时，倡导不应等待运营确认。

byChoice.en: Length of stay and a lower BNP do not override failed ambulation, failed teach-back, unaffordable medication, and unsafe home conditions.
byChoice.zh: 住院天数和 BNP 降低不能抵消步行失败、回授失败、药物负担不起和居家不安全。

byChoice.en: This focuses on the nurse's duty to protect client safety and uses objective barriers to request a discharge hold or modification.
byChoice.zh: 这体现护士保护患者安全的职责，并用客观障碍请求暂缓或修改出院。

byChoice.en: Written materials alone do not fix demonstrated misunderstanding, and the nurse should speak up when an active order threatens safety.
byChoice.zh: 单靠书面资料不能解决已证实的理解不足；当有效医嘱威胁安全时护士应发声。

correct.en: The priority concern is patient safety. The nurse should communicate the specific barriers and request that discharge be held or modified pending interdisciplinary evaluation. Bed pressure and improving biomarkers do not override unsafe functional, comprehension, medication-access, and home-environment findings.
correct.zh: 优先问题是患者安全。护士应沟通具体障碍，并请求暂缓或修改出院，等待跨专业评估。床位压力和指标改善不能超过功能、理解、用药取得和居家环境方面的不安全发现。

stem.en: The attending cites the downtrending BNP and the need for the bed as reasons to proceed. What is the nurse's priority advocacy stance?
stem.zh: 医生以 BNP 下降和需要床位为理由要求继续出院。护士优先的倡导立场是什么？

testTakingStrategy.en: When the stem includes operational pressure, ask whether it conflicts with client safety. Safety wins.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 题干出现运营压力时，先判断它是否与患者安全冲突。患者安全优先。

glossary.defZh: 协调保险、资源、转诊和过渡护理计划的成员。
帮助优化用药、评估相互作用、剂量和可负担性的药学人员。
评估住所是否适合患者当前功能能力和护理需求的检查。

options.en: Arrange home health nursing and coordinate immediate family support.
options.zh: 安排居家护理，并协调近期家属支持。

options.en: Contact the case manager about transition needs, insurance coverage, and discharge resources.
options.zh: 联系个案管理师评估过渡需求、保险覆盖和出院资源。

options.en: Discharge the client as ordered to free the telemetry bed and rely on written instructions.
options.zh: 按医嘱让患者出院以腾出监护床位，并依赖书面说明。

options.en: Ask the clinical pharmacist to identify an affordable formulary alternative or assistance program.
options.zh: 请临床药师寻找可负担的目录内替代药或援助项目。

options.en: Request social work support for home resources, a scale, and home-safety evaluation.
options.zh: 请求社工协助居家资源、体重秤和居家安全评估。

options.en: Document the ambulation result, failed teach-back, medication-cost barrier, and home-safety concerns.
options.zh: 记录步行结果、回授失败、药费障碍和居家安全担忧。

byChoice.en: Pharmacy involvement targets the exact medication-access problem that caused the admission.
byChoice.zh: 药师介入针对导致入院的核心用药取得问题。

byChoice.en: Proceeding to free a bed ignores unresolved safety barriers and repeats the conditions that led to decompensation.
byChoice.zh: 为腾床出院会忽视未解决的安全障碍，并重现导致失代偿的条件。

byChoice.en: Social work addresses the community and home-environment barriers that make the current plan unsafe.
byChoice.zh: 社工可处理使当前计划不安全的社区与居家环境障碍。

byChoice.en: Documentation preserves the objective safety record and supports provider communication and escalation if needed.
byChoice.zh: 记录可保留客观安全资料，并支持与医生沟通及必要时上报。

byChoice.en: Case management can address insurance, resources, and transition-of-care planning.
byChoice.zh: 个案管理可处理保险、资源和过渡护理计划。

byChoice.en: Home health and family support provide monitoring and immediate assistance after discharge.
byChoice.zh: 居家护理和家属支持可在出院后提供监测和即时帮助。

correct.en: The nurse should document, involve case management, social work, pharmacy, home health, and family support. These actions target the functional, comprehension, financial, and environmental barriers. Discharging to meet a bed target is unsafe.
correct.zh: 护士应记录情况，并联络个案管理、社工、药师、居家护理和家属支持。这些措施分别处理功能、理解、经济和环境障碍。为了床位目标出院是不安全的。

stem.en: Which nursing actions address the identified Stage 1 discharge barriers? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 哪些护理措施可以处理第 1 阶段识别出的出院障碍？选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: For multi-domain discharge barriers, choose the actions that match each barrier; avoid one-resource answers for a multi-resource problem.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 面对多领域出院障碍时，选择能对应每个障碍的措施；多资源问题不要只选单一资源。

glossary.defZh: 已经由医生开立、可能被执行的医嘱。
初步沟通未解决安全问题时，按政策寻求更高层级协助。

options.en: Escalate directly to the nursing supervisor before speaking with the attending physician.
options.zh: 在联系主治医生前直接上报护理主管。

options.en: Call the daughter first to see if she can solve the transportation and stair problem.
options.zh: 先致电女儿，看她是否能解决交通和爬楼问题。

options.en: Call the attending physician with the objective safety concerns and request that the discharge order be held.
options.zh: 致电主治医生说明客观安全担忧，并请求暂缓出院医嘱。

options.en: Page the social worker first because financial and home barriers are the root causes.
options.zh: 先呼叫社工，因为经济和居家障碍是根本原因。

byChoice.en: The active discharge order must be paused first so there is time to mobilize the interdisciplinary resources safely.
byChoice.zh: 必须先暂停已经生效的出院医嘱，才能安全争取时间调动跨专业资源。

byChoice.en: Chain-of-command escalation is appropriate if the provider will not address the concern; the first step is direct provider communication.
byChoice.zh: 若医生不处理担忧，逐级上报是合适的；第一步应先直接与医生沟通。

byChoice.en: Family support is important, but it cannot replace provider modification of the unsafe discharge order.
byChoice.zh: 家属支持很重要，但不能替代医生修改不安全的出院医嘱。

byChoice.en: Social work is needed, but calling social work first does not stop the active 11:00 discharge process.
byChoice.zh: 社工确实需要介入，但先找社工不能阻止 11:00 的有效出院流程。

correct.en: The first action is direct communication with the ordering provider to request a discharge hold. This stops the unsafe process and creates time for case management, social work, pharmacy, home health, and family coordination. Escalation follows if the provider refuses to address the safety concern.
correct.zh: 首要措施是直接联系开立医嘱的医生，请求暂缓出院。这样才能停止不安全流程，并争取时间协调个案管理、社工、药师、居家护理和家属。若医生拒绝处理安全问题，再逐级上报。

stem.en: The discharge order is active with a target discharge time of 11:00 AM. After identifying the unsafe discharge picture, what should the nurse do first?
stem.zh: 出院医嘱已生效，目标出院时间为上午 11:00。识别出出院不安全后，护士首先应怎么做？

testTakingStrategy.en: When an unsafe process is already moving, choose the action that pauses the unsafe process before arranging secondary supports.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当不安全流程已经启动时，应先选择能暂停该流程的措施，再安排后续支持。

glossary.defZh: 判断干预后目标是否达到，并确认原先的问题是否已解决。
出院后已预约的复诊或联系，用于监测病情和调整治疗。
患者完成日常活动所需体力活动而不出现危险症状的能力。

columns.en: Evidence a specific discharge barrier is resolved or controlled
columns.zh: 证明某个出院障碍已解决或受控

columns.en: Helpful treatment-response data but not sufficient alone
columns.zh: 有帮助的治疗反应资料，但单独不足

rows.en: Ambulates 150 feet and completes simulated stairs with SpO2 92% on room air, recovering within 1 minute.
rows.zh: 步行 150 英尺并完成模拟楼梯，室内空气 SpO2 为 92%，1 分钟内恢复。

rows.en: Correctly explains the diuretic purpose, daily weight plan, call parameters, and warning signs.
rows.zh: 正确说明利尿剂用途、每日称重计划、联系医护的参数和警示症状。

rows.en: The prescription is revised and a 30-day diuretic supply is provided before discharge.
rows.zh: 处方已修改，且出院前已提供 30 天利尿剂供应。

rows.en: Daughter will stay for two days, home health visit is scheduled, scale delivery is arranged, and cardiology follow-up is confirmed.
rows.zh: 女儿将陪伴两天，已安排居家护理、体重秤配送，并确认心脏科随访。

rows.en: Creatinine improves from 1.8 to 1.6 mg/dL, potassium is 4.1 mEq/L, and resting SpO2 is 95%.
rows.zh: 肌酐从 1.8 改善至 1.6 mg/dL，钾为 4.1 mEq/L，静息 SpO2 为 95%。

rows.en: BNP has decreased to 520 pg/mL.
rows.zh: BNP 已降至 520 pg/mL。

byChoice.en: This directly verifies functional tolerance for walking and stairs without clinically significant desaturation.
byChoice.zh: 这直接验证患者能耐受步行和楼梯，且无临床上显著的低氧。

byChoice.en: Successful teach-back resolves the comprehension barrier to self-management.
byChoice.zh: 回授成功解决了自我管理理解障碍。

byChoice.en: Medication access is now secured, addressing the nonadherence trigger for the admission.
byChoice.zh: 用药取得已经落实，解决了导致本次入院的服药中断诱因。

byChoice.en: Immediate support, home monitoring equipment, home nursing, and follow-up address the social and environmental barriers.
byChoice.zh: 近期支持、居家监测设备、居家护理和随访解决社会与环境障碍。

byChoice.en: Improved renal function, electrolytes, and resting oxygenation show clinical stability for the modified discharge plan.
byChoice.zh: 肾功能、电解质和静息氧合改善，说明修改后的出院计划下临床状态较稳定。

byChoice.en: BNP improvement is supportive, but BNP alone does not prove the client can manage medications, stairs, monitoring, or follow-up at home.
byChoice.zh: BNP 改善有支持意义，但 BNP 单独不能证明患者能在家管理用药、爬楼、监测或随访。

correct.en: By Stage 3, the functional, comprehension, medication-access, support/equipment, and clinical-stability barriers have concrete resolutions. BNP is still helpful as treatment-response information, but it remains insufficient by itself to establish discharge readiness.
correct.zh: 到第 3 阶段，功能、理解、用药取得、支持/设备和临床稳定性障碍都有具体解决结果。BNP 仍是有帮助的治疗反应资料，但单独仍不足以证明出院准备充分。

stem.en: Using the Stage 3 re-evaluation, classify each finding as evidence that a specific discharge barrier has been resolved/controlled or as supportive treatment-response data that is not sufficient alone.
stem.zh: 根据第 3 阶段重新评估，将每项发现分类为“证明某个出院障碍已解决/受控”，或“有帮助但单独不足的治疗反应资料”。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate outcomes by matching each original problem to a verifiable resolution; do not clear discharge on a lab trend alone.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价结果时，要把每个原始问题对应到可验证的解决结果；不要仅凭一个实验室趋势就认为可以出院。

content.en: During teach-back, the client says torsemide may be for blood pressure, is unsure what to do for weight gain over 2 lb overnight, and cannot name warning signs that should prompt calling the provider. She asks whether torsemide is the same as furosemide and whether insurance will cover it. Pharmacy test claim shows a $95/month copay for the new diuretic. She says she lives on about $1,400/month and could not afford furosemide last month, which is why she stopped taking it. Ambulation trial: after about 40 feet, she stops, grips the handrail, and says she is very winded. HR 110, RR 28, SpO2 89% on room air. She requires 2 minutes of rest and oxygen 2 L/min by nasal cannula to recover to SpO2 93%. She states her apartment is up one flight of stairs and she does not know how she would make it. Five minutes after returning to bed: HR 96, RR 24, SpO2 92% on room air. At 08:45, bed management asks whether the bed will be available by 11:00 because 3 emergency department patients are boarding for telemetry beds.
content.zh: 回授时，患者说 torsemide 可能是降血压药，不确定如果一夜体重增加超过 2 lb 该怎么做，也说不出哪些警示症状需要联系医护人员。她询问 torsemide 是否和 furosemide 一样，以及保险是否会支付。药房试算显示新的利尿剂每月自付 95 美元。她表示每月社会保障收入约 1,400 美元，上月因买不起 furosemide 才停药。步行试验：约 40 英尺后，她停下抓住扶手，说非常喘。HR 110，RR 28，室内空气 SpO2 89%。她需要休息 2 分钟并经鼻导管吸氧 2 L/min，才恢复至 SpO2 93%。她说自己的公寓要上一层楼，不知道自己能否做到。回床休息 5 分钟后：HR 96，RR 24，室内空气 SpO2 92%。08:45，床位管理询问该床是否能在 11:00 空出，因为急诊有 3 名患者在等待监护床位。

title.en: Teach-back, medication access, and functional tolerance
title.zh: 回授、用药取得与功能耐受

title.en: Stage 1: 07:30-09:00, discharge teaching and ambulation trial
title.zh: 第 1 阶段：07:30-09:00，出院教育与步行试验

content.en: The nurse documents ambulation findings, failed teach-back, medication affordability barrier, and home environment concerns. At 09:15, the nurse calls the attending and reports that the client desaturates to 89% with minimal exertion, cannot demonstrate understanding of the new regimen, cannot afford the diuretic, lives alone, lacks a scale, and must climb stairs. The attending initially cites length of stay, downtrending BNP, and bed need. The nurse respectfully reiterates patient-safety concerns and states she will escalate through chain of command if the discharge order is not modified. The attending agrees to hold discharge for interdisciplinary evaluation. The nurse pages the case manager, requests social work, contacts the clinical pharmacist for formulary or assistance options, places a home health referral, and contacts the daughter. By 10:30, pharmacy identifies a covered generic loop-diuretic alternative; social work identifies a scale program and home-safety evaluation; home health accepts the referral for the day after discharge; the daughter arranges to stay for 2 days.
content.zh: 护士记录步行发现、回授失败、用药负担障碍和居家环境担忧。09:15，护士致电主治医生，报告患者少量活动即 SpO2 降至 89%，不能说明新用药方案，负担不起利尿剂，独居、没有体重秤且需要爬楼。医生最初以住院天数、BNP 下降和床位需求为理由。护士尊重地重申患者安全担忧，并说明若出院医嘱不修改，将按逐级上报流程处理。医生同意暂缓出院，等待跨专业评估。护士呼叫个案管理师，请求社工会诊，联系临床药师寻找目录内或援助方案，申请居家护理，并联系女儿。10:30 前，药师找到保险覆盖的通用袢利尿剂替代方案；社工找到体重秤项目并安排居家安全评估；居家护理接受转诊并安排出院次日上门；女儿安排陪伴 2 天。

title.zh: 暂缓出院并启动资源
第 2 阶段：09:00-11:30，倡导与跨专业介入

content.en: The provider orders potassium and magnesium repletion, repeat labs, and an additional loop-diuretic dose. Next morning resting vitals: HR 82, BP 112/70, RR 18, SpO2 95% on room air. Weight 77.4 kg. At 09:00, the client walks 150 feet and completes simulated stair climbing with HR 98, RR 22, SpO2 92% on room air; she recovers to baseline within 1 minute without oxygen. On repeat teach-back, she correctly states that the diuretic is her water pill, that she should weigh herself every morning, and that she should call for weight gain over 2 lb in 1 day or 3 lb in 1 week. She names increased leg swelling, waking up short of breath, and needing more pillows to sleep as warning signs. She states the medication names, doses, and timing, and confirms her daughter will stay for 2 days, home health will visit the day after discharge, a scale is being delivered, her prescription was revised, a 30-day diuretic supply is in hand, and cardiology follow-up is in 5 days. Labs: K 4.1, Mg 2.0, creatinine 1.6 mg/dL, BNP 520 pg/mL.
content.zh: 医生医嘱补充钾和镁、复查实验室，并再给一次袢利尿剂。次日早晨静息生命体征：HR 82，BP 112/70，RR 18，室内空气 SpO2 95%。体重 77.4 kg。09:00，患者步行 150 英尺并完成模拟爬楼，HR 98，RR 22，室内空气 SpO2 92%；无需吸氧，1 分钟内恢复基线。再次回授时，她正确说明利尿剂是“排水药”，应每天早晨称体重；若 1 天增加超过 2 lb 或 1 周增加 3 lb 应联系医护人员。她能说出警示症状：腿部肿胀增加、夜间气短醒来、需要更多枕头睡觉。她能说出药名、剂量和时间，并确认女儿将陪伴 2 天、居家护理出院次日上门、体重秤将送达、处方已修改、手中有 30 天利尿剂供应，且 5 天后心脏科随访。实验室：K 4.1，Mg 2.0，肌酐 1.6 mg/dL，BNP 520 pg/mL。

title.zh: 干预后的重新评估

title.en: Stage 3: Next morning 08:00-11:00, re-evaluation and modified discharge
title.zh: 第 3 阶段：次日 08:00-11:00，重新评估与修改后出院

summary.en: A 71-year-old client recovering from acute decompensated heart failure has an active discharge order despite unresolved functional, comprehension, medication-access, social, environmental, and clinical monitoring concerns.
summary.zh: 一名 71 岁急性失代偿性心衰恢复期患者已有有效出院医嘱，但仍存在功能、理解、用药取得、社会、环境和临床监测方面未解决的担忧。

title.en: Advocating Against Unsafe Premature Discharge in Acute Decompensated Heart Failure
title.zh: 急性失代偿性心衰中反对不安全过早出院的患者倡导

glossary.defZh: 患者在生理状态、功能能力、理解能力、用药取得、居家支持和随访安排方面均能安全离院的程度。
请患者用自己的话复述重点内容，以确认其是否真正理解教育内容。
当医嘱或计划可能危及患者安全且初次沟通未解决时，护士按机构政策逐级上报的流程。
护士在患者出院后到家中进行评估、用药指导、病情监测和护理支持的服务。

correct.en: This case tests the difference between clinical improvement and discharge readiness. The patient is responding to diuresis, with improved weight, edema, JVD, and BNP, but Stage 1 shows unresolved discharge barriers: borderline resting respiratory status, exertional desaturation requiring oxygen recovery, failed teach-back, an unaffordable new diuretic that repeats the admission trigger, stairs/living alone/no scale, creatinine above baseline, and low-normal potassium during diuresis. The nurse should advocate to hold or modify the discharge order, document objective concerns, and mobilize case management, social work, pharmacy, home health, and family support. By Stage 3, discharge becomes appropriate only because each barrier has a concrete resolution and the client demonstrates functional tolerance, understanding, medication access, home support, follow-up, and stable clinical trajectory.
correct.zh: 本病例考查“临床改善”和“出院准备度”的区别。患者对利尿治疗有反应，体重、水肿、颈静脉怒张和 BNP 改善，但第 1 阶段仍显示未解决的出院障碍：静息呼吸状态临界、活动后低氧且需吸氧恢复、回授失败、新利尿剂负担不起并重现入院诱因、楼梯/独居/无体重秤、肌酐高于基线，以及利尿期间钾偏低正常。护士应倡导暂缓或修改出院医嘱，记录客观担忧，并启动个案管理、社工、药师、居家护理和家属支持。到第 3 阶段，只有在每个障碍都有具体解决结果，且患者证明有功能耐受、理解能力、用药取得、居家支持、随访和稳定临床趋势后，出院才合适。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not equate improving heart-failure markers with safe discharge. Ask: Can the client breathe and function in the home environment, understand the plan, obtain the medication, monitor symptoms/weight, and access support and follow-up?
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要把心衰指标改善等同于安全出院。要问：患者能否在居家环境中呼吸和活动、理解计划、取得药物、监测症状/体重，并获得支持和随访？

content.en: G5P5, one hour postpartum after vaginal birth of a 4.2 kg infant. Second stage lasted 3 hours; oxytocin augmentation was used during first stage. Placenta delivered intact and appeared complete. Pregnancy-induced hypertension was diagnosed at 34 weeks and treated with labetalol 200 mg twice daily. History includes mild intermittent asthma. No bleeding disorder, prior PPH, or uterine surgery. Admission BP 148/94 mmHg. Admission Hgb 11.8 g/dL, Hct 35.2%. Blood type O-positive; type and screen sent on admission. Oxytocin 20 units in 1 L LR has been infusing for about 50 minutes after placental delivery.
content.zh: G5P5，阴道分娩 4.2 kg 新生儿后 1 小时。第二产程持续 3 小时；第一产程使用催产素加强宫缩。胎盘娩出完整，检查外观完整。34 周诊断妊娠期高血压，使用拉贝洛尔 200 mg 每日两次。既往有轻度间歇性哮喘。无出血性疾病、既往产后出血或子宫手术史。入院血压 148/94 mmHg。入院 Hgb 11.8 g/dL，Hct 35.2%。血型 O 阳性；入院已送血型筛查。胎盘娩出后已按医嘱输注催产素 20 units 加入 1 L LR，约 50 分钟。

title.zh: 病史背景

content.en: Client says she feels 'dizzy and wet.' She is pale, diaphoretic, alert, oriented, and anxious. Underpads show a large amount of blood; the perineal pad placed 20 minutes ago is saturated. Vital signs: T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C), HR 118, BP 90/62 mmHg, RR 22, SpO2 97% on room air. Uterus is two fingerbreadths above the umbilicus, deviated to the right, and boggy; it does not stay firm after massage. Lochia is heavy with dark-red flow and several small clots. Repaired second-degree perineal laceration has no active bleeding and no visible hematoma. Bladder is palpable above the symphysis pubis. Skin is cool and clammy; capillary refill 3 seconds. Estimated blood loss is 600 mL and visibly increasing.
content.zh: 患者说自己“头晕，而且感觉很湿”。她面色苍白、出汗，意识清醒、定向力正常但焦虑。护理垫上有大量血液；20 分钟前更换的会阴垫已饱和。生命体征：T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，HR 118，BP 90/62 mmHg，RR 22，室内空气 SpO2 97%。子宫底位于脐上两横指，向右偏移且松软；按摩后不能维持坚硬。恶露量多，暗红色流出并有数个小血块。已缝合的二度会阴裂伤无活动性出血，也未见血肿。耻骨联合上方可触及膀胱。皮肤湿冷；毛细血管再充盈 3 秒。估计失血量 600 mL，并且肉眼可见仍在增加。

title.zh: 产后 1 小时评估

content.en: Hgb 11.8 g/dL, Hct 35.2%, platelets 188 ×10³/µL, fibrinogen 410 mg/dL, INR 1.0, aPTT 28 sec. Sodium 138 mEq/L, potassium 3.9 mEq/L, creatinine 0.7 mg/dL, glucose 92 mg/dL. Urinalysis: 1+ protein, otherwise unremarkable.
content.zh: Hgb 11.8 g/dL，Hct 35.2%，血小板 188 ×10³/µL，纤维蛋白原 410 mg/dL，INR 1.0，aPTT 28 秒。钠 138 mEq/L，钾 3.9 mEq/L，肌酐 0.7 mg/dL，血糖 92 mg/dL。尿检：蛋白 1+，其余无明显异常。

title.zh: 入院化验

glossary.defZh: 产后子宫触之柔软而不是坚硬，提示收缩不良。
产后从子宫经阴道排出的血液和组织。
通过称重或收集血液来测量失血量，而不是仅凭目测估计。

segments.en: Temperature 98.2 °F (36.8 °C).
Heart rate 118 beats/min.
segments.zh: 心率 118 次/分。

segments.en: Blood pressure 90/62 mmHg, down from her hypertensive admission baseline of 148/94 mmHg.
segments.zh: 血压 90/62 mmHg，低于入院时 148/94 mmHg 的妊娠期高血压基线。

segments.en: SpO2 97% on room air.
segments.zh: 室内空气下 SpO2 97%。

segments.en: The uterus is two fingerbreadths above the umbilicus, deviated to the right, and boggy.
segments.zh: 子宫底位于脐上两横指，向右偏移，触之松软。

segments.en: It does not stay firm after gentle massage.
segments.zh: 轻柔按摩后子宫不能持续变硬。

segments.en: Lochia is heavy with a steady dark-red flow and several small clots.
segments.zh: 恶露量多，持续暗红色流出，并有数个小血块。

segments.en: The repaired second-degree perineal laceration has no active bleeding and no visible hematoma.
segments.zh: 已缝合的二度会阴裂伤无活动性出血，也未见血肿。

segments.en: The bladder is palpable above the symphysis pubis.
segments.zh: 耻骨联合上方可触及膀胱。

segments.en: Skin is cool and clammy with capillary refill of 3 seconds.
segments.zh: 皮肤湿冷，毛细血管再充盈时间为 3 秒。

segments.en: Estimated blood loss is 600 mL and visibly increasing.
segments.zh: 估计失血量为 600 mL，且肉眼可见仍在增加。

segments.en: She denies chest pain or shortness of breath.
segments.zh: 她否认胸痛或气短。

byChoice.en: A normal temperature does not define this acute hemorrhage.
byChoice.zh: 体温正常，不能说明当前急性出血问题。

byChoice.en: Tachycardia is an early sign of volume loss and shock in postpartum hemorrhage.
byChoice.zh: 心动过速是产后出血导致容量不足和休克的早期表现。

byChoice.en: The absolute BP is low, and the drop from a hypertensive baseline makes the hemodynamic compromise more severe.
byChoice.zh: 血压本身偏低，且相对妊娠期高血压基线明显下降，提示血流动力学受损更严重。

byChoice.en: Normal oxygen saturation does not rule out hemorrhagic shock and is not the defining cue here.
byChoice.zh: 血氧饱和度正常不能排除失血性休克，也不是本题的关键线索。

byChoice.en: A boggy, displaced uterus is the hallmark cue for uterine atony and impaired contraction.
byChoice.zh: 子宫底偏移且松软是子宫收缩乏力、收缩无效的标志性线索。

byChoice.en: Failure to sustain tone after massage shows that atony is ongoing.
byChoice.zh: 按摩后不能维持张力说明子宫收缩乏力仍在持续。

byChoice.en: Heavy lochia with clots supports ongoing uterine bleeding from the placental site.
byChoice.zh: 恶露量多并有血块，支持胎盘附着部位仍在子宫性出血。

byChoice.en: This is relevant because it helps rule away a laceration source, but it is not itself an abnormal hemorrhage cue needing immediate correction.
byChoice.zh: 这一正常发现有助于排除裂伤来源，但它本身不是需要立即处理的异常出血线索。

byChoice.en: A distended bladder can displace the uterus and prevent effective contraction, worsening atony.
byChoice.zh: 膀胱充盈会使子宫偏移并妨碍有效收缩，从而加重子宫收缩乏力。

byChoice.en: Cool clammy skin and delayed capillary refill are peripheral perfusion cues of hypovolemia.
byChoice.zh: 皮肤湿冷和毛细血管再充盈延迟提示低血容量导致外周灌注不足。

byChoice.en: Blood loss of 600 mL after a vaginal birth meets the traditional PPH threshold and is still increasing.
byChoice.zh: 阴道分娩后失血 600 mL 已达到传统产后出血阈值，并且仍在增加。

byChoice.en: Absence of chest pain or dyspnea is reassuring but does not address the hemorrhage source.
byChoice.zh: 无胸痛或气短较为 reassuring，但不能说明出血来源或严重程度。

correct.en: The key cues are a boggy displaced uterus that cannot maintain tone, heavy lochia with clots, blood loss already at 600 mL and increasing, tachycardia, hypotension relative to a hypertensive baseline, poor peripheral perfusion, and a palpable bladder that can worsen uterine displacement. Normal temperature and oxygen saturation do not define the problem, and the intact perineal repair helps narrow the source away from a laceration.
correct.zh: 关键线索包括子宫底偏移且松软、不能维持张力，恶露量多伴血块，失血量已达 600 mL 且仍在增加，心动过速，相对于妊娠期高血压基线明显下降的血压，外周灌注差，以及可触及的膀胱充盈（可加重子宫偏移）。体温和血氧正常不能说明当前问题；会阴修补处完整有助于把出血来源从裂伤转向子宫。

stem.en: Highlight the assessment findings that require immediate follow-up for postpartum hemorrhage from uterine atony.
stem.zh: 请标出需要立即针对子宫收缩乏力性产后出血进行处理的评估发现。

testTakingStrategy.en: In early postpartum bleeding, first connect uterine tone, lochia, blood-loss amount, and perfusion signs. Compare vital signs with the client's baseline, not just the normal range.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 早期产后出血题先把子宫张力、恶露、失血量和灌注表现联系起来；生命体征要和该患者的基线比较，而不只看正常范围。

clozeStem.en: The most likely cause of the hemorrhage is {{dd_condition}} because {{dd_best_evidence}}. Uterine inversion is unlikely because {{dd_inversion_ruleout}}.
clozeStem.zh: 最可能的出血原因是 {{dd_condition}}，因为 {{dd_best_evidence}}。子宫内翻的可能性较低，因为 {{dd_inversion_ruleout}}。

options.en: uterine inversion
options.zh: 子宫内翻

options.en: retained placental tissue
options.zh: 胎盘组织残留

options.en: uterine atony
options.zh: 子宫收缩乏力

options.en: cervical or vaginal laceration
options.zh: 宫颈或阴道裂伤

options.en: the boggy fundus briefly firms with massage but immediately relaxes
options.zh: 子宫底松软，按摩后短暂变硬但很快又松弛

options.en: the client is O-positive with a negative antibody screen
options.zh: 患者 O 型 Rh 阳性且抗体筛查阴性

options.en: the urinalysis shows 1+ protein
options.zh: 尿检显示蛋白 1+

options.en: the repaired second-degree laceration is intact
options.zh: 二度裂伤修补处完整

options.en: several small clots are present
options.zh: 可见数个小血块

options.en: the fundus is palpable above the umbilicus
options.zh: 子宫底可在脐上触及

options.en: the infant weighed 4.2 kg
options.zh: 新生儿体重 4.2 kg

options.en: oxytocin was used during labor
options.zh: 产程中使用过催产素

glossary.defZh: 产后子宫不能充分收缩以压迫胎盘附着部位血管。
产后子宫翻转内陷的一种罕见急症。
胎盘碎片残留在子宫内，可妨碍子宫收缩并导致出血。

byChoice.en: Correct: the uterus is boggy and does not maintain tone.
byChoice.zh: 正确：子宫松软，不能维持张力。

byChoice.en: A laceration usually causes persistent bleeding with a firm uterus; the repair here is intact and not actively bleeding.
byChoice.zh: 裂伤通常表现为子宫坚硬但仍持续出血；本例修补处完整且无活动性出血。

byChoice.en: Retained tissue can cause atony, but the placenta was documented intact and no retained-fragment cue is present at Stage 1.
byChoice.zh: 胎盘残留可导致子宫收缩不良，但本例胎盘记录为完整，第 1 阶段没有残留组织线索。

byChoice.en: Inversion would usually make the fundus absent from its expected abdominal position or visible/protruding vaginally.
byChoice.zh: 子宫内翻通常表现为腹部预期位置触不到子宫底，或阴道内可见/突出肿块。

byChoice.en: Correct: inability to sustain uterine tone is the central cue for atony.
byChoice.zh: 正确：不能维持子宫张力是收缩乏力的核心线索。

byChoice.en: This helps rule away laceration but is not the best positive evidence for atony.
byChoice.zh: 这有助于排除裂伤，但不是支持子宫收缩乏力的最佳阳性证据。

byChoice.en: Blood type and antibody screen matter for transfusion planning, not identifying the hemorrhage source.
byChoice.zh: 血型和抗体筛查对输血准备重要，但不能判断出血来源。

byChoice.en: Proteinuria supports the hypertensive pregnancy history, not the immediate cause of bleeding.
byChoice.zh: 蛋白尿支持妊娠期高血压病史，但不是当前出血原因。

byChoice.en: Correct: a palpable abdominal fundus makes inversion unlikely.
byChoice.zh: 正确：腹部可触及子宫底，使子宫内翻可能性降低。

byChoice.en: Clots support hemorrhage but do not distinguish inversion from other causes.
byChoice.zh: 血块支持出血，但不能区分子宫内翻和其他原因。

byChoice.en: Oxytocin exposure is relevant to labor history but does not rule out inversion.
byChoice.zh: 催产素使用与产程有关，但不能排除子宫内翻。

byChoice.en: Macrosomia is a risk factor for atony, not a direct rule-out for inversion.
byChoice.zh: 巨大儿是子宫收缩乏力的风险因素，但不是直接排除子宫内翻的依据。

correct.en: A boggy uterus that will not maintain tone after massage identifies uterine atony as the primary mechanism. The intact laceration repair argues against a traumatic lower-tract source. Retained tissue is possible early in a PPH workup, but the placenta was inspected as complete and the defining cue is uterine relaxation. Inversion is unlikely because the fundus remains palpable in the abdomen.
correct.zh: 按摩后不能维持张力的松软子宫指向子宫收缩乏力。会阴裂伤修补处完整，不支持下生殖道创伤性出血。胎盘残留在产后出血评估中可以考虑，但胎盘已检查完整，且决定性线索是子宫松弛。子宫底仍可在腹部触及，因此子宫内翻可能性低。

stem.en: Complete the clinical reasoning statement using the available Stage 1 findings.
stem.zh: 根据第 1 阶段可获得的资料，完成临床推理陈述。

testTakingStrategy.en: For PPH differentials, ask whether the uterus is firm or boggy. Boggy points to tone; firm with bleeding points more toward trauma or tissue.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 区分产后出血原因时先问子宫是坚硬还是松软。松软指向“张力”问题；子宫坚硬但仍出血则更偏向创伤或组织残留。

glossary.defZh: 促进子宫收缩的药物。
一种具有血管收缩作用的宫缩药；高血压相关疾病中不安全。
一种前列腺素类宫缩药，可加重哮喘患者支气管痉挛。

options.en: Administer carboprost tromethamine 250 mcg IM.
options.zh: 给予卡前列素氨丁三醇 250 mcg IM。

options.en: Administer methylergonovine 0.2 mg IM.
options.zh: 给予甲基麦角新碱 0.2 mg IM。

options.en: Administer misoprostol 800 mcg rectally.
options.zh: 给予米索前列醇 800 mcg 经直肠给药。

options.en: Hold all additional uterotonics until the repeat CBC and coagulation panel result.
options.zh: 在复查 CBC 和凝血功能结果出来前暂停所有追加宫缩药。

byChoice.en: Correct: misoprostol treats atony and avoids the hypertension contraindication of methylergonovine and the asthma risk of carboprost.
byChoice.zh: 正确：米索前列醇可治疗子宫收缩乏力，同时避开甲基麦角新碱的高血压禁忌和卡前列素的哮喘风险。

byChoice.en: Carboprost should be avoided in asthma because it can trigger bronchospasm.
byChoice.zh: 卡前列素应避免用于哮喘患者，因为可诱发支气管痉挛。

byChoice.en: The client is unstable with ongoing hemorrhage; uterotonic treatment must not wait for labs when the atony source is clear.
byChoice.zh: 患者不稳定且仍在出血；当子宫收缩乏力来源明确时，不应等化验结果才使用宫缩药。

byChoice.en: Methylergonovine is contraindicated with pregnancy-induced hypertension because vasoconstriction can cause severe rebound hypertension once volume is restored.
byChoice.zh: 甲基麦角新碱禁用于妊娠期高血压患者，因为补足容量后血管收缩作用可能导致严重反跳性高血压。

correct.en: Misoprostol is the safe second-line uterotonic in this client because methylergonovine is contraindicated by pregnancy-induced hypertension and carboprost is unsafe with asthma. Current hemorrhagic hypotension does not remove the methylergonovine contraindication.
correct.zh: 本例中米索前列醇是安全的二线宫缩药，因为妊娠期高血压禁用甲基麦角新碱，哮喘病史使卡前列素不安全。当前因失血导致的低血压并不能解除甲基麦角新碱的禁忌。

stem.en: The provider orders a second uterotonic. Which medication should the nurse administer from the available unit options?
stem.zh: 医嘱追加第二种宫缩药。护士应从病区可用药物中给予哪一种？

testTakingStrategy.en: When medication choices all treat the same problem, screen each option for patient-specific contraindications before choosing the strongest drug.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当多个药物都能治疗同一问题时，先根据患者个体禁忌证筛选，而不是直接选择作用最强的药。

glossary.defZh: 一种抗纤溶辅助止血药；不是宫缩药。
在进行进一步治疗时用双手压迫子宫以减少出血。
血库为输注相容血液所做的检测。

options.en: Have another team member send the type and crossmatch specimen immediately.
options.zh: 由另一名团队成员立即送检配血标本。

options.en: Maintain continuous external fundal massage or assist with bimanual compression.
options.zh: 持续进行外部子宫底按摩，或协助双手压迫子宫。

options.en: Stop fundal massage so the primary nurse can draw the laboratory specimens first.
options.zh: 停止子宫底按摩，让责任护士先抽取化验标本。

options.en: Start tranexamic acid 1 g IV over 10 minutes per the PPH protocol after uterotonic administration is underway.
options.zh: 宫缩药给药开始后，按产后出血方案给予氨甲环酸 1 g IV，10 分钟输注。

options.en: Continue rapid warmed IV fluid resuscitation through large-bore access.
options.zh: 通过大口径静脉通路继续快速输入温热 IV 液体复苏。

options.en: Administer the selected second uterotonic without delay.
options.zh: 立即给予已选择的第二种宫缩药。

byChoice.en: Stopping compression for labs allows the atonic uterus to refill and bleed; team response prevents this delay.
byChoice.zh: 为了抽血而停止压迫会使松软子宫再次充血出血；团队协作可避免这种延误。

byChoice.en: Correct: a second safe uterotonic directly treats the atony causing the hemorrhage.
byChoice.zh: 正确：安全的第二种宫缩药直接治疗造成出血的子宫收缩乏力。

byChoice.en: Correct: source control must be maintained continuously while the uterus is atonic.
byChoice.zh: 正确：子宫收缩乏力时必须持续维持止血源控制。

byChoice.en: Correct: blood preparation is urgent, but it should be delegated to another team member so massage and resuscitation continue.
byChoice.zh: 正确：备血很紧急，但应由其他团队成员完成，以便持续按摩和复苏。

byChoice.en: Correct: TXA is ordered by protocol for PPH not responding to first-line uterotonics and should not be delayed once source-control actions are underway.
byChoice.zh: 正确：对于一线宫缩药反应不佳的产后出血，方案已医嘱使用氨甲环酸；在止血源控制进行中的同时不应延误。

byChoice.en: Correct: rapid volume resuscitation treats hypotension and poor perfusion while bleeding control proceeds.
byChoice.zh: 正确：在止血同时快速补充容量，以处理低血压和灌注不足。

correct.en: This is not a rigid ordered sequence. The team must maintain source control with massage/compression and a safe uterotonic while restoring circulating volume, starting ordered TXA within the protocol window, and preparing blood products through another team member. Lab and blood-bank tasks should not interrupt uterine compression.
correct.zh: 这不是严格的单线顺序题。团队必须同时通过按摩/压迫和安全宫缩药控制出血来源，恢复循环容量，在方案时间窗内启动已医嘱的氨甲环酸，并由其他团队成员准备血制品。化验和血库任务不能中断子宫压迫。

stem.en: Which actions should occur now as part of the coordinated team response? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 此时哪些措施应作为团队协作反应立即进行？选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a hemorrhage item lists many tasks, separate source control and resuscitation from tasks that can be assigned to helpers. Do not convert concurrent priorities into a fake sequence.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 出血题列出多项任务时，先区分“止血源控制和复苏”与可交给他人完成的任务；不要把并行优先事项误当成严格顺序。

glossary.defZh: 尿量减少，成人临床上常以低于 30 mL/hr 作为重要警讯。
一种凝血因子，在严重产科出血中可较早下降。
补液复苏后剩余血液成分被稀释，导致测得浓度下降。

rows.en: Uterus is firm and contracted at the umbilicus.
rows.zh: 子宫坚硬收缩，位于脐水平。

rows.en: Lochia has decreased to moderate dark-red flow without clots.
rows.zh: 恶露减少为中等量暗红色且无血块。

rows.en: Quantitative blood loss has plateaued at 1,450 mL with no new accumulation for 15 minutes.
rows.zh: 定量失血停留在 1,450 mL，15 分钟内无新增积血。

rows.en: Client is alert, oriented, and no longer confused.
rows.zh: 患者清醒、定向力正常，不再意识混乱。

rows.en: Blood pressure has improved from 80/52 to 94/60 mmHg.
rows.zh: 血压从 80/52 mmHg 改善至 94/60 mmHg。

rows.en: Hemoglobin is 7.4 g/dL after crystalloid resuscitation and transfusion has begun.
rows.zh: 晶体液复苏后血红蛋白为 7.4 g/dL，输血已开始。

rows.en: Fibrinogen has trended down from 410 to 280 to 240 mg/dL.
rows.zh: 纤维蛋白原从 410 降至 280 再降至 240 mg/dL。

rows.en: Foley output is 25 mL/hr of concentrated amber urine.
rows.zh: Foley 尿量为 25 mL/hr，呈浓缩琥珀色。

rows.en: Heart rate is improved but remains 112 beats/min.
rows.zh: 心率较前改善但仍为 112 次/分。

byChoice.en: A firm contracted uterus means the bleeding source is controlled for now.
byChoice.zh: 子宫坚硬收缩说明目前出血来源已得到控制。

byChoice.en: Decreased lochia without clots supports improved uterine control of bleeding.
byChoice.zh: 恶露减少且无血块支持子宫对出血控制改善。

byChoice.en: A plateau in measured blood loss is a direct sign that active accumulation has stopped.
byChoice.zh: 定量失血不再上升直接说明活动性积血已停止。

byChoice.en: Clearing mental status indicates improving cerebral perfusion after resuscitation.
byChoice.zh: 意识转清提示复苏后脑灌注改善。

byChoice.en: The BP is still low but improved from the shock-level reading, supporting early stabilization.
byChoice.zh: 血压仍偏低，但较休克时改善，支持早期稳定。

byChoice.en: This confirms major red-cell loss and need for continued transfusion; with controlled bleeding it does not alone prove rebleeding.
byChoice.zh: 这证实红细胞丢失严重，需要继续输血；在出血受控时，它本身不能证明再出血。

byChoice.en: The value remains above the critical 200 mg/dL threshold but the downward trend requires close monitoring for coagulopathy.
byChoice.zh: 数值仍高于 200 mg/dL 临界值，但下降趋势需要严密监测凝血障碍。

byChoice.en: Urine output below 30 mL/hr indicates ongoing renal hypoperfusion from volume deficit.
byChoice.zh: 尿量低于 30 mL/hr 提示容量不足导致肾灌注仍差。

byChoice.en: Persistent tachycardia means physiologic recovery is incomplete even though the trend is better.
byChoice.zh: 持续心动过速说明生理恢复尚未完成，即使趋势已有改善。

correct.en: The case is improving because uterine tone is restored, lochia is reduced, QBL has plateaued, mentation is clear, and BP is trending up. She is not fully stable: hemoglobin remains severely low, fibrinogen is falling, urine output is below 30 mL/hr, and tachycardia persists, so transfusion and close monitoring must continue.
correct.zh: 本例出现改善，因为子宫张力恢复、恶露减少、定量失血停止上升、意识转清、血压回升。但患者尚未完全稳定：血红蛋白仍很低，纤维蛋白原继续下降，尿量低于 30 mL/hr，心动过速持续，因此必须继续输血和严密监测。

stem.en: Classify each Stage 3 finding as evidence of early stabilization or as a finding that still requires close monitoring/continued concern.
stem.zh: 请将第 3 阶段每项发现分类为“早期稳定证据”或“仍需严密监测/持续关注”。

testTakingStrategy.en: In evaluation items, separate source control from systemic recovery. A firm uterus tells you bleeding is controlled; urine output, HR, hemoglobin, and fibrinogen tell you whether shock and coagulopathy are resolving.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价类题目要把“出血来源控制”与“全身恢复”分开看。子宫坚硬说明出血受控；尿量、心率、血红蛋白和纤维蛋白原反映休克和凝血状态是否恢复。

glossary.defZh: 将球囊置入子宫腔内，通过压力减少出血。
用于控制严重子宫出血的一种外科压迫缝合。
凝血形成受损，可加重持续出血。

options.en: Quantitative blood loss resumes climbing despite uterotonics and compression.
options.zh: 尽管已使用宫缩药和压迫，定量失血仍继续上升。

options.en: Urine output remains 25 mL/hr but bleeding remains controlled.
options.zh: 尿量仍为 25 mL/hr，但出血保持受控。

options.en: The uterus becomes boggy again with renewed heavy lochia.
options.zh: 子宫再次变松软，并重新出现大量恶露。

options.en: Fibrinogen falls below 200 mg/dL with ongoing bleeding risk.
options.zh: 纤维蛋白原降至 200 mg/dL 以下，并存在持续出血风险。

options.en: Hemoglobin is 7.4 g/dL while the uterus is firm and QBL is plateaued.
options.zh: 子宫坚硬且定量失血停止上升时，血红蛋白为 7.4 g/dL。

options.en: Heart rate improves from 132 to 112 beats/min.
options.zh: 心率从 132 次/分改善至 112 次/分。

byChoice.en: Low urine output shows ongoing hypoperfusion and need for resuscitation, but without recurrent bleeding it is not a direct surgical trigger.
byChoice.zh: 尿量低提示灌注不足，需要继续复苏；但若没有再出血，它不是直接手术指征。

byChoice.en: Correct: recurrent atony with renewed heavy bleeding means source control has failed and escalation is needed.
byChoice.zh: 正确：子宫收缩乏力复发并再次大量出血，说明止血源控制失败，需要升级处理。

byChoice.en: Correct: continued measured blood loss despite uterotonics/compression suggests need for balloon tamponade or operative control.
byChoice.zh: 正确：在宫缩药和压迫后定量失血仍上升，提示可能需要球囊填塞或手术止血。

byChoice.en: Improved but persistent tachycardia requires monitoring; it is not an escalation trigger when bleeding is controlled.
byChoice.zh: 心率虽仍偏快但已有改善，需要监测；在出血受控时不是升级处理触发点。

byChoice.en: Correct: fibrinogen below 200 mg/dL during obstetric bleeding is a critical coagulopathy warning and supports escalation of hemorrhage management.
byChoice.zh: 正确：产科出血时纤维蛋白原低于 200 mg/dL 是凝血障碍的重要警讯，支持升级出血处理。

byChoice.en: With a firm uterus and plateaued QBL, the low hemoglobin supports transfusion and reassessment, not surgery by itself.
byChoice.zh: 在子宫坚硬且定量失血停止上升时，低血红蛋白支持输血和复查，本身不等于需要手术。

correct.en: Escalation is driven by loss of source control or evolving coagulopathy: recurrent bogginess with heavy bleeding, QBL that rises despite uterotonics and compression, or fibrinogen falling below the critical threshold. Low hemoglobin, oliguria, or persistent tachycardia require treatment and monitoring, but when bleeding is controlled they do not by themselves mandate surgical escalation.
correct.zh: 升级处理主要由出血来源失控或凝血障碍进展驱动：子宫再次松软并大量出血、在宫缩药和压迫后定量失血仍上升，或纤维蛋白原低于临界值。低血红蛋白、少尿或持续心动过速需要治疗和监测；但在出血受控时，它们本身不必然要求手术升级。

stem.en: Which findings would signal the need to anticipate escalation to intrauterine balloon tamponade or surgical intervention? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 哪些发现提示需要预期升级至宫腔球囊填塞或手术干预？选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not treat every abnormal lab or vital sign as a surgical trigger. Escalation follows uncontrolled bleeding, recurrent atony, or coagulopathy crossing a critical threshold.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要把每个异常化验或生命体征都当作手术触发点。升级处理通常取决于出血失控、子宫收缩乏力复发，或凝血指标跨过关键阈值。

content.en: The nurse begins external fundal massage with lower uterine support and calls for assistance. Straight catheterization drains 450 mL of clear urine; the uterus descends to the umbilicus but remains boggy. Oxytocin is confirmed infusing and increased per standing order to infuse the remaining volume over 30 minutes. Two 16-gauge peripheral IVs are placed; warmed LR is hung wide open. Quantitative blood loss is now 800 mL. Vital signs: HR 124, BP 86/58, RR 24, SpO2 96% on room air. The provider is called to bedside.
content.zh: 护士开始在下方支托子宫的同时进行外部子宫底按摩，并呼叫协助。一次性导尿排出清亮尿液 450 mL；子宫下降至脐水平但仍松软。确认催产素正在输注，并按常规医嘱提高速度，在 30 分钟内输完剩余液体。置入两条 16G 外周静脉通路；温热 LR 全速开放。定量失血现为 800 mL。生命体征：HR 124，BP 86/58，RR 24，室内空气 SpO2 96%。已呼叫医师到床旁。

title.zh: 第 1 阶段：初始出血处理
第 1 阶段：初始出血处理

content.en: Despite massage and increased oxytocin, the uterus intermittently firms then relaxes within seconds. QBL is 1,200 mL. Vital signs: HR 132, BP 80/52, RR 26, SpO2 95% on room air. The client is confused and markedly pale with capillary refill 4 seconds. The provider rules out retained placental fragments and unrepaired cervical/vaginal lacerations. Available uterotonics are methylergonovine 0.2 mg IM, misoprostol 800 mcg rectally, and carboprost 250 mcg IM. Stat labs: Hgb 8.1 g/dL, Hct 24.3%, platelets 162 ×10³/µL, fibrinogen 280 mg/dL, INR 1.1, aPTT 30 sec. Type and crossmatch for 2 units PRBC is sent. The unit protocol orders tranexamic acid 1 g IV over 10 minutes within 3 hours of birth for PPH not responding to first-line uterotonics.
content.zh: 尽管持续按摩并增加催产素输注，子宫仍间歇性变硬后数秒内又松弛。定量失血 1,200 mL。生命体征：HR 132，BP 80/52，RR 26，室内空气 SpO2 95%。患者意识混乱、明显苍白，毛细血管再充盈 4 秒。医师排除胎盘碎片残留及未修补的宫颈/阴道裂伤。可用宫缩药包括甲基麦角新碱 0.2 mg IM、米索前列醇 800 mcg 经直肠给药、卡前列素 250 mcg IM。急查化验：Hgb 8.1 g/dL，Hct 24.3%，血小板 162 ×10³/µL，纤维蛋白原 280 mg/dL，INR 1.1，aPTT 30 秒。已送 2 单位 PRBC 配血。病区方案医嘱：对一线宫缩药反应不佳的产后出血，在分娩后 3 小时内给予氨甲环酸 1 g IV，10 分钟输注。

title.en: Stage 2: Persistent atony and medication selection
title.zh: 第 2 阶段：子宫收缩乏力持续及药物选择

title.en: Stage 2: Persistent atony and medication selection
title.zh: 第 2 阶段：子宫收缩乏力持续及药物选择

content.en: Misoprostol 800 mcg was given rectally, tranexamic acid 1 g IV was infused over 10 minutes, and the provider performed aggressive bimanual compression. The uterus is now firm at the umbilicus. Lochia is moderate dark red without clots. QBL has plateaued at 1,450 mL with no further active accumulation for 15 minutes. Vital signs: HR 112, BP 94/60, RR 20, SpO2 97% on 2 L nasal cannula. The client is alert and oriented but fatigued and mildly dizzy with repositioning. The first PRBC unit is infusing through a dedicated large-bore IV; a second unit is ordered. Repeat labs: Hgb 7.4 g/dL, Hct 22.1%, platelets 148 ×10³/µL, fibrinogen 240 mg/dL, INR 1.2, aPTT 32 sec. Foley output is 25 mL/hr of concentrated amber urine. Fundal checks continue every 15 minutes.
content.zh: 已给予米索前列醇 800 mcg 经直肠给药，氨甲环酸 1 g IV 10 分钟输注，医师进行了积极双手子宫压迫。现在子宫坚硬，位于脐水平。恶露为中等量暗红色，无血块。定量失血停留在 1,450 mL，15 分钟内无进一步活动性增加。生命体征：HR 112，BP 94/60，RR 20，鼻导管 2 L 下 SpO2 97%。患者清醒、定向力正常，但疲乏，变换体位时仍轻度头晕。第 1 单位 PRBC 正通过专用大口径 IV 输注；已医嘱随后输注第 2 单位。复查化验：Hgb 7.4 g/dL，Hct 22.1%，血小板 148 ×10³/µL，纤维蛋白原 240 mg/dL，INR 1.2，aPTT 32 秒。Foley 尿量 25 mL/hr，为浓缩琥珀色尿。继续每 15 分钟检查子宫底。

summary.en: A 32-year-old G5P5 client is one hour postpartum after a vaginal birth of a 4.2 kg infant. She has pregnancy-induced hypertension treated with labetalol and mild intermittent asthma. She develops heavy bleeding, a boggy displaced fundus, tachycardia, and hypotension relative to her hypertensive baseline.
summary.zh: 一名 32 岁 G5P5 产妇在阴道分娩 4.2 kg 新生儿后 1 小时处于产后恢复期。她有妊娠期高血压，使用拉贝洛尔治疗，并有轻度间歇性哮喘。她出现大量出血、子宫底偏移且松软、心动过速，以及相对高血压基线明显下降的血压。

title.en: Postpartum hemorrhage from uterine atony in a grand multiparous client with pregnancy-induced hypertension
title.zh: 妊娠期高血压经产妇因子宫收缩乏力发生的产后出血

glossary.defZh: 分娩后过量出血；传统上指阴道分娩后至少 500 mL，或伴低血容量表现的出血。
产后子宫不能充分收缩，无法止住胎盘附着部位出血。
通过称重材料和收集血液进行客观失血测量。
用于促进子宫收缩的药物。
尿量低于预期最低值，是休克中肾灌注不足的表现。

correct.en: This case follows recognition, treatment, and evaluation of early postpartum hemorrhage from uterine atony. The decisive cues are heavy bleeding, QBL above the vaginal-birth PPH threshold, a boggy displaced uterus that will not maintain tone, tachycardia, hypotension relative to a hypertensive baseline, poor perfusion, and bladder distention. The intact laceration repair and later exploration narrow the source away from trauma or retained tissue. Priority care is concurrent: maintain uterine compression/massage, administer a safe uterotonic, restore volume through large-bore IV access, prepare blood, and give ordered TXA within the unit protocol. Misoprostol is the safe second-line uterotonic because methylergonovine is contraindicated by pregnancy-induced hypertension and carboprost is unsafe with asthma. Improvement is shown by a firm uterus, decreased lochia, plateaued QBL, clearer mentation, and rising BP; continued concern is shown by anemia, downward fibrinogen trend, oliguria, and persistent tachycardia.
correct.zh: 本病例呈现早期子宫收缩乏力性产后出血的识别、处理和评价。决定性线索包括大量出血、定量失血超过阴道分娩产后出血阈值、子宫底偏移且松软并不能维持张力、心动过速、相对妊娠期高血压基线明显下降的血压、灌注不良以及膀胱充盈。会阴修补处完整以及后续探查结果，使出血来源不支持创伤或胎盘残留。优先护理是并行进行的：维持子宫压迫/按摩，给予安全宫缩药，通过大口径 IV 恢复容量，准备血制品，并按病区方案给予已医嘱的氨甲环酸。米索前列醇是安全的二线宫缩药，因为妊娠期高血压禁用甲基麦角新碱，哮喘病史使卡前列素不安全。改善表现为子宫坚硬、恶露减少、定量失血停止上升、意识转清、血压回升；仍需关注的表现包括贫血、纤维蛋白原下降趋势、少尿和持续心动过速。

testTakingStrategy.en: For postpartum hemorrhage, use the four-T framework but let uterine tone lead the first hypothesis. A boggy uterus means tone/atony until proven otherwise; management must control the source and restore perfusion at the same time.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 处理产后出血题可使用“四个 T”框架，但第一假设要由子宫张力决定。子宫松软时优先考虑张力问题/子宫收缩乏力；处理必须同时控制出血来源并恢复灌注。
